Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. A 6-8 page image-text script, each page including visual description, main copy, key info points, and interaction/save action; 3. Change to pure black-and-white high contrast

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: An ochre-orange rounded square icon containing a white radiating-line pattern, with a text mark below
cards.why: A highly recognizable square icon replaces a real person or scene, making the cover look like official institutional output and boosting credibility.

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: A clean, restrained, slightly authoritative informational cover
cards.why: No extra decoration; relies on font weight and whitespace to signal "this is substance," suitable for tutorial list content to be saved and shared.

cards.label: Subject

cards.value: 上手い人は、情報ではなく景色を渡している
cards.why: Use a counterintuitive contrasting conclusion to create cognitive conflict and make people curious about what "scenery" actually refers to.

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Left-right contrast two columns + center conclusion column, horizontally balanced across the whole image
cards.why: The contrast structure lets readers see the gap at a glance, lowers comprehension cost, and makes it easy to screenshot and save.

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Mainly white background with black text, blue frame lines for sections, yellow highlighted title
cards.why: Blue-yellow contrast is eye-catching but not harsh, and the hand-drawn feel of the colors appears friendly yet professional.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: Hand-drawn stick-figure dialogue scene, confused on the left and confident on the right
cards.why: Minimalist facial expressions are expressive, and readers can immediately identify with the two states of "can't talk" and "can talk."

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Relaxed and easy-to-understand teaching feel, as friendly as hand-drawn notes
cards.why: Lower the psychological barrier to learning, make people feel "I can learn this too," and thus be willing to save it.

spec: 上手い人は、情報ではなく景色を渡している

cards.label: Mood

sourcePrompt.en: Based on the reference cover's composition, visual metaphor, and readability as a WeChat public-account thumbnail, generate a new horizontal WeChat public-account cover. Output size: 1456x582, ratio about 2.5:1; keep the core subject and essential title information within the safe square crop for the public account. Article title: {fill in the public-account article title} Intro: {fill in the intro} Original cover approach: the "72 Must-Have Claude Skills Top Professionals Use: The Ultimate Guide" style dual skill. Create a horizontal WeChat public-account article cover, 2.35:1 aspect ratio, for an article titled "72 Must-Have Claude Skills Top Professionals Use: The Ultimate Guide". Central concept: visualize abstract tool capabilities as interface windows, code snippets, node networks, control consoles, AI workflows, or a glowing system core. Style: preserve the reference cover's visual direction: black-and-white or low-saturation editorial illustration/photo. Use a palette inspired by #fbf5e7 (white), #fbf3e6 (white), #79695b (brown), #fdf8e9 (white). Keep the image editorial, conceptual, and readable as a small WeChat thumbnail. Composition: lots of whitespace, suitable for a large headline, a few icons, and a clear left-text-right-image/center-headline layout. Keep the main subject and any essential title text inside the safe square crop, while using the full wide frame for atmosphere, secondary symbols, or directional motion. Text strategy: use either no text or a very short headline fragment from the title. If text is used, make it large, clean, and integrated into the layout rather than pasted on top. Mood: match the article skill "72 Must-Have Claude Skill... Top Professionals Use dual skill" -- useful, sharp, high-signal, and slightly more memorable than a normal tutorial thumbnail. Avoid: photorealistic clutter unless the source cover is photo-led, fake logos, unreadable tiny text, generic gradient blobs, stock-office imagery, watermark-like marks, and literal screenshots unless the article is explicitly about software interfaces.

Top of the image, about 90% width

A cartoon girl with double braids, lying on her side with eyes closed

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: 47 min
cards.why: The oversized text pushes the most counterintuitive number right in front of you, instantly creating the question, "How could it only take 47 minutes?"
alts: Switch to "8 hours" to highlight the workload contrast
Place "47 min vs 8 h" side by side as a dual-number contrast
Enlarge the template count "9" as the main number

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: A single full-width column with no dividers, a large number on the left aligned with left-aligned explanatory text below, a small text info block in the upper right, and a one-line source footnote along the bottom edge
cards.why: A minimalist single column with generous whitespace lets the eye follow just one main line, making it effortless to read, like a list cover meant to be saved to a collection.
alts: Change to a large number on the left and three horizontal key points on the right
A cover with a thin divider line added at the bottom
Two columns comparing number on the left and text on the right

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Off-white background with near-black text, entirely achromatic, with hierarchy created by font weight and size
cards.why: The low-stimulation paper-like background keeps long titles comfortable to read for a long time, and the absence of color blocks itself becomes a visual label of a "professional document."
alts: Change the background to light gray-blue for a more tool-like feel
Highlight the main number with one accent color
Make a dark version with a dark background and reversed white text

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: There is no graphic subject in the image, only text arranged as the main visual: a large "47 min" and three lines of italic explanatory text
cards.why: Treating the text as the main image means readers first see the conclusion rather than decoration, delivering the information directly.
alts: Place a small illustration of a prompt card
Use geometric color blocks to support the text

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Calm, restrained archival feel, like a numbered work record, professional without being loud
cards.why: Not making grand claims instead makes it feel credible, suitable for readers moved by "this method works" to share tool-tutorial content.

spec: Upper left of the image, occupying about 40% of the width
Serif typeface, very bold numerals, min in lowercase
Main number and explanatory text are left-aligned; the small text in the upper right forms its own block
Wide whitespace on all sides, with a one-line footnote near the bottom edge
A single achromatic color, no accent color
Two lines of italic explanatory text
No illustration, no photo, no portrait
No light or shadow, flat and even
Monospaced small text and numbering create a recorded feel

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: 47 min
cards.why: 超大字号把最反直觉的数字推到眼前，一秒制造“凭什么只要47分钟”的追问。
alts: 换成“8 小时”，突出工作量反差
并列“47 min vs 8 h”双数字对冲
把模板数量“9”放大做主数字

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 单栏整幅无分割，左侧大数字对齐下方向左齐的说明文字，右上角小字信息块，底边一行出处注脚
cards.why: 极简单栏加宽留白，让视线只走一条主线，读起来毫不费力，像一份要被收进收藏夹的清单封面。
alts: 改成左大数字右三条横排要点
底部加一条细分隔线的封面
双栏左数字右文字对照

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 米白底配近黑字，全部为无彩色，靠字重与字号分主次
cards.why: 低刺激的纸感底色让长标题久看不累，也让色块缺失本身变成一种“专业文档”的视觉标签。
alts: 底色改成浅灰蓝更偏工具感
主数字用一个强调色点出

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 画面没有图形主体，只有排布成主视觉的文字：大号“47 min”与三行斜体小字说明
cards.why: 把文字当主图，读者第一眼读到的是结论而不是装饰，信息直达。
alts: 加入一枚抽象对话气泡图标
放一个提示词卡片的小插图

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 冷静、克制的档案感，像一份编号后的工作记录，专业而不喧哗
cards.why: 不喊口号反而显得可信，适合工具教程类内容被“方法有效”打动的读者转发。
alts: 更轻松的圆润字体氛围

spec: 画面左上，占约四成宽度
衬线体，数字特粗，min 为小写
主数字与说明文字左对齐，右上小字独立成块
四周留白宽，底部一行注脚贴近下缘
等宽小字与编号字样营造记录感

cards.why: The star symbol replaces a specific person or screenshot, keeping the cover neutral and reusable while also hinting at "lighting up/a fresh start."

Change to pure black and white with a bit of red
Darken the whole thing into deep blue-gray

alts: Keep only the hole and no form

Enlarge the form to fill one panel

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Cold, tense, like an accident happening right now
cards.why: The overhead angle plus cold light gives the image a sense of pressure, and viewers will save it with unease.
alts: Change to a quiet empty-shot feel
Change to a bright daytime tone
Add graininess for a rougher look

spec: Cold white light reflected from the ice
Strong contrast between the large blue-white area and the small deep red block

cards.label: 钩子
cards.why: 画面里完全没有文字，靠三格从上到下的残酷变化制造悬念，让人想滑到下一张看答案。
alts: 加一行悬念短句压在上格
在下格空白处写一句反转台词

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 三格等高横条画面自上而下堆叠，无边框，铺满整幅

alts: 改成一格大图加一条底栏

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 冰面浅蓝白打底，洞口由深蓝转为大片深红
cards.why: 大面积冷蓝白里塞进一块深红，颜色本身就在说危险和代价。

cards.label: 主体

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: 本当に幸せな人の思考

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: A single horizontal infographic with a diagonal road running through the whole image and text and figures distributed at three points: left, center, and right
cards.why: A diagonal line guides the eye from the lower left all the way to the upper right, creating a smooth visual flow that is easy to read.
alts: Make it a circular looping arrow

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Mainly white background with black text, a gray road, and accents of red arrows and red hearts
cards.why: Large areas of black, white, and gray keep it rational and restrained, with red used only to mark emotion and energy so the focus is instantly visible.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A small black figure jumping to the right along a gray road, with a red flame on its chest and red hearts around it
cards.why: A simple stick figure with exaggerated movements makes the state of "breaking free and moving forward" instantly understandable.
alts: Change to a person seen from behind

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: A rational infographic with a slightly upbeat, uplifting emotion
cards.why: A calm explanatory feel plus the leaping red figure makes change feel possible rather than preachy.

spec: Largest in the image, black bold
A gray diagonal road extending from lower left to upper right
Three points: upper left, center, and right side
#D32F2F red, used for arrows and red hearts
Black stick figure with both arms raised and legs in a stride
Two red hearts and a dashed line connecting to a circle on the left
Right-center of the image, on the road

xray.short: Rational with a sense of movement
spec: No light or shadow, flat solid color
Explanatory infographic feel, rational and slightly relaxed
Red hearts and flames bring warmth

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: 本当に幸せな人の思考

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 白底黑字为主，灰色道路，红色箭头与红心点缀
cards.why: 大面积黑白灰保持理性克制，仅用红色标记情绪与能量，重点一眼可见。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 沿灰色道路向右跃起的小黑人，胸口有红色火焰，周围有红心
cards.why: 简单火柴人动作夸张，让「摆脱束缚往前走」的状态被一眼看懂。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 理性图解中带着一点轻快向上的情绪
cards.why: 冷静的说明感加上红色小人的跃动，让人觉得改变是可行的而不是说教。

spec: 本当に幸せな人の思考
灰色斜向道路从左下延伸到右上
黑色火柴人，双臂上举、腿部跨步
两颗红心，一条虚线连接左侧圆形
画面右中部，位于道路上
图解说明感，理性偏轻松

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: GEMINI PLAYS POKÉMON
cards.why: Pairing a top-tier model with a childhood game creates a huge contrast that makes people want to click and see how it plays.

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Full-frame starry background, main title and subtitle centered and stacked vertically, no border and no columns
cards.why: Centered large text lets the message be read in a second, and the starry whitespace doesn't steal the show—great for video/article covers.
alts: Enlarge main title to fill the frame

cards.label: Color Palette
cards.value: Near-black background with white text; subtitle uses blue and pink for keyword emphasis
cards.why: The dark base makes text look like glowing pixels, while blue and pink accents push the brand and tech points right in front of the viewer.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: Pixel-style English title text in the center of the frame, with a dark starry background
cards.why: Pixel fonts evoke gaming memories; the text itself is the protagonist, with no character interfering with the information.

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Deep-space cosmic feel mixed with retro pixels—calm yet with a sense of exploration
cards.why: The starry sky evokes cutting-edge and infinite possibilities, while pixel style lowers the barrier, making technical content feel approachable and fun.

spec: White pixel monospace font, all caps
Single layout, no columns and no border
Main title on top, subtitle below, center-aligned
About one character-height gap between the two lines
About 7% padding on left and right
Two lines of pixel-style English title
Calm, techy, with a touch of nostalgia
Text like self-luminous pixels, background at low brightness
Curiosity, wanting to verify the results

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: GEMINI PLAYS POKÉMON
cards.why: 把顶级模型和童年游戏放一起，制造巨大反差，让人忍不住点开看它怎么玩。

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 全幅星空背景，主标题与副标题居中上下叠放，无边框无分栏
cards.why: 居中大字让信息一秒读完，留白星空不抢戏，适合做视频/文章封面。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 近黑背景配白字，副标题用蓝与粉做关键词强调
cards.why: 深色底让文字像发光像素，蓝粉点缀把品牌和技术点直接推到眼前。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 画面中央的像素风英文标题文字，背景为深色星空
cards.why: 像素字体唤起游戏记忆，文字本身就是主角，没有人物干扰信息。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 深空宇宙感混搭复古像素，冷静又带探索趣味
cards.why: 星空让人联想到前沿与无限，像素又降低门槛，让技术内容显得亲切好玩。

spec: 画面中部偏上，横向居中
白色像素等宽字体，全大写
主标题在上、副标题在下，居中对齐
两行之间留约一字高的空隙
文字如自发光像素，背景低亮度

Three equal-width, equal-height blocks arranged vertically with even spacing

Discover — Find tools & capabilities, with a magnifying glass icon
Verify — Identity, access & requirements, with a person icon

cards.label: 钩子

cards.label: Mood

sourcePrompt.en: Referencing the old photo restoration approach, vintage texture, visual storytelling, and publishing tone of the case study "AI Awakens the Old Times in Old Photos," generate a new set of retro old-photo image-text content. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. A 6-9 page image-text script, each page including visual description, main copy, era/texture keywords, and a save prompt; 3. Visual prompts that can be used directly for image generation or photo restoration, explaining requirements for characters, scene, lighting, film grain, damage repair, and color restoration; 4. cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 单幅整图，无分格，一行文字压在画面上方偏左
cards.why: 不分格的一整张画面像一张翻出来的旧相片，文字只占一条，不打断看人的视线。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 灰绿墙面配暖棕木家具，米白衣物提亮

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 一位短发女性坐在木凳上，怀里抱着一个幼儿

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 柔和室内光、暖调、安静的旧日居家感
cards.why: 暖光和旧家具把情绪压得温和，看的人容易想起自己家的老照片，从而收藏和转发。

spec: 画面上方，横向居中偏左
约占画面宽度三分之二

sourcePrompt.en: Using the reference case "AI Gave Old Photos New Life, Memories Awakened Again" as a model for old photo restoration approach, era texture, visual storytelling, and posting tone, generate a new set of vintage old-photo image-and-text content. New theme: {fill in the photo theme you want to restore, rebuild, or replicate} Reference platform: Xiaohongshu Content direction: vintage old-photo image-and-text Creation method: keep the original case's nostalgic emotion, film/photographic paper texture, relationships between people, period feel of the scene, and restoration constraints; if it is photo restoration, it must stay faithful to the original image's identity, facial features, composition, and historical context, and avoid excessive beautification, redrawing, false historical information, and a modern digital plastic feel. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. A 6-9 page image-and-text script, each page containing a scene description, main copy, era/texture keywords, and a save prompt; 3. Visual prompts that can be used directly for image generation or photo restoration, explaining requirements for people, scene, lighting, film grain, damage repair, and color restoration; 4. Posting suggestions: title length, tags, image ratio, and platform tone. Constraints: do not replicate the original author, original people, or brand logos; do not fabricate historical facts; when real people's photos are involved, prioritize identity consistency, and do not make them younger, beautify, slim the face, or rewrite facial features.

sourcePrompt.en: Please generate a new horizontal WeChat public-account cover based on the reference cover's composition, visual metaphor, and thumbnail readability for WeChat public accounts. Output size: 1456x582, ratio about 2.5:1; the core subject and essential title information should also work within WeChat's safe square crop. WeChat article title: {fill in the WeChat article title} Summary: {fill in the summary} Original cover method: AI in the 1447 Hajj: The Innovation Powering Saudi Arabia's Successful Hajj Season, dual-skill style. Create a horizontal WeChat public-account article cover, 2.35:1 aspect ratio, for an article titled "AI in the 1447 Hajj: The Innovation Powering Saudi Arabia's Successful Hajj Season". Central concept: visualize abstract tool capabilities as interface windows, code snippets, node networks, control consoles, AI workflows, or a glowing system core. Style: preserve the reference cover's visual direction: high-saturation poster/tech-advertising visuals. Use a palette inspired by #002f10 (charcoal), #32613b (green), #00290d (black), #023011 (charcoal). Keep the image editorial, conceptual, and readable as a small WeChat thumbnail. Composition: the image is information-dense, suitable for a central subject with supporting information on the left and right, keeping it readable as a thumbnail. Keep the main subject and any essential title text inside the safe square crop, while using the full wide frame for atmosphere, secondary symbols, or directional motion. Text strategy: use either no text or a very short headline fragment from the title. If text is used, make it large, clean, and integrated into the layout rather than pasted on top. Mood: match the article skill "AI in the 1447 Hajj Saudi Arabia powering a successful Hajj... dual-skill style" -- useful, sharp, high-signal, and slightly more memorable than a normal tutorial thumbnail. Avoid: photorealistic clutter unless the source cover is photo-led, fake logos, unreadable tiny text, generic gradient blobs, stock-office imagery, watermark-like marks, and literal screenshots unless the article is explicitly about software interfaces.

cards.label: Hook
cards.why: The absence of text forces viewers to read the faces, creating an immediate, silent punchline that is universally understood and shared.

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Four equal quadrants arranged in a 2x2 grid, each panel showing a different face or expression.
cards.why: The balanced grid allows for a clear chronological reading order (left-to-right, top-to-bottom) that frames the joke as a mini-narrative.

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Natural greens of a grassy field dominate the background, contrasting with warm skin tones and earthy clothing.
cards.why: The bright, sunlit greens make the image feel pleasant and familiar, lowering the viewer's guard before the subtle emotional shift.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: Two people shown in close-up: a young man with short hair in a dark tunic and a young woman with a floral headband.
cards.why: Using two distinct faces allows the meme to compare two opposing reactions or perspectives, making the dynamic relatable to any relationship.

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Playful and slightly sarcastic, moving from a contented smile to a neutral, knowing expression.
cards.why: The shift in mood mirrors everyday moments of subtle disappointment or realization, turning a private feeling into a shared, humorous experience.

cards.label: 钩子
cards.why: 没有文字迫使观众解读面部表情，创造出一种立即、无声且被普遍理解和分享的笑点。

cards.label: 布局
cards.value: 四个相等的象限排列成2x2网格，每个面板显示不同的面孔或表情。
cards.why: 平衡的网格允许清晰的时间顺序阅读（从左到右、从上到下），将笑点构建为一个小型叙事。

cards.label: 调色板
cards.value: 草地自然的绿色主导背景，与温暖的肤色和土色服装形成对比。
cards.why: 明亮、阳光照耀的绿色让图像感觉愉悦而熟悉，在微妙的情感转变前降低观众的防备。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 两个特写人物：一个穿深色束腰外衣的短发年轻男子和一个戴花卉头带的年轻女子。
cards.why: 使用两张不同的面孔让模因能够比较两种对立的反应或视角，使这种动态对任何关系都具有共鸣。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 俏皮且略带讽刺，从满足的微笑转变为中性、会意的表情。
cards.why: 情绪转变反映日常微妙失望或顿悟的时刻，将私人感受转变为共享的幽默体验。

sourcePrompt.en: Referencing the case study "Ancients said seeing is believing, what about now?" in its old photo restoration approach, period texture, visual storytelling, and publishing tone, generate a new set of retro old-photo image-text posts. New topic: {fill in the photo topic you want to restore, rebuild, or replicate} Reference platform: Xiaohongshu Content direction: retro old-photo image-text Creation method: Keep the original case's nostalgic mood, film/photo-paper texture, character relationships, era-appropriate scene feel, and restoration constraints; if it is photo restoration, it must stay faithful to the original image's identity, facial features, composition, and historical context, avoiding over-beautification, redrawing, false historical information, and a modern digital plastic look. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. 6-9 page image-text script, each page including visual description, main copy, era/texture keywords, and a save prompt; 3. Visual prompts that can be used directly for image generation or photo restoration, explaining requirements for characters, scene, lighting, film grain, damage repair, and color restoration; 4. Publishing suggestions: title length, tags, image ratio, and platform tone. Constraints: Do not replicate the original author, original people, or brand logos; do not fabricate historical facts; when real people's photos are involved, prioritize identity consistency, and do not make them younger, beautify, slim the face, or alter facial features.

cards.value: Off-white background, charcoal title text, terracotta orange accent color and radiating graphic

alts: Dark blue background + white text for a tech feel
Black background + fluorescent green for high contrast

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A person in a dark crew-neck top, positioned in about the lower-right third of the frame
cards.why: A clear face and smile are the strongest stop signals for a social cover, easier to click than a text-only cover.
alts: Replace with a silhouette or illustrated avatar
Keep only a hand holding a phone
Remove the person and use a product screenshot

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Restrained, professional, dry-insight sharing with a slight sense of urgency
cards.why: Clean typography plus the "no secret prompt" subtitle makes people believe the content is actionable and willing to save it instead of scrolling past.

spec: About 30 English characters, arranged in three lines
First two lines charcoal #2B2B2B, third line terracotta orange #C97A5C
Serif, size about 9% of frame height
Upper-middle left side of the frame
Two columns, left and right, nearly 1:1 equal width
Left column top to bottom: name line, divider, main title, subtitle
Right column is the portrait and radiating color block, cropped at the bottom
Noticeable gap kept between the right edge of the left text and the right column
#FAF7F2 off-white, taking up most of the frame
#C97A5C terracotta orange, used for the third title line and radiating graphic
#1F1F1F deep charcoal gray, appearing in the person's clothing area
A person in a dark crew-neck top, facing the camera
Half-body above the chest, within about 34% of the frame width on the right side
A terracotta orange radiating block behind them, partially obscured by the person
The person's lower edge is cropped by the bottom of the frame
Warm white background with low-saturation orange, overall soft
Even with no obvious shadows, the portrait's face is bright
The title uses a negated number, the subtitle emphasizes "no secrets, no magic, just systems"
Like a well-organized set of dry insights, lowering the reader's psychological barrier

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: 7 AI HABITS THAT 99% OF PEOPLE NEVER USE
cards.why: 用具体数字和权威职位制造信息差，让读者担心自己属于被落下的那 99%。
alts: 改成「7 个习惯」中文标题

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 左右二分布局：左侧文字块约占一半，右侧人物与放射形图形占另一半
cards.why: 左文右图的经典封面结构让文字有呼吸感，一眼分清「说什么」和「谁说的」。
alts: 上下二分：标题在上人物在下
三栏式：人像夹在文字中间

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 米白底、炭黑标题字、赤陶橙强调色与放射图形
cards.why: 低饱和暖色底配单一点缀色，信息层级分明且不刺眼，适合知识类封面长期复用。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 一位穿深色圆领上衣的人，位于画面右下约三分之一区域
cards.why: 清晰的人脸和微笑是社交封面最强的停留信号，比纯文字封面更易被点开。
alts: 去掉人像改放产品截图

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 克制、专业、略带紧迫感的干货分享感
cards.why: 干净排版加「无秘密提示词」的副标题让人相信内容可落地，愿意收藏而不是划走。

spec: 约 30 个英文字符，分三行排列
前两行炭黑 #2B2B2B，第三行赤陶橙 #C97A5C
衬线体，字号约占画面高 9%
左右两栏，接近 1:1 等宽
左栏自上而下：姓名行、分割线、主标题、副标题
右栏为人像与放射形色块，底部被裁切
左侧文字右缘与右栏之间保留明显空隙
#C97A5C 赤陶橙，用于第三行标题与放射图形
#1F1F1F 深炭灰，出现在人物衣物区域
一位穿深色圆领上衣的人，正面朝向镜头
胸部以上半身，位于画面右侧约 34% 宽度内
身后有赤陶橙放射形色块，部分被人物遮挡
人物下缘被画面底部裁切
暖白背景与低饱和橙色，整体柔和
均匀无明显阴影，人像面部明亮
标题使用否定式数字，副标题强调「无秘密、无魔法、只有系统」
像一份被整理好的干货，降低读者的心理门槛

sourcePrompt.en: Based on the reference cover's composition, visual metaphor, and WeChat thumbnail readability, generate a new horizontal WeChat public-account cover. Output size: 1456x582, ratio about 2.5:1; the core subject and essential title information must also work within WeChat's safe square crop. Public-account article title: {fill in the WeChat public-account article title} Intro: {fill in the intro} Original cover approach: Andrej Karpathy says 99% of AI users ignore 7 foundational points — I've broken them all down for you. Style dual-skill Create a horizontal WeChat public-account article cover, 2.35:1 aspect ratio, for an article titled "Andrej Karpathy says 99% of AI users ignore 7 foundational points — I've broken them all down for you.". Central concept: visualize abstract tool capabilities as interface windows, code snippets, node networks, control panels, AI workflows, or a glowing system core. Style: preserve the reference cover's visual direction: black-and-white or low-saturation editorial illustration/photo. Use a palette inspired by #ffffff (white), #8b513e (brown), #d7b0a1 (cream), #fffffe (white). Keep the image editorial, conceptual, and readable as a small WeChat thumbnail. Composition: lots of whitespace, suitable for a large title, a few icons, and a clear left-text/right-image or center-title layout. Keep the main subject and any essential title text inside the safe square crop, while using the full wide frame for atmosphere, secondary symbols, or directional motion. Text strategy: use either no text or a very short headline fragment from the title. If text is used, make it large, clean, and integrated into the layout rather than pasted on top. Mood: match the article skill "Andrej Karpathy says 99% of AI users… style dual-skill" -- useful, sharp, high-signal, and slightly more memorable than a normal tutorial thumbnail. Avoid: photorealistic clutter unless the source cover is photo-led, fake logos, unreadable tiny text, generic gradient blobs, stock-office imagery, watermark-like marks, and literal screenshots unless the article is explicitly about software interfaces.

cards.label: Hook
cards.why: A wordless threat plus a hiding victim triggers instant curiosity about what happens next.

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Single panel split by a diagonal partition: threatening figure left, hiding figure right.
cards.why: The diagonal divider forces the eye to bounce between the two subjects, building tension.

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Cool grays and muted blues against the ruddy metal and red shoes.
cards.why: The cold industrial tones make the warm red accents on the victim pop, signaling fear and focus.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: One small figure crouched behind a partition, one large mechanical figure approaching.
cards.why: The size contrast between the two subjects communicates powerlessness and danger instantly.

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Tense and sympathetic — fear of being found.
cards.why: The distressed expression and looming machine create an empathetic trap that makes viewers share the post.

spec: small crouching figure vs large approaching machine
one small figure crouched, hugging knees behind partition
trembling, tears on cheek, small hair clip
one tall mechanical figure holding a long object
flat indoor light from upper right

cards.label: 钩子
cards.why: 一个无言的威胁加上一个躲藏的受害者，会立即引发对接下来会发生什么的好奇。
alts: 添加‘躲藏还是战斗’提示

cards.label: 布局
cards.value: 单一面板被对角线分隔：左侧为威胁人物，右侧为躲藏人物。
cards.why: 对角线分隔迫使视线在两个主体之间来回跳动，营造紧张感。
alts: 上方/下方分割：躲藏/威胁

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 冷灰色和柔和蓝色，与暗红金属和红色鞋子形成对比。
cards.why: 冷峻的工业色调让受害者身上的暖红色点缀更突出，传达恐惧与专注。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 一个小人物蹲在隔板后，一个大型机械人物正在靠近。
cards.why: 两个主体之间的大小对比瞬间传达出无力感和危险。

cards.label: 情绪
cards.value: 紧张而令人同情——害怕被发现。
cards.why: 痛苦的表情和逼近的机器制造出共情陷阱，让观众愿意分享这条帖子。

spec: 小蹲伏人物 vs 大型逼近机器
带角度透视的垂直隔板
一个小人物蹲在隔板后抱膝
一个高大机械人物拿着长物体
来自右上方平淡的室内光
蹲伏人物痛苦，机器冷漠

sourcePrompt.en: Create a new [Meme Template] concept Title Turn Anime Girl Hiding from Terminator into a fresh social meme Subtitle Keep the classic visual rhythm, swap in a new punchline and audience insight. Creative direction: meme template Method: preserve the original template structure, conflict, eye-line, and reversal timing while replacing the situation with an English-language social insight. Please output: 1. A concise English title and subtitle for social posting; 2. 2-4 short English caption lines that can be placed directly on the meme; 3. A visual prompt for image generation or image editing, covering subject, composition, typography, stickers, and whitespace; 4. Posting advice: use case, hashtags, and engagement hook. Constraints: do not recreate a real person's identity, trademark, or watermark; do not claim source authorization; when keeping the source image, use it only as a composition reference.
sourcePrompt.zh-CN: 创建一个新的[梗图模板]概念 标题 将动漫女孩躲避终结者变为新鲜社交梗图 副标题 保留经典视觉节奏，换入新的笑点和受众洞察。创意方向：梗图模板 方法：保留原始模板结构、冲突、视线和反转时机，同时用英语社交洞察替换情境。请输出：1. 用于社交发布的简洁英文标题和副标题；2. 2-4条可直接放在梗图上的简短英文说明文字；3. 用于图像生成或图像编辑的视觉提示，涵盖主体、构图、排版、贴纸和留白；4. 发布建议：使用场景、话题标签和互动钩子。限制：不要重建真实人物的身份、商标或水印；不要声称获得来源授权；保留源图像时，仅将其用作构图参考。

cards.label: Hook
cards.why: The absence of text makes people curious about who he is looking at, creating the urge to click.
alts: Place a large text title in the blank upper-right area
Write a line of small handwritten text along the edge of the photo

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: One complete full illustration, with a small photo embedded slightly right of center, taking up about a quarter of the frame, and a large blank space in the upper right
cards.why: Large areas of blank space push the gaze toward the person and the photo, locking the focal point at a glance.
alts: Top and bottom panels: contrast between the person and the photo
Center the person and enlarge the photo to fill half the frame
Multiple photos scattered on a tabletop

cards.label: Color Palette
cards.value: Large white background, dark blue plaid shirt, with green grass and blue sky inside the photo
cards.why: The clean white background and crisp blue-green contrast make the warm yellow edge of the vintage photo instantly recognizable.
alts: Change the background to warm beige paper color
Adjust the whole image to deep brown old-photo tones

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A person with short dark hair seen from a side-back view, wearing a plaid shirt, holding up a photo with yellowed edges with both hands
cards.why: The action of holding up the photo presents the "story" directly to the viewer, making it easiest to identify with.
alts: Replace with a single hand holding the photo
Place two photos side by side for comparison
Two people each holding a photo

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Quiet, nostalgic, restrained sense of longing, with soft lighting and no strong shadows
cards.why: A gentle emotion makes people willing to linger, and also makes them more likely to save and share.
alts: Add grain and noise for an aged feel
Change to a cold rainy-night tone
Backlit warm tone for more tenderness

spec: Large blank space in the upper right
Create suspense through the action and the photo itself
Soft and even, with no obvious strong shadows

cards.label: 钩子
cards.why: 没有文字反而让人好奇他在看谁，产生点开的冲动。
alts: 右上空白处压一行大字标题
照片边缘写一行手写小字
加一句第一人称内心独白

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 整幅一幅完整插画，中部偏右嵌一张小照片，约占画面四分之一，右上方留大片空白
cards.why: 大片留白把视线挤向人物和照片，焦点一眼就锁定。
alts: 上下两格：人物与照片对照
人物居中、照片放大占半幅

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 大面积白底，深蓝格纹衬衫，照片内是绿色草地与蓝天
cards.why: 白底干净、蓝绿对比清爽，复古照片的暖黄边一眼可辨。
alts: 整体调成深褐老照片色

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 一个深色短发人物侧后视角，穿格纹衬衫，双手举着一张泛黄边的照片
cards.why: 举照片这个动作把“故事”递到观众眼前，最容易引发代入。
alts: 换成一只手单独拿照片

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 安静、怀旧、克制的思念感，光线柔和没有强烈阴影
cards.why: 轻柔的情绪让人愿意停留，也更容易被收藏转发。

spec: 靠动作与照片本身制造悬念
柔和均匀，无明显强阴影

sourcePrompt.en: Referencing the old photo restoration approach, vintage texture, visual storytelling, and publishing tone of the case study "Anime 'Old Photos'", generate a new set of retro old-photo image-text content. New theme: {fill in the photo theme you want to restore, rebuild, or recreate} Reference platform: Xiaohongshu Content direction: retro old-photo image-text Creation method: retain the nostalgic emotion, film/photo-paper texture, character relationships, era atmosphere of the scene, and restoration constraints of the original case; if it is photo restoration, it must stay faithful to the original image's identity, facial features, composition, and historical context, avoiding excessive beautification, redrawing, false historical information, and a modern digital plastic look. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. A 6-9 page image-text script, with each page containing a visual description, main copy, era/texture keywords, and a save prompt; 3. Visual prompts that can be used directly for image generation or photo restoration, explaining requirements for characters, scene, lighting, film grain, damage repair, and color restoration; 4. Publishing suggestions: title length, tags, image ratio, and platform tone. Constraints: do not replicate the original author, original people, or brand logos; do not fabricate historical facts; when real people's photos are involved, prioritize identity consistency, and do not make them younger, beautify, slim the face, or alter facial features.
sourcePrompt.zh-CN: 参考案例《动漫《老照片》》的老照片修复方式、年代质感、画面叙事和发布语气，生成一组新的复古老照片图文。 新主题：{填写你要修复、重建或复刻的照片主题} 参考平台：小红书 内容方向：复古老照片图文 创作方法：保留原案例的怀旧情绪、胶片/相纸质感、人物关系、场景年代感和修复约束；如果是照片修复，必须忠于原图身份、五官、构图和历史语境，避免过度美颜、重绘、虚假历史信息和现代数码塑料感。 请输出： 1. 封面标题与副标题； 2. 6-9 页图文脚本，每页包含画面描述、主文案、年代/质感关键词和收藏引导； 3. 可直接用于图像生成或照片修复的视觉提示词，说明人物、场景、光线、胶片颗粒、破损修复和色彩还原要求； 4. 发布建议：标题长度、标签、图片比例和平台语气。 约束：不要复刻原作者、原人物或品牌标识；不要编造历史事实；涉及真实人物照片时优先保留身份一致性，不做年轻化、美颜、瘦脸或五官改写。

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: 葵S
cards.why: A single giant brush-stroke character blocks the left half and forces the eye to lock on the title before anything else.

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: One wide single-panel banner; heavy text block left, photo of horse and rider right, thin vertical text strip far right.
cards.why: The left-to-right weight shift makes a wide cover readable as a poster and a title card at once.

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Deep electric blue ground, white display type, gold and amber brush accents, warm brown horse.
cards.why: Blue-to-gold contrast reads as premium sport and makes white type glow against a dark field.
alts: Black and white with one accent

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A dark-coated horse with blinkers and a rider in a blue and white silks and blue helmet, seen at speed.
cards.why: The horse occupies the right third head-on, so the living subject carries the motion while type carries the message.

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Intense, high-speed, competitive, with glowing particles and streaks suggesting a night race.
cards.why: Energy particles and cold blue light create urgency that suits an announcement or a big-match post.

spec: calligraphic white brush strokes with glow
one horse with blinkers, one rider in blue and white silks
moving toward the viewer, slightly left
cold blue rim light with glowing specks

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: 葵S
cards.why: 一个巨大的毛笔字占据左半边，迫使视线在注意其他任何东西之前先锁定标题。

cards.label: 布局
cards.value: 一张宽幅单面板横幅；左侧是厚重文字块，右侧是马与骑手的照片，最右侧是细长的竖排文字条。
cards.why: 从左到右的视觉重心转移，让宽封面既能作为海报阅读，又能当作标题卡。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 深电光蓝底、白色标题字、金色与琥珀色笔触点缀、暖棕色马匹。
cards.why: 蓝到金的对比带来高端运动感，让白色字体在深色背景上发光。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 一匹深色马匹戴着遮眼罩，骑手身穿蓝白赛马服、戴蓝色头盔，高速行进中。
cards.why: 马以正面姿态占据右侧三分之一，让活的主体承载动感，而文字承载信息。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 激烈、高速、竞技感，发光粒子与光痕暗示夜间比赛。
cards.why: 能量粒子与冷蓝光线营造紧迫感，适合公告或大赛帖文。

暖棕 #6B3A1E 与蓝色赛马服
一匹戴遮眼罩的马，一位穿蓝白赛马服的骑手
冷蓝轮廓光与发光微粒
颗粒感粒子与火花轨迹

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Warm gray and off-white main tones, pale gold sky, cool gray concrete, house in light white
cards.why: Restrained low saturation feels rational and premium, suitable for discussing assets and prices.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: Back view of a family of three on the left looking up at the steps, with a detached house at the top
cards.why: The family's upward gaze turns housing-price anxiety into a relatable image.

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Calm, looking up, with a morning feel of slight pressure and hope
cards.why: A gentle emotion rather than agitation makes readers more willing to finish the analysis rationally.

cards.label: 钩子
cards.why: 让读者立刻想知道：这么高的房子到底谁买得起。

cards.label: 配色

cards.why: 情绪温和不煽动，反而让读者愿意理性看完分析。

cards.label: Hook
cards.why: The image has not a single word, relying entirely on an instantly recognizable old living room scene to pin people down, making them want to place themselves in their own childhood.
alts: Use a big title overlaid on the TV screen

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Single full image, no panels; child sits at the bottom center, TV and wooden cabinet in the upper middle slightly left, bright door/window on the right.
cards.why: A single scene seen at a glance, without collage, feels more like a frame from memory, making it easier to stop when scrolling.
alts: Split into two panels for then-and-now comparison
One panel on the left with a close-up of an old object

cards.label: Color Palette
cards.value: Overall faded warm tones, beige walls and sheer curtains, light wood floor occupy a large area, floral sofa on the left brings patches of red and pink.
cards.why: The grayish warm tones look washed by time, directly giving the credibility of an old photo and making people willing to save it.
alts: High-saturation Hong Kong style red and green
Black and white with a single warm color

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A child sitting on a bamboo mat on the floor, a TV on a wooden cabinet in front is on, next to it a standing fan, a red thermos, and a plate of watermelon.
cards.why: The seated posture with back to the camera lets viewers automatically put themselves in that position, while the objects speak of the era for the person.
alts: Replace with an adult facing away from the camera
Only shoot the lit old TV
Shoot an empty old living room

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Quiet, life-like nostalgia, soft indoor lighting, like stretched-out old times.
cards.why: This relaxed everyday feel reminds people of their own living room, and the comments section naturally becomes a collective memory.
alts: A cold and lonely empty room

用大标题压在电视画面上

sourcePrompt.en: Refer to the old photo restoration method, vintage texture, visual storytelling, and publishing tone of the case study "Back to the Past" to generate a new set of retro old photo posts. New theme: {fill in the photo theme you want to restore, rebuild, or replicate} Reference platform: Xiaohongshu Content direction: Retro old photo posts Creation method: Retain the nostalgic emotion, film/photo paper texture, character relationships, era atmosphere of the scene, and restoration constraints from the original case; if it is photo restoration, it must be faithful to the original identity, facial features, composition, and historical context, avoiding excessive beautification, redrawing, false historical information, and modern digital plastic feel. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. 6-9 page visual script, each page including scene description, main copy, era/texture keywords, and save guide; 3. Visual prompts that can be directly used for image generation or photo restoration, explaining requirements for characters, scene, lighting, film grain, damage repair, and color restoration; 4. Publishing suggestions: title length, tags, image ratio, and platform tone. Constraints: Do not replicate the original author, original characters, or brand logos; do not fabricate historical facts; when involving real people's photos, prioritize identity consistency, and do not do rejuvenation, beautification, face slimming, or facial feature rewriting.
sourcePrompt.zh-CN: 参考案例《回到过去》的老照片修复方式、年代质感、画面叙事和发布语气，生成一组新的复古老照片图文。 新主题：{填写你要修复、重建或复刻的照片主题} 参考平台：小红书 内容方向：复古老照片图文 创作方法：保留原案例的怀旧情绪、胶片/相纸质感、人物关系、场景年代感和修复约束；如果是照片修复，必须忠于原图身份、五官、构图和历史语境，避免过度美颜、重绘、虚假历史信息和现代数码塑料感。 请输出： 1. 封面标题与副标题； 2. 6-9 页图文脚本，每页包含画面描述、主文案、年代/质感关键词和收藏引导； 3. 可直接用于图像生成或照片修复的视觉提示词，说明人物、场景、光线、胶片颗粒、破损修复和色彩还原要求； 4. 发布建议：标题长度、标签、图片比例和平台语气。 约束：不要复刻原作者、原人物或品牌标识；不要编造历史事实；涉及真实人物照片时优先保留身份一致性，不做年轻化、美颜、瘦脸或五官改写。

sourcePrompt.en: Based on the reference cover's composition, visual metaphor, and readability as a WeChat public-account thumbnail, generate a new horizontal WeChat public-account cover. Output size: 1456x582, ratio about 2.5:1; the core subject and essential title information should also work within WeChat's safe square crop. WeChat article title: {enter WeChat article title} Intro: {enter intro} Original cover approach: BackpackSecurities: Building a More Compliant, More Professional All-Round US Stock Trading Platform style dual-skill Create a horizontal WeChat public-account article cover, 2.35:1 aspect ratio, for an article titled "Backpack Securities: Building a More Compliant, More Professional All-Round US Stock Trading Platform". Central concept: visualize market judgment as charts, asset symbols, trading panels, risk gauges, and directional signals. Style: preserve the reference cover's visual direction: black-and-white or low-saturation editorial illustration/photo. Use a palette inspired by #f9f9f9 (white), #545455 (brown), #fefefe (white), #c3c3c3 (cream). Keep the image editorial, conceptual, and readable as a small WeChat thumbnail. Composition: lots of negative space, suitable for a large headline, a few icons, and a clear left-text/right-image or centered-title layout. Keep the main subject and any essential title text inside the safe square crop, while using the full wide frame for atmosphere, secondary symbols, or directional motion. Text strategy: use either no text or a very short headline fragment from the title. If text is used, make it large, clean, and integrated into the layout rather than pasted on top. Mood: match the article skill "BackpackSecurities打造更合…风格双技能" -- useful, sharp, high-signal, and slightly more memorable than a normal tutorial thumbnail. Avoid: photorealistic clutter unless the source cover is photo-led, fake logos, unreadable tiny text, generic gradient blobs, stock-office imagery, watermark-like marks, and literal screenshots unless the article is explicitly about software interfaces.

Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. A 6-9 page image-text script, each page including a visual description, main copy, era/texture keywords, and a save prompt; 3. cards.label: Hook
cards.value: Hello,这是一期很正式的涂鸦教程

Use a question: 'How do you all shoot yours?'

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: The whole image has no grid; text is arranged in three sections: a two-line title centered at the top, a section heading slightly left of center, and a left-aligned body paragraph
cards.why: The three-part whitespace feels like a page from a notebook, easy to read, and your finger wants to keep scrolling.
alts: Enlarge the title to take up half the screen

cards.label: Color palette
cards.value: A large area of off-white background fills the whole image, with no second large-area color; only the text itself is dark
cards.why: A clean background makes handwritten text most eye-catching, and while scrolling you instantly recognize it as save-worthy notes.
alts: Switch to a light beige paper color
Change to pure white background with thin grid lines

cards.label: Subject

cards.why: Writing the experience directly as text feels as trustworthy as a journal, and viewers can screenshot and keep it.
alts: Switch to hand-drawn small illustrations with text
Stitch photos of the equipment into the image

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: A casual handwritten journal mood, like a friend jotting down experience sharing
cards.why: Low pressure and non-ad-like, making people let their guard down and more willing to finish watching and save it.
alts: Make it a formal tutorial document style
Change to a chat screenshot tone
Add a bit of sticker-style decoration

cards.why: 满屏不留白让画面像绘本封面，大字号标题在小红书缩略图里依然清晰可读。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 灰绿草地配奶油白背景，橙色帽子围巾作点缀

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 温暖安静的清晨草地质感，手绘柔和笔触
cards.why: 舒缓无压力的画面降低家长焦虑，让人愿意收藏给孩子睡前反复看。

sourcePrompt.en: Referencing the information breakdown, visual metaphors, and one-image-explains-all structure of the illustrated post "Bedtime Story|Picture Book Story|The Little Duck Who Goes to Bed on Time," generate a new set of Xiaohongshu knowledge-popularization themes: title "A Life Common Sense That Has Been Misunderstood for a Long Time," subtitle "Explain it clearly with one image, perfect for saving and sharing." Please output a cover hook, 6-8 content cards, the core knowledge point of each page, visual elements, and a colloquial explanation. Be accurate in expression and avoid exaggeration.

cards.label: Hook
cards.why: The image has no text, relying on the cute child's chewing motion to make people stop first and create a sense of immersion.
alts: Use white space with a gentle short line

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: A single horizontal illustration, child centered slightly above, table occupying the lower third, large white space on both sides.
cards.why: Large areas of white space make the subject stand out more, keeping the viewer's gaze undisturbed, suitable for a cover or article header image.
alts: Person on the left, text on the right

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Off-white background, light brown table and hair, gray-green bib, pale pink rice bowl and cheek blush.
cards.why: The low-saturation warm palette feels soft, harmless, and healing, matching the gentle tone of parenting topics.
alts: Switch to cream yellow and milk tea colors

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A child sitting at the table, holding a spoon with both hands, with a bowl and small plate in front, blushing cheeks and upturned mouth.
cards.why: The specific yet cute eating scene makes parents immediately think of their own child and feel "this is about me."
alts: Change to an adult tasting scene
Show only the table and utensils
Switch to parent and child in the same frame

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Warm, quiet, everyday feel with a touch of cuteness.
cards.why: The relaxed, non-anxious tone makes readers willing to keep reading rather than being put off by a preachy feel.
alts: Change to a funny exaggerated expression

spec: Holding a spoon with both hands
A bowl and a small plate

cards.label: 钩子
cards.why: 画面不含文字，靠萌态孩童的咀嚼动作先让人停留，制造代入感。

cards.label: 配色

cards.value: 一个坐在桌前的孩童，双手拿勺，面前有碗和碟，脸带腮红、嘴角上扬。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 温暖、安静、带一点憨态的日常感。
cards.why: 轻松不焦虑的基调让读者愿意继续读下去，而不是被说教感劝退。

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: 适合新手的 快手菜
cards.why: Directly calls out "beginner" and "quick," lowering the difficulty threshold for cooking to the minimum so people instantly feel "I can do this too."
alts: Rice-Serving Dishes Beginners Can Make Too
Home Dishes with No Repeats for Three Days
Quick Dishes Done in Ten Minutes

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Nine white bowls arranged in three rows and three columns, uniform in size and filling the frame, with only narrow gaps between the bowls
cards.why: A neat nine-grid makes the number of dishes clear at a glance; swiping the first image shows how rich the content is, making it easy to save.
alts: Two rows, three columns of large images

cards.label: Color Palette
cards.value: White porcelain bowls and a wood-toned tabletop dominate; the dishes show large areas of sauce red and fresh green
cards.why: The white bowls frame the messy dish colors, the red and green contrast looks steaming hot, and the wood-toned base keeps the image from looking dirty.
alts: Dark wood table with warm light

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: Nine white bowls holding different home-style dishes, filling the frame
cards.why: Every plate is a familiar rice-serving dish, so viewers automatically picture themselves and want to save whichever bowl they want to learn.
alts: Add a pair of chopsticks in the foreground

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Homey warmth under warm light, abundant and appetizing
cards.why: The homey feel relaxes people and makes it seem replicable, while the abundance stimulates appetite, creating the urge to "save first and think later."

spec: 适合新手的 快手菜
Horizontally centered in the middle of the image, pressed between the first row of bowls and the second row of bowls
Takes up almost the entire image width horizontally

xray.short: White bowls, wood table, warm tone
spec: #A93A22 sauce red as the main tone, with green interspersed
Warm tone, white porcelain and wood tones complementing each other
Red-yellow contrasting colors make the image livelier

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: 适合新手的 快手菜
cards.why: 直接点名“新手”和“快手”，把做菜的难度门槛降到最低，让人一眼觉得“我也能做”。

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 九个白碗排成三行三列，大小一致铺满，碗边只留窄缝
cards.why: 整齐的九宫格让菜品数量一目了然，滑动第一张就知道内容有多丰富，容易收藏。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 白瓷碗与木色桌面为主，菜品呈大面积酱红与青绿
cards.why: 白碗把杂乱的菜色框住，红绿相间显得热腾腾，木色底又压住画面不脏。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 九个白碗盛着不同的家常菜，铺满画面
cards.why: 一盘盘都是熟悉的下饭菜，看的人会自动对号入座，想学哪碗就存哪碗。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 暖光下的家常烟火气，丰盛又有食欲
cards.why: 家常感让人放松、觉得可复制，丰盛感又刺激食欲，形成“先收藏再说”的冲动。

spec: 适合新手的 快手菜
画面中部横向居中，压在第一行碗与第二行碗之间
横向几乎占满画面宽度
红黄撞色让画面更热闹

sourcePrompt.en: Refer to the content structure, cover hook, visual rhythm, and publishing tone of the case study "Beginner-Friendly Home Quick Dish Collection‼️Easy to Make and Delicious" to generate a new set of viral image-text posts. New topic: {填写你要生成的主题} Reference platform: Xiaohongshu Content direction: Food and lifestyle image-text Creation method: Keep the original case's sensory descriptions, scene sense, and action guidance, highlighting differences in method, taste, price, or experience. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. 6-8 page image-text script, each page including visual description, main copy, information points, and interaction/save actions; 3. Visual prompts ready for image generation, specifying subject, scene, lighting, composition, font, or layout; 4. Publishing suggestions: title length, tags, image ratio, and platform tone. Constraints: Do not replicate the original author, original characters, or brand logos; do not fabricate data; avoid promising results when it involves health, mysticism, investment, or educational outcomes.

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: ← look at all the things I did
cards.why: The anthropomorphic little robot's self-deprecating dialogue gives the technical flowchart an emotional anchor and lowers the barrier to reading.

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Single horizontal flowchart with left, center, and right zones
cards.why: A single main line runs across the full width, so the eye naturally sweeps from left to right, which suits cover whitespace.

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Light gray background with bright yellow dashed line, black-and-white text accents
cards.why: The high-contrast yellow line is extremely eye-catching on the gray background, like a highlighted key point.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: Square little robot with a speech bubble
cards.why: The cute character turns an abstract process into a narrator with personality, making it easy to remember.
alts: Replace with a small animal character

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Relaxed teaching feel, clean and rational
cards.why: The low-saturation background plus playful character makes technical basics feel unintimidating.

spec: ← look at all the things I did
Inside the white speech bubble at the upper right of the image
The REQUEST node on the left extends rightward to the robot
EMBED / RERANK above, GENERATE / ANSWER below
#FFFFFF white squares and light pink cheeks
White rounded-square body, two round eyes, a smiling curve
A small yellow round antenna on top of the head, white speech bubble above
Right side of the image, facing the flowchart line on the left
Cool gray background with warm yellow lines

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: ← look at all the things I did
cards.why: 拟人小机器人的自嘲式对白让技术流程图有情绪落点，降低阅读门槛。
alts: 改成第一人称经验分享

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 单幅横向流程图，左中右三区分布
cards.why: 一条主线贯穿全幅，视线自然从左向右扫完，适合封面留白。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 浅灰底配亮黄虚线，黑白文字点缀
cards.why: 高对比黄线在灰底上极醒目，像被高亮标记的重点。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 戴对话框的方形小机器人
cards.why: 可爱角色把抽象流程变成有人味的讲解者，方便记忆。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 轻松教学感，干净理性
cards.why: 低饱和背景加俏皮角色，让人觉得技术入门不吓人。

sourcePrompt.en: Based on the reference cover's composition, visual metaphor, and readability as a WeChat public-account thumbnail, generate a new horizontal WeChat public-account cover. Output size: 1456x582, ratio about 2.5:1; the core subject and necessary title information should also work within WeChat's safe square crop. WeChat article title: {fill in the WeChat article title} Summary: {fill in the summary} Original cover method: BorisCherny: After ClaudeCode, programming is evolving into "managing Agents" style dual skill Create a horizontal WeChat public-account article cover, 2.35:1 aspect ratio, for an article titled "Boris Cherny: After Claude Code, Programming Is Evolving into 'Managing Agents'". Central concept: visualize abstract tool capabilities as interface windows, code snippets, node networks, control panels, AI workflows, or a glowing system core. Style: preserve the reference cover's visual direction: black-and-white or low-saturation editorial illustration/photo. Use a palette inspired by #63544d (brown), #fef6e9 (white), #fcf6ea (white), #bdab9e (gray). Keep the image editorial, conceptual, and readable as a small WeChat thumbnail. Composition: the image has a high information density, suitable for a central subject plus left and right supporting information, keeping the thumbnail readable. Keep the main subject and any essential title text inside the safe square crop, while using the full wide frame for atmosphere, secondary symbols, or directional motion. Text strategy: use either no text or a very short headline fragment from the title. If text is used, make it large, clean, and integrated into the layout rather than pasted on top. Mood: match the article skill "BorisChernyAfterClaudeCode…style dual skill" -- useful, sharp, high-signal, and slightly more memorable than a normal tutorial thumbnail. Avoid: photorealistic clutter unless the source cover is photo-led, fake logos, unreadable tiny text, generic gradient blobs, stock-office imagery, watermark-like marks, and literal screenshots unless the article is explicitly about software interfaces.

cards.label: Hook
cards.why: When there is no text, the exaggerated expression and exploding light spots are the only hook, making people want to click and see what it is at a glance.
alts: Add a large text title over the character
Replace the explosion with a short copy line
Change it to two characters colliding

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Single borderless illustration, character toward the upper right, round planet in the lower-left corner, stars of various sizes scattered around
cards.why: Elements are distributed along the diagonal, guiding the eye from the planet explosion all the way to the character, with whitespace that is not empty and information visible at a glance.
alts: Split into two sections top and bottom
Leave whitespace in the middle with text

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Large dark blue base, white character and yellow stars for brightness, green, orange, and blue color blocks on the planet
cards.why: The dark blue base makes white and yellow pop, and it is bright enough in the feed even as a small image; it looks clean and comfortable at a glance.
alts: Purple base with white and yellow
Off-white base with blue and orange

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A white cloud-like character, mouth open showing a red mouth area, speed lines beside it, dashing toward the upper left
cards.why: The soft cute design plus dashing motion is both healing and energetic, and it is easy to save as an avatar.
alts: Change to a round-faced little person

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Bright flat-color cartoon universe, saturated colors, light and excited emotion
cards.why: The relaxed and pleasant look lifts the mood, matching the psychology of changing an avatar to seek good luck.

spec: No readable characters in the whole image
Relies on the character's expression and explosion sparks to catch the eye

xray.short: Dark blue base with white and yellow highlights
spec: Dark blue covers most of the image
Green, orange, and blue color blocks

cards.label: 钩子
cards.why: 没有文字时，夸张的表情和爆炸光点就是唯一抓手，让人一眼想点开看是什么。
alts: 用一句短文案替代爆炸

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 单幅无边框插画，角色偏右上，圆形星球占左下角，四周散布大小星形
cards.why: 元素沿对角线分布，视线被从星球爆炸一路带到角色，留白不空、信息一眼看完。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 深蓝大面积打底，白色角色与黄色星形提亮，星球上出现绿橙蓝三色块
cards.why: 深蓝底让白和黄跳出来，小图在信息流里也够亮，一看就干净舒服。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 一个白色云朵状角色，张嘴露出红色口部，身旁带速度线，朝左上方向冲
cards.why: 软萌造型加上冲刺动态，既治愈又有能量感，容易被当成头像保存。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 明亮平涂的卡通宇宙，色彩饱和、情绪轻快兴奋
cards.why: 轻松愉快的观感让人心情变好，符合换头像求好运的使用心理。

spec: 靠角色表情与爆炸火花抓眼

sourcePrompt.en: Referring to the content structure, first-image hook, visual rhythm, and posting tone of the case study "Bouncy Bunny High-Energy Aura Avatar🔥", generate a new set of viral image-text posts. New topic: {fill in the topic you want to generate} Reference platform: Douyin Content direction: metaphysical energy image-text Creation method: keep the original case's emotional soothing, ritual feel, and save motivation; avoid promising results in expression, and write the content as spiritual support and action reminders. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. 6-8 page image-text script, each page including visual description, main copy, information points, and interaction/save actions; 3. Visual prompts ready for image generation, explaining subject, scene, lighting, composition, fonts, or layout; 4. Posting suggestions: title length, tags, image ratio, and platform tone. Constraints: do not replicate the original author, original character, or brand logos; do not fabricate data; avoid promising effects when health, metaphysics, investment, or educational outcomes are involved.

Show the object held in a hand

cards.label: 主体

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: Quiet, even, playful: a still-life that smiles back at you.
cards.why: The gentle humour plus calm light makes the post feel shareable rather than salesy.

cards.label: 钩子
cards.why: 它依靠物体本身来阻止滑动，所以惊喜是产品，而不是一行文案。

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 一个物体居中放在干净的背景上，画面中没有其他东西。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 无缝白色背景，浅紫色石头主体和深紫色纹理。
cards.why: 白色上的柔和紫色读起来平静且值得收藏，在快速信息流中也很悦目。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 一块长方形紫色石头直立着，磨损处带有玫瑰金线框，框住两只圆形深色眼睛。
cards.why: 给一块普通水晶一张脸，就把矿物变成了人们想要保存的角色。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 安静、均匀、俏皮：一幅对你微笑的静物。
cards.why: 温和的幽默加上平静的光线，让帖子感觉可分享而不是推销。

cards.label: Hook
cards.why: A wordless side-by-side contrast is instantly readable, so it stops the scroll without needing a language match.
alts: Add two labels above each dog
Add a punchline line at the bottom

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: 2 separate cut-out figures side by side on blank white: muscular dog left, small seated dog right
cards.why: The empty diagonal band between them makes the size gap the whole story, giving the eye one clean left-to-right read.
alts: Split screen with a centre divider

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Plain white ground with the dogs' tan, cream and warm brown fur tones
cards.why: The flat white background isolates the two figures and lets the template be re-captioned with any text colour.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A muscular human-bodied dog on the left; a small seated dog with a blue mark under its eye on the right
cards.why: The exaggerated strong-versus-weak body language is a visual shorthand anyone can map onto their own two options.
alts: Two humans in the same poses
One dog split into two versions

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Deadpan comic contrast: absurd confidence on one side, pitiful resignation on the other
cards.why: The straight-faced mismatch of triumph and defeat is what people save to reuse for their own before-and-after jokes.

spec: the two figures act as the hook
wide empty white band down the middle
faint blue mark under the right dog's eye
high contrast against the white ground
one dog rendered with a broad muscular human torso and arms
one small dog seated on its haunches
cut-out photographic fur pasted on white

cards.label: 钩子
cards.why: 无需文字并排对比就能瞬间读懂，因此即使语言不通也能让人停下滚动。
alts: 添加一行简短顶部配文
在每只狗上方添加两个标签

cards.label: 布局
cards.value: 空白白色背景上并排的两个独立抠图形象：左侧肌肉狗，右侧坐着的小狗
cards.why: 两者之间空出的对角区域让体型差距成为整个故事，使视线从左到右清晰阅读。
alts: 3 个面板并带有中间节奏

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 纯白地面，以及狗的黄褐、奶油和暖棕色毛发色调
cards.why: 纯白背景隔离了两个形象，并让模板可以用任何文字颜色重新配文。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 左侧是一只拥有肌肉人身体的狗；右侧是一只眼下有蓝色标记的小坐狗
cards.why: 夸张的强弱肢体语言是一种视觉速记，任何人都能映射到自己的两个选项上。
alts: 两个人类摆出相同姿势

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 冷面喜剧对比：一边是荒诞的自信，另一边是可怜的认命
cards.why: 胜利与失败面无表情的错位感，正是人们保存并用来套用自己前后对比笑话的原因。

spec: 2 个独立抠图形象，无边框
中间有宽阔的空白白色带
黄褐和奶油色，大约 #D8B98A 到 #E8D6B8
右侧狗眼下的淡蓝色标记
与白色地面形成高对比
一只狗被渲染成宽阔肌肉发达的人类躯干和手臂
摄影毛发抠图粘贴在白色背景上

sourcePrompt.en: Create a new [Meme Template] concept Title Turn Buff Doge vs Cheems into a fresh social meme Subtitle Keep the classic visual rhythm, swap in a new punchline and audience insight. Creative direction: meme template Method: preserve the original template structure, conflict, eye-line, and reversal timing while replacing the situation with an English-language social insight. Please output: 1. A concise English title and subtitle for social posting; 2. 2-4 short English caption lines that can be placed directly on the meme; 3. A visual prompt for image generation or image editing, covering subject, composition, typography, stickers, and whitespace; 4. Posting advice: use case, hashtags, and engagement hook. Constraints: do not recreate a real person's identity, trademark, or watermark; do not claim source authorization; when keeping the source image, use it only as a composition reference.
sourcePrompt.zh-CN: 创建一个新的[表情包模板]概念 标题 把肌肉柴犬 vs 废柴柴犬变成一个新的社交表情包 副标题 保留经典的视觉节奏，替换成新的笑点和受众洞察。创作方向：表情包模板 方法：保留原模板的结构、冲突、视线和反转时机，同时把情境替换为英语社交洞察。请输出：1. 用于社交发布的简洁英文标题和副标题；2. 2-4 行可直接放在表情包上的简短英文配文；3. 用于图像生成或图像编辑的视觉提示，涵盖主体、构图、排版、贴纸和留白；4. 发布建议：使用场景、话题标签和互动钩子。限制：不要重现真实人物的身份、商标或水印；不要声称来源授权；在保留原图时，仅将其用作构图参考。

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: Gemini Live API
cards.why: The product name sits directly on the lower third of the image and is the largest text in the whole image, so readers instantly know what it's about; technical readers will immediately judge whether it's relevant to them.
alts: Switch to a Chinese question sentence

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Single full-screen image, axis-symmetric with the logo centered slightly above and the title centered slightly below
cards.why: There's only one focal point and one line of text, with no extra elements, so when scrolling it actually stands out more than covers crammed with information.

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Radial gradient from deep blue to black, with one bright blue glow; text and icons are pure white
cards.why: A dark background with bright blue is the default tech feel for AI products; white text has extremely high contrast and looks clean and professional in the feed.
alts: Pure black background with cyan-green glow
Light gray background with tech blue

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A glowing white microphone icon, a four-point star at the upper right, and several concentric arcs behind it
cards.why: The microphone points directly to voice interaction, the star implies intelligence, and the concentric rings look like sound waves; three strokes make the product capability clear.
alts: Change the icon to a chip

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Calm, cool-toned, precise tech night feel
cards.why: The low-saturation dark scene makes people hold their breath, suitable for carrying the credible tone of an "official release" or "developer documentation."

spec: Lower part of the image, horizontally centered
Small text at the top: ai.studio/live
Vertical center axis, icon above and text below
About 30% white space on each side
Top small text + center icon + bottom title
Rounded-rectangle body + U-shaped arm + vertical base line
Several concentric arcs, like spreading sound waves
Soft radial light from the center outward
White text on dark background, strong contrast

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: Gemini Live API
cards.why: 产品名直接压在画面下三分之一，是整张图最大的字，一眼就知道这篇讲什么，技术读者会立刻判断是否与己相关。

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 单幅满屏图，徽标居中偏上、标题居中偏下的中轴对称
cards.why: 信息只有一个焦点加一行字，没有多余元素，滑动时反而比信息堆叠的封面更显眼。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 深蓝到黑的径向渐变，配一处亮蓝辉光，文字与图标为纯白
cards.why: 深色底加高亮蓝是 AI 产品默认的科技感语言，白字对比度极高，在信息流里显得干净专业。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 发光的白色麦克风图标，右上一颗四角星，背后几圈同心弧线
cards.why: 麦克风直接指向语音交互，星号暗示智能，同心圈像声波，三笔就把产品能力讲清楚了。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 沉静、冷调、精密的技术夜感
cards.why: 低饱和暗场让人屏息，适合承载“官方发布”“开发者文档”式的可信语气。

spec: 垂直中轴，图标在上文字在下
顶部小字＋中心图标＋底部标题
圆角矩形主体＋U 形支臂＋底座竖线
数条同心弧线，如声波扩散
中心向外的柔和径向光
冷静、克制的官方发布感

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: Now you can automate your content efficiently
cards.why: Directly points out the payoff of "automated content," uses second person to create immersion, and makes people immediately want to read on for the method.
alts: You can automatically produce content right now
Your content can run on autopilot

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: A single horizontal image, one line of handwriting at the top, and five icons arranged horizontally in the center connected into a formula with plus signs and an equals sign
cards.why: The formulaic horizontal reading path feels like solving a problem; the eyes naturally move left to right, so comprehension cost is extremely low.
alts: Two columns with image on left, text on right
Large center text with icons at the bottom

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Off-white paper surface with black text, orange-red accents, and only the X icon on a pure black background
cards.why: A low-saturation papery base plus a touch of orange is crisp without stealing attention, and the black X becomes the only visual anchor.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: An equation composed of an orange radial graphic, an X icon, a 2-3 hours rounded block, a notebook icon, and +100M views
cards.why: Turns an abstract process into a countable addition equation, with the result made concrete as +100M views, which is credible and enticing.
alts: One person, one computer, plus data

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: A relaxed handwritten-notes feel, like a friend working out a money-making formula for you on graph paper
cards.why: Hand-drawn elements reduce the seriousness of a tutorial and make people willing to save it as a template to follow.

spec: Now you can automate your content efficiently
Upper left, two lines, about 45% width
Rounded handwriting, black, with a thin rounded outline box
Three orange rays on the right
One title line at the top, five elements in a horizontal row below
Title about 20% height, formula area about 45% height, about 3% margin on each side

xray.short: Paper white plus orange and black

spec: White background black text 2-3 hours rounded rectangle
Notebook icon with metal spiral binding, with this article written inside
Black +100M views handwritten bold, with three orange rays at the upper right
Even flat light, no strong shadows

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: Now you can automate your content efficiently
cards.why: 直接点出「自动化内容」的收益，用第二人称制造代入感，让人立刻想往下看方法。
alts: 现在就能自动产出内容

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 单幅横版图，上方一行动手写字，中央横向排列五个图标用加号与等号串成公式
cards.why: 公式化的横向阅读路径像解题，眼睛从左到右自然走完，理解成本极低。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 米白纸面配黑字，橙红点缀，仅 X 图标为纯黑底色
cards.why: 低饱和纸感底加一点橙，清爽又不抢眼，黑色 X 形成唯一视觉锚点。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 一条由橙色放射图形、X 图标、2-3 hours 圆角块、笔记本图标与 +100M views 组成的等式
cards.why: 把抽象流程变成可数的加法等式，结果具体到 +100M views，可信又诱人。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 轻松手写笔记感，像朋友在方格纸上给你演算一个赚钱公式
cards.why: 手绘元素降低教程的严肃感，让人愿意收藏当作模板照做。

spec: Now you can automate your content efficiently
圆润手写体，黑色，外围细圆角描边框
顶部一行标题，下方五元素横向一字排开
标题约高 20%，公式区约占高 45%，左右各留约 3% 边距
元素间以 + 与 = 号连接
黑底白色 X 图标
白底黑字 2-3 hours 圆角矩形
带金属线圈的笔记本图标，内写 this article
黑色 +100M views 手写粗体，右上三点橙射线

cards.value: AI能根据你现在的照片猜出你小时候的脸吗?
cards.why: A direct question at the top turns "can AI do it" into the reader's own suspense, forcing them to scroll down for the answer.
alts: Did you look like this as a kid?
The same face, twenty years apart

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Two equal-height panels top and bottom, each with two people side by side, with a year number label above each person
cards.why: Two equal-height comparison panels make "past/now" instantly comparable; the information is clear without reading text.
alts: Top-bottom two panels with a small caption strip at the bottom

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Beige-brown background covers a large area, with light gray and white tops and blue denim forming the main color blocks
cards.why: Low-saturation beige-brown feels like an old studio negative, and the blue denim pops out to give the "photo" a real feel.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: Multiple pairs of people appearing together against the same beige-brown background, wearing light gray or white short-sleeve tops with blue jeans
cards.why: Two generations, old and young, are placed against the same background, so readers automatically compare facial features and feel drawn in and want to share.
alts: Single child face and adult side by side
Hand-drawn illustration version of face comparison

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Low-saturation beige-brown tone under soft studio light, quiet, nostalgic, with a touch of warmth
cards.why: The quiet studio texture makes people willing to linger on the image and look slowly, suitable for save-worthy content.

xray.short: Two lines of large text at the top
spec: AI能根据你现在的照片猜出你小时候的脸吗?
Top center of the image, arranged in two lines
A single line takes up about three-quarters of the image width
#5B7BA6 blue denim appears over a large area
Low saturation of beige-brown and blue-gray
Quietly nostalgic, like flipping through an old photo album

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: AI能根据你现在的照片猜出你小时候的脸吗?
cards.why: 顶部一句直接提问，把“AI能不能做到”变成读者自己的悬疑，逼人往下看答案。
alts: 同一张脸差了二十多年

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 上下两个等高面板，每格内并排两个人物，人物上方各有一处年份数字标注
cards.why: 两格等高的对照结构让“过去/现在”一眼可比，信息不用读文字就懂。
alts: 上下两格加底部小字条

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 米褐色背景大面积铺满，浅灰与白色上衣、蓝色牛仔构成主要色块
cards.why: 低饱和米褐色像旧影棚底片，蓝牛仔一跳出来就显出“照片”的实感。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 同一米褐色背景前成对出现的多个人物，穿浅灰或白色短袖上衣配蓝色牛仔裤
cards.why: 大小两代人被摆进同一块背景，读者会自动去比对五官，产生代入与转发欲。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 柔和影棚光下的低饱和米褐调，安静、怀旧、带点温情
cards.why: 不吵不闹的影棚质感让人愿意停留在画面上慢慢看，适合收藏型内容。

spec: AI能根据你现在的照片猜出你小时候的脸吗?
画面上方居中，两行排布
单行约占画面宽度的四分之三
均匀柔和的正面影棚光

sourcePrompt.en: Referencing the case study "Can AI Guess What Your Childhood Face Looked Like from Your Current Photo?"—its old photo restoration approach, vintage texture, visual storytelling and posting tone—generate a new set of retro old photo image-and-text content. New topic: {fill in the photo topic you want to restore, rebuild or recreate} Reference platform: Xiaohongshu Content direction: retro old photo image-and-text Creation method: keep the original case's nostalgic emotion, film/photo paper texture, character relationships, era atmosphere of the scene and restoration constraints; if it is photo restoration, it must be faithful to the original photo's identity, facial features, composition and historical context, avoiding excessive beautification, redrawing, false historical information and a modern digital plastic feel. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. A 6-9 page image-and-text script, with each page containing a visual description, main copy, era/texture keywords and a save prompt; 3. Visual prompts that can be used directly for image generation or photo restoration, explaining requirements for characters, scene, lighting, film grain, damage repair and color restoration; 4. Posting suggestions: title length, tags, image ratio and platform tone. Constraints: do not replicate the original author, original people or brand logos; do not fabricate historical facts; when real people's photos are involved, prioritize identity consistency and do not do rejuvenation, beautification, face slimming or facial feature rewriting.
sourcePrompt.zh-CN: 参考案例《AI能根据你现在的照片猜出你小时候的脸吗》的老照片修复方式、年代质感、画面叙事和发布语气，生成一组新的复古老照片图文。 新主题：{填写你要修复、重建或复刻的照片主题} 参考平台：小红书 内容方向：复古老照片图文 创作方法：保留原案例的怀旧情绪、胶片/相纸质感、人物关系、场景年代感和修复约束；如果是照片修复，必须忠于原图身份、五官、构图和历史语境，避免过度美颜、重绘、虚假历史信息和现代数码塑料感。 请输出： 1. 封面标题与副标题； 2. 6-9 页图文脚本，每页包含画面描述、主文案、年代/质感关键词和收藏引导； 3. 可直接用于图像生成或照片修复的视觉提示词，说明人物、场景、光线、胶片颗粒、破损修复和色彩还原要求； 4. 发布建议：标题长度、标签、图片比例和平台语气。 约束：不要复刻原作者、原人物或品牌标识；不要编造历史事实；涉及真实人物照片时优先保留身份一致性，不做年轻化、美颜、瘦脸或五官改写。

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: Menu
cards.why: The only text lands on the red menu card, like a suspense prop, making people want to tap in and see what happened at this dinner gathering.
alts: No text, relying on the image itself to catch the eye
A handwritten question pressed onto the image
A large title spanning the top of the image

alts: Image on top, text strip below

cards.label: Colour palette

cards.why: The warm-cold clash of deep brown and purple-pink brings out a sense of era, instantly evoking the flavour of old magazine illustrations.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: Two people seated around a dining table; in the foreground a woman holds a cigarette and a wine glass, behind her a man in a grey-blue suit and tie
cards.why: The two people, one in front and one behind, stand like a frozen scene from a story, leaving room for imagination.

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: A retro illustration-style nighttime social scene, with dramatic tension under warm light
cards.why: The old print texture plus indoor warm light evokes a suspenseful frame from an old film.

xray.short: One word on the menu card
spec: The menu card standing on the left side of the dining table
The smallest and only text in the image
#7A5EA8 dress purple, with light pink patterns
Warm light falling on the characters and tablecloth
A dramatic scene frozen in a single frame

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: Menu
cards.why: 唯一的文字落在红色菜单卡上，像一枚悬念道具，让人想点开看这桌饭局发生了什么。
alts: 无文字，靠画面本身抓眼
手写体提问句压在画面上

cards.label: Mood

sourcePrompt.en: Referencing the old-photo restoration approach, vintage texture, visual storytelling, and posting tone of the case study "Can anyone restore this old photo?", generate a new set of retro old-photo image-text content. New topic: {fill in the photo topic you want to restore, rebuild, or recreate} Reference platform: Xiaohongshu Content direction: retro old-photo image-text Creative method: keep the original case's nostalgic emotion, film/photo-paper texture, relationships between people, period feel of the scene, and restoration constraints; if it's photo restoration, it must stay faithful to the original image's identity, facial features, composition, and historical context, avoiding excessive beautification, redrawing, false historical information, and a modern digital plastic look. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. A 6-9 page image-text script, with each page containing a visual description, main copy, era/texture keywords, and a save prompt; 3. Posting suggestions: title length, tags, image ratio, and platform tone. Constraints: do not recreate the original author, original people, or brand marks; do not fabricate historical facts; when real people's photos are involved, prioritize identity consistency, and do not make them younger, beautify, slim the face, or alter facial features.

cards.label: Hook
cards.why: There is no text on the image; it relies entirely on two similar old photos placed side by side, making people want to stop and figure out which one looks unnatural.
alts: Add a line of question text on the image
Circle the suspicious spots in red
Add a "real vs fake comparison" sticker

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Two equal-height panels stacked vertically, full width horizontally, each taking about half the height, meeting directly in the middle
cards.why: Two panels with almost identical compositions are placed together so the comparison works, and readers will scan back and forth looking for differences.
alts: Two panels side by side for comparison
A four-grid arrangement of multiple photos
A large image with a small image pressed into the corner

cards.label: Color Palette
cards.value: Overall yellow-brown old film tone, large areas of off-white wall, with a gray-blue large outer garment in the lower panel
cards.why: The unified faded warm tone makes both images look like real old photos, while the cool-colored outer garment becomes the visual anchor of the lower panel.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: Two people, one in each of the upper and lower panels, with a house with windows and rows of trees behind them
cards.why: The same type of people and the same type of scene appear repeatedly, so readers subconsciously compare details panel by panel.
alts: A single person filling the entire panel
A person occupying only a corner of the frame
A person's back facing the courtyard

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: A warm, yellowed nostalgic feel, like a family group photo page turned up from an old album
cards.why: The nostalgic atmosphere first stirs emotion, then gives people the patience to distinguish real from fake.
alts: A warm family photo under the sun

spec: There is no readable text in the image
There are tiny blurry marks on the photo whose content cannot be identified
The image has grain and the worn feel of an old photo

cards.label: 钩子

cards.label: 配色

sourcePrompt.en: Please generate a new WeChat public-account horizontal cover based on the reference cover's composition, visual metaphor, and thumbnail readability. Central concept: visualize the growth mechanism as a flywheel, pipeline, customer journey, revenue dashboard, or team collaboration system. Style: preserve the reference cover's visual direction: high-saturation poster/tech-advertising visual. Use a palette inspired by #d2250c (red), #6d170e (charcoal), #f24b28 (orange), #cf8c6f (pink). Keep the image editorial, conceptual, and readable as a small WeChat thumbnail. Composition: the image is information-dense, suitable for a central subject plus supporting information on the left and right, keeping the thumbnail readable. Keep the main subject and any essential title text inside the safe square crop, while using the full wide frame for atmosphere, secondary symbols, or directional motion. Text strategy: use either no text or a very short headline fragment from the title. If text is used, make it large, clean, and integrated into the layout rather than pasted on top. Mood: match the article skill "CarpGirls' disappearance isn't just because the team performed... style dual skill" -- useful, sharp, high-signal, and slightly more memorable than a normal tutorial thumbnail. Avoid: photorealistic clutter unless the source cover is photo-led, fake logos, unreadable tiny text, generic gradient blobs, stock-office imagery, watermark-like marks, and literal screenshots unless the article is explicitly about software interfaces.
