cards.label: Hook
cards.value: 暴躁的小火柴
cards.why: Bold black handwritten large text pressed over the flame immediately throws the emotion point of "grumpy" at parents, triggering associations with their own child's temper.
alts: Change to a question to create relatability
Use the child's own words as the title
Write the conflict outcome in the subtitle

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Single full-bleed illustration, title at the top, two characters placed side by side in confrontation, one left and one right
cards.why: Full-bleed with no divisions makes the image feel like an inner page of a picture book; the left-right standoff pose naturally creates conflict tension, making it easy to read at a glance in the feed.
alts: Large text on the left, illustration on the right

cards.label: Color Palette
cards.value: Orange-red flames surround warm wood-colored ground; off-white candle and dark brown matchstick form a brightness contrast
cards.why: Large areas of warm orange-red first apply emotional pressure, while the off-white character creates visual breathing room, making the "frightened" side stand out especially.
alts: Cool blue tones to highlight low mood
High-contrast red and black warning feel

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A matchstick with flailing arms and bared teeth stands side by side with a candle covering its mouth and cowering
cards.why: The contrast of high-low, big-small and strong-weak postures turns the abstract "emotional loss of control" into two visible cartoon figures.
alts: Draw only a close-up of the angry matchstick
Two characters holding hands and making up

cards.label: Atmosphere
cards.value: Lively and irritable yet with childish, cute hand-drawn charm
cards.why: The fiery scene is softened by rounded brushstrokes, so parents won't feel oppressed and are instead willing to save it for their children to see.

Bold-stroke handwritten, black, tight letter spacing

About 4%–17% height from the top edge
25%–95% height in the middle-lower part, two characters left and right

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: 暴躁的小火柴
cards.why: 粗黑手写体大字压在火焰上，第一眼就把"暴躁"这个情绪点砸给家长，触发对自家孩子脾气的联想。

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 单幅满版插画，标题居上，两角色一左一右并置对峙
cards.why: 满版无分割让画面像绘本内页，左右对峙的站姿天然形成冲突张力，方便在信息流里被一眼读懂。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 橙红火焰包围暖木色地面，米白蜡烛与深棕火柴形成明度对比
cards.why: 大面积暖橙红先给情绪压强，米白角色做视觉留白，让"被吓到"的一方格外显眼。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 一根张牙舞爪的火柴与一根捂嘴瑟缩的蜡烛并排站立
cards.why: 高低大小与姿态一强一弱的对照，把抽象的"情绪失控"变成看得见的两个卡通形象。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 热烈焦躁中带着幼稚可爱的手绘童趣
cards.why: 火气十足的场景被圆润笔触软化，家长不会觉得压抑，反而愿意收藏给孩子看。

sourcePrompt.en: Referencing the content structure, first-image hook, visual pacing, and publishing tone of the case study "#EffortlessVibes #PersonalGrowth #MindsetShift", generate a new set of viral image-text posts. New topic: {topic you want to generate} Reference platform: Douyin Content direction: growth and self-discipline image-text Creation method: keep the original case's sense of purpose, step-by-step breakdown, and low-barrier execution methods, so every page has an actionable step. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. A 6-8 page image-text script, each page including visual description, main copy, key information points, and an interaction/save action; 3. Visual prompts that can be used directly for image generation, specifying subject, scene, lighting, composition, font, or layout; 4. Publishing suggestions: title length, tags, image ratio, and platform tone. Constraints: do not replicate the original author, original characters, or brand logos; do not fabricate data; avoid promising results when it involves health, mysticism, investing, or educational outcomes.

Composition: 暗底强氛围，适合单一发光焦点、人物剪影或中央隐喻物。 Keep the main subject and any essential title text inside the safe square crop, while using the full wide frame for atmosphere, secondary symbols, or directional motion. cards.label: Hook
cards.value: 领导发话了，还得上“职场牛马干等”课
cards.why: A single workplace complaint line lands directly on the office worker, and readers will click the moment they recognize themselves.
alts: Open directly with the boss's exact words
Write the pain point as a course name

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: 2×2 four equal panels, each with a black hand-drawn border, even white space between panels
cards.why: Four equal panels like comic storyboards, clear rhythm, and you can finish it with one glance on a phone.
alts: Three panels in a horizontal row

cards.label: Color scheme
cards.value: Large areas of white background, warm brown characters, red hair accents, stage pink and blue in the lower-right corner
cards.why: The clean white background makes the black-line comic pop, and the warm-colored characters feel friendly rather than oppressive.
alts: Off-white background with pure black lines
Black background with white lines for high contrast

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: Cartoon capybara and red-haired bearded character, appearing repeatedly across multiple panels
cards.why: A fixed protagonist appears repeatedly, so readers will remember the persona and follow the next episode.

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: The relaxed complaining feel of a hand-drawn comic, self-deprecating and funny
cards.why: Turn workplace frustration into a joke, and once the emotion is caught, people are willing to forward it to colleagues.
alts: A slightly bleak office worker complaint

xray.short: Complaint line in the upper-left corner
spec: 领导发话了，还得上“职场牛马干等”课
At the top of the upper-left panel, arranged in two lines
The largest font size within that panel

xray.short: Mainly white background with warm brown

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: 领导发话了，还得上“职场牛马干等”课
cards.why: 一句职场吐槽台词直接落到打工人身上，读者一眼对号入座就会点开。

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 2×2 四格等分，每格黑色手绘边框，格间留白均匀
cards.why: 四格等大像漫画分镜，节奏清楚，手机上扫一眼就能读完。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 大面积白色底，暖棕角色，红发点缀，右下角舞台粉蓝
cards.why: 白底干净让黑线漫画跳出来，暖色角色显得亲切不压抑。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 卡通水豚与红发大胡子角色，在多格里反复出现
cards.why: 固定主角反复出场，读者记住人设就会追更下一回。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 手绘漫画的轻松吐槽感，自嘲又好笑
cards.why: 把职场憋屈讲成段子，情绪被接住就愿意转发给同事。

spec: 领导发话了，还得上“职场牛马干等”课
左上角一格顶部，分两行排布

sourcePrompt.en: Refer to the content structure, first-image hook, visual pacing, and publishing tone of the case study "(Continued from last time) Sha Wujing, stop waiting, I'll take you to open a bathhouse" to generate a new set of viral image-text content. New topic: {fill in the topic you want to generate} Reference platform: Xiaohongshu Content direction: workplace growth image-text Creation method: keep the original case's workplace hook, pain-point scenes, and conclusion rhythm, and restructure with more specific personas, conflicts, methods, and executable actions. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. 6-8 page image-text script, each page including visual description, main copy, information points, and interaction/save action; 3. Visual prompts that can be used directly for image generation, explaining subject, scene, lighting, composition, font, or layout; 4. Publishing suggestions: title length, tags, image ratio, and platform tone. Constraints: do not replicate the original author, original characters, or brand logos; do not fabricate data; avoid promising results when it involves health, mysticism, investment, or educational outcomes.

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: 抹茶新地
cards.why: The large text on the wall poster together with the date stamp evokes memories of old fast-food restaurants, making people want to stop and look.
alts: Change to English slogan i'm lovin' it
Change to price number as low as 4 yuan

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Single photo, no panels; people are distributed horizontally across the middle of the frame, with a dining table and paper cups in the foreground.
cards.why: A single image with no collage keeps the viewer's attention focused on the people and the period feel.

cards.label: Color palette
cards.value: Mainly off-white and light pink, with a gray-green poster in the upper right and denim-blue clothing on the right.
cards.why: A light warm base with local green/blue creates an everyday retro film feel that easily triggers nostalgic resonance.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A group of people sitting around a fast-food restaurant table, with paper cups, trays, and paper bags on the table.
cards.why: A group dining scene feels down-to-earth and makes viewers think of their own gatherings back then.
alts: Only photograph the food on the table
Empty shot of the poster and date

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: A nostalgic snapshot under warm indoor light, with a dreamcore vibe and a 2008 date stamp.
cards.why: The date stamp and low-quality flash texture together create a time-capsule feel that makes people want to save it.

spec: Larger, occupying the upper part of the poster

xray.short: Warm white base with local green and blue
spec: #EFE9E0 clothing of the people and bright areas of the background
The text 2008/03/30 appears in the lower right

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: 抹茶新地
cards.why: 墙上海报的大字与日期戳一起唤起旧日快餐店记忆，让人想停留查看。
alts: 换成英文标语 i'm lovin' it

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 单幅照片，无分格；人物横向分布在画面中部，前景是餐桌与纸杯。
cards.why: 无拼贴的单图让观者注意力集中在人物与年代感上。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 米白与浅粉为主，右上角有灰绿色海报，右侧有牛仔蓝色衣物。
cards.why: 浅暖底色与局部绿色/蓝色形成日常复古胶片感，容易引发怀旧共鸣。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 一群人围坐在快餐店餐桌前，桌上有纸杯、托盘和纸袋。
cards.why: 多人聚餐场景接地气，让观者联想到自己当年的聚会。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 暖调室内光下的怀旧快照，带有 2008 年日期戳的梦核气息。
cards.why: 日期戳和低画质闪光灯质感共同制造时间胶囊感，让人想收藏。

sourcePrompt.en: Referencing the case "Created more dreamcore photos!" and its approach to old photo restoration, period texture, visual storytelling, and publishing tone, generate a new set of retro old-photo posts. New theme: {topic you want to restore, rebuild, or recreate} Reference platform: Xiaohongshu Content direction: retro old-photo posts Creation method: keep the original case's nostalgic mood, film/photo-paper texture, interpersonal relationships, period atmosphere of the scene, and restoration constraints; if it is photo restoration, it must stay faithful to the original image's identity, facial features, composition, and historical context, and avoid excessive beautification, redrawing, false historical information, and a modern digital plastic feel. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. A 6-9 page image-text script, with each page including a scene description, main copy, era/texture keywords, and a save prompt; 3. Visual prompts that can be used directly for image generation or photo restoration, explaining requirements for people, scene, lighting, film grain, damage repair, and color restoration; 4. Publishing suggestions: title length, tags, image ratio, and platform tone. Constraints: do not replicate the original author, original people, or brand marks; do not fabricate historical facts; when real people's photos are involved, prioritize identity consistency and do not make them younger, beautify, slim the face, or alter facial features.
sourcePrompt.zh-CN: 参考案例《又创作了一些梦核照片！》的老照片修复方式、年代质感、画面叙事和发布语气，生成一组新的复古老照片图文。 新主题：{填写你要修复、重建或复刻的照片主题} 参考平台：小红书 内容方向：复古老照片图文 创作方法：保留原案例的怀旧情绪、胶片/相纸质感、人物关系、场景年代感和修复约束；如果是照片修复，必须忠于原图身份、五官、构图和历史语境，避免过度美颜、重绘、虚假历史信息和现代数码塑料感。 请输出： 1. 封面标题与副标题； 2. 6-9 页图文脚本，每页包含画面描述、主文案、年代/质感关键词和收藏引导； 3. 可直接用于图像生成或照片修复的视觉提示词，说明人物、场景、光线、胶片颗粒、破损修复和色彩还原要求； 4. 发布建议：标题长度、标签、图片比例和平台语气。 约束：不要复刻原作者、原人物或品牌标识；不要编造历史事实；涉及真实人物照片时优先保留身份一致性，不做年轻化、美颜、瘦脸或五官改写。

cards.label: Hook
cards.why: Even without text, visual density creates a festive feel that makes people want to tap and see who is celebrating.

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Single full-bleed illustration, large character pressed to the left edge, character raising a fist on the right, densely stacked in the middle
cards.why: Full-bleed with no whitespace maxes out information density, and eye movement sweeps from the large face on the left to the cheering characters on the right.

cards.value: Pink-purple background with red balloons, warm yellow and cyan accents, high-saturation contrasting colors
cards.why: The celebratory pink-and-purple color scheme directly triggers a joyful mood, and the red-and-white logo pops most against the warm tones.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A person wearing headphones raises a fist and opens their mouth, surrounded by multiple cartoon animals and game characters
cards.why: One cheering person plus a group of cute pet characters gives both human relatability and collectible appeal.

Keep only a group of animal characters
Split the frame half person, half characters

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Lively party vibe, confetti flying, all characters smiling
cards.why: The overall emotion is consistently upbeat, so viewers unconsciously associate the celebratory feel with good news.

cards.why: 没有文字也能靠视觉密度制造节日感，让人想点开看是谁在庆祝。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 粉紫背景配红气球，暖黄与青蓝点缀，高饱和撞色

cards.why: 整体情绪一致向上，观众会不自觉把庆典感与好消息联系起来。

cards.why: With no words at all, the contrast between a white pet and a matching bead bracelet has to carry the curiosity on its own.

cards.value: Two equal side-by-side panels divided by a thin vertical seam: pet photo left, bracelet product shot right.
cards.why: The 50/50 split reads instantly as before-and-after, so the eye compares the two halves without any explanation.

Three stacked frames: pet, beads, bracelet
Pet left on white, bracelet smaller bottom right

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Off-white walls and surface, taupe vase and branch, dark green beads on both sides.
cards.why: A near-monochrome room makes the green and brass accents feel like the only precious thing in frame.
alts: Warm cream background with amber accents
Cool grey studio with silver metal

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A white dog wearing a beaded collar on the left, a matching beaded cord bracelet on the right.
cards.why: Seeing the exact same beads on pet and wrist is the save-worthy proof that the product can be shared.
alts: Two pets each wearing a bead collar
Bracelet held in a hand beside the pet
Collar alone on a plain surface

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Quiet, minimal studio calm: soft even light, faint shadows, nothing decorative competing with the beads.
cards.why: Calm, uncluttered staging makes the item feel like a considered keepsake rather than a hard sell.

pet and jewellery shown as one set

cards.label: Hook
cards.why: Pure visual metaphor creates curiosity about "how technology builds barriers," making people want to click and see the explanation.
alts: Add a glowing title to strengthen clicks
Use arrows to mark the direction of the river of light
Leave space on the left for a large Chinese title

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: A single wide composite image, with the main castle on the right as the subject and distant castles and a river on the left forming a depth-leading line
cards.why: The unbalanced composition-heavy on the right and empty on the left-pins the eye first on the glowing subject, then sweeps along the river across the whole image.
alts: Split left and right halves for contrast
Center and symmetrically highlight the main castle
Use the rule of thirds and place the river of light at the bottom

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Deep blue-purple night sky and gray-green mist as the base, with fluorescent cyan-green circuit light as the dominant accent color
cards.why: Cool night colors lower the mood, and bright green light pops most against a dark background, naturally catching the eye and suggesting technological energy.
alts: Go fully cool gray to reduce the glow

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A stone castle on rock, its walls covered with fluorescent circuit patterns, with walls and towers clearly recognizable
cards.why: Turning an ancient stone castle into a "circuited" defamiliarized combination makes the abstract concept of platform barriers visible and tangible.
alts: Replace with a chip city skyline
Replace with a glowing server room
Replace with an island lifted by a river of light

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Dim mist, distant warm firelight juxtaposed with cold green light, mysterious and slightly intimidating
cards.why: A sense of quiet with pressure fits the dual emotion of a "moat"-both protecting and excluding-and encourages people to save and look closer.

spec: Replace the title with visual suspense
About three-fifths to the right of the frame
Distant castle on the left, valley in the midground, river of light in the foreground
The river curves from lower left to center right
A multi-towered stone castle on rock
Covered with linear circuits and node light patterns
The main castle occupies the right half and is about 60% of the frame height
Mainly self-luminous, with very weak ambient light

cards.label: 钩子
cards.why: 纯视觉隐喻制造“技术如何筑起壁垒”的好奇，让人想点开看解释。
alts: 添加发光标题强化点击
左侧留白加大号中文标题

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 单幅宽幅合成图，主城堡居右占主体，左侧远景城堡与河流形成纵深引导线
cards.why: 右侧重、左侧空的失衡构图把目光先钉在发光主体，再顺着河流扫过全图。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 深蓝紫夜空与灰绿雾气为底，荧光青绿电路光为主导强调色
cards.why: 冷色夜景压低情绪，亮绿光在暗底上最跳，天然抓眼并暗示科技能源。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 岩石上的石砌城堡，墙面被荧光电路纹路覆满，城墙与塔楼清晰可辨
cards.why: 把古老石堡做成“电路化”的陌生化组合，让抽象的平台壁垒概念变得可见可感。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 幽暗薄雾、远处暖火光与冷绿光并置，神秘而略带威慑
cards.why: 静谧中带压迫感，契合“护城河”既保护又排他的双重情绪，促人收藏细看。

spec: 左远景城堡、中景山谷、前景光河
岩石上的多塔石砌城堡
满布线状电路与节点光纹
主堡占右半、高约画面六成
自发光为主，环境光极弱

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: 1871年黄鹤楼
cards.why: Put the place name with its year directly on the image: first give the trust that 'this is a real old photo', then make people want to see what it becomes.
alts: Use a question to point out the location
Label it with before/after colourisation wording

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Two equal panels stacked vertically: the top panel is the old photo, the bottom panel is the colourised version of the same framing, with a narrow gap between the two panels.
cards.why: The same angle compared top and bottom — you know at a glance what is being compared, and you get it as soon as you swipe.
alts: Side-by-side comparison of the same scene
Large image with a small comparison inset

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Top panel sepia monochrome; bottom panel warm pink and pale blue sky with teal-green vegetation and warm brown pavilions.
cards.why: The warm-cold contrast is concentrated in the two panels, making the colourisation look more striking.
alts: Top panel black-and-white, bottom panel cool cyan
Bottom panel high-saturation teal and orange

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A multi-tiered flying-eave pavilion on the city wall, with the river, distant mountains and shoreline houses in front; the same framing in both panels.
cards.why: The landmark itself is famous enough; repeating the same composition twice makes the change the only thing to look at.
alts: Focus on the river and distant mountains

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: The top panel is faded and flat like an archival photo; the bottom panel is warm and bright, creating a nostalgic feeling of time being awakened.
cards.why: The aged feel of the old photo plus the new colours evokes an emotional connection to the city's memory.

xray.short: Year and landmark in white text
spec: Middle-lower part of the frame, horizontally centred
About one quarter of the frame width

xray.short: Sepia old photo plus warm pink
spec: #e6a894 warm pink and pale blue gradient
Flat grey tones, weak light-dark contrast
Unified warm tones, stronger light-dark contrast
A time contrast between the old photo and the new colours

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: 1871年黄鹤楼
cards.why: 带年份的地名直接写在画面上，先给出'这是真旧照'的信任感，再让人想看它变成什么样。

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 上下两格等分，上格旧照、下格同一取景的上色版，两格之间留一条窄缝。
cards.why: 同一角度上下对照，一眼就知道在比什么，滑到即懂。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 上格棕褐单色，下格暖粉淡蓝天空配青绿植被与暖棕楼阁。
cards.why: 冷暖反差集中在两格里，上色效果显得更惊艳。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 城墙上的多层飞檐楼阁，前有江面远山与岸边屋舍，两格同一取景。
cards.why: 地标本身够有名，同一构图重复两次让变化成为唯一看点。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 上格褪色平淡像档案照，下格暖光明亮，形成时间被唤醒的怀旧感。
cards.why: 老照片的旧感加上新色彩，唤起对城市记忆的情感。

spec: 画面中部偏下、水平居中
约占画面宽度四分之一
暖调统一、明暗对比更强
旧照与新色的时间对照

sourcePrompt.en: Referencing the old-photo restoration approach, vintage texture, visual storytelling and publishing tone of the case study 'DeepSeek + Jimeng AI Bring Wuhan Old Photos Stunningly Back to Life!', generate a new set of retro old-photo image-text posts. New topic: {fill in the photo topic you want to restore, reconstruct or recreate} Reference platform: Xiaohongshu Content direction: retro old-photo image-text Creation method: keep the nostalgic emotion, film/photo-paper texture, human relationships, era-specific scene feel and restoration constraints of the original case; if it is photo restoration, it must stay faithful to the original subject's identity, facial features, composition and historical context, avoiding excessive beautification, redrawing, false historical information and a modern digital plastic look. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. A 6-9 page image-text script, each page containing a visual description, main copy, era/texture keywords and a save prompt; 3. Visual prompts ready for image generation or photo restoration, specifying requirements for people, scene, lighting, film grain, damage repair and colour restoration; 4. Publishing suggestions: title length, tags, image ratio and platform tone. Constraints: do not replicate the original author, original people or brand logos; do not fabricate historical facts; when real people's photos are involved, prioritise identity consistency, and do not make them younger, beautify, slim the face or alter facial features.
sourcePrompt.zh-CN: 参考案例《DeepSeek+即梦AI让武汉市老照片惊艳重生！》的老照片修复方式、年代质感、画面叙事和发布语气，生成一组新的复古老照片图文。 新主题：{填写你要修复、重建或复刻的照片主题} 参考平台：小红书 内容方向：复古老照片图文 创作方法：保留原案例的怀旧情绪、胶片/相纸质感、人物关系、场景年代感和修复约束；如果是照片修复，必须忠于原图身份、五官、构图和历史语境，避免过度美颜、重绘、虚假历史信息和现代数码塑料感。 请输出： 1. 封面标题与副标题； 2. 6-9 页图文脚本，每页包含画面描述、主文案、年代/质感关键词和收藏引导； 3. 可直接用于图像生成或照片修复的视觉提示词，说明人物、场景、光线、胶片颗粒、破损修复和色彩还原要求； 4. 发布建议：标题长度、标签、图片比例和平台语气。 约束：不要复刻原作者、原人物或品牌标识；不要编造历史事实；涉及真实人物照片时优先保留身份一致性，不做年轻化、美颜、瘦脸或五官改写。

cards.label: Hook
cards.why: No text on the first image; use a face looking straight at the camera and let the title do the click-driving.

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: A single full-bleed image, person centered slightly above middle, blue background on both sides
cards.why: Centered composition makes the face the only focus, with zero information interference, locking attention at a glance while scrolling.
alts: Two columns with image left and text right

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Gray-white portrait pressed onto a bright blue square-noise background
cards.why: The cool blue background and desaturated face create strong contrast, delivering both tech feel and calmness.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A person wearing thin metal-frame glasses, frontal big headshot
cards.why: The big headshot enlarges the gaze and expression, and viewers will instinctively make eye contact with the person in the image.

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Calm, restrained, with a futuristic feel of data streams
cards.why: The quiet tech temperament makes people believe this is an informative long read rather than clickbait.

spec: No copy anywhere in the image
The subject's gaze looking straight at the camera
Horizontally centered, occupying about 25%-75% of the width
About one quarter on each side is background
Medium-brightness sky blue, covering over about 60% of the image
Small light blue and white square noise
A person wearing thin metal-frame glasses
Frontal big headshot, from top of head to jaw
The person is combined with the blue background in a collage-like way
Clear contrast between facial highlights and shadows
The photo is posterized to give it an illustrative feel

cards.label: 钩子
cards.why: 首图不写字，用一张直视镜头的脸把点击欲交给标题去完成。

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 单一满幅画面，人物居中偏上，两侧留蓝底
cards.why: 中心构图让脸成为唯一焦点，信息零干扰，滑动中一眼锁定。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 灰白人像压在亮蓝色方块噪点底上
cards.why: 冷蓝底与去色人脸形成强反差，科技感与冷静感同时到位。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 一位戴细金属框眼镜的人，正面大头特写
cards.why: 大头特写放大眼神与表情，观众会下意识与画面里的人对视。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 冷静、克制，带数据流的未来感
cards.why: 不喧哗的科技气质让人相信这是一篇有信息量的长文而非标题党。

spec: 左右各约四分之一为背景
中明度天蓝，约占全图 60% 以上
浅蓝与白色小方块噪点
一位戴细金属框眼镜的人
正面大头特写，头顶到下颌
人物与蓝底做拼贴式结合
面部高光与阴影对比明显
照片经海报化处理后带插画感

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: 我跟我老公结婚6年了，老公出轨了4年。

alts: Use number contrast as the title

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Single borderless illustration: two lines of text at the top, three groups of graphics scattered below in varying sizes.
cards.why: There are no panels, yet there are focal points everywhere; the eye is led in order through text, figures, photo frame, and desk calendar until the end.
alts: Single large image with a bottom banner
Split left and right to compare two sides

cards.label: Color scheme
cards.value: Mainly white background; clothing uses three large color blocks of bright green, light purple, and gray-blue; red appears only in small marks.
cards.why: A large white background makes the hand-drawn lines look clean, and a few solid color blocks distinguish the figures from each other without tiring the eyes.
alts: Cool gray with a touch of red

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: Hand-drawn figures: one person standing on the left, a facing pair at the upper right, a photo frame and desk calendar below.
cards.why: Drawing "the person present" and "the evidence of absence" in the same image lets the story tell itself.
alts: Use a phone chat screenshot as the subject
Add cracks to a group photo

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Hand-drawn diary feel, quiet and restrained, holding emotions down with a broken photo frame and a cracked heart.
cards.why: No crying, no fuss, only cracks drawn; readers fill in the emotions themselves, making it easier to relate and share.

xray.short: Two lines of large text at the top

cards.label: Hook
cards.why: The absence of words forces the viewer to read the dog's expression, which makes the meme instantly relatable and shareable.

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Single square panel, subject centered, no borders or grid.
cards.why: A single clean panel keeps the focus entirely on the expression, making it easy to add captions in any format.
alts: Full-bleed with text top and bottom

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Warm beige and cream tones dominate, with dark accents from eyes and nose.
cards.why: The soft, warm palette feels inviting and neutral, so the meme can be reused without visual clash.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A close-up portrait of a light-colored dog, looking sideways.
cards.why: The dog's sideways glance is the core of the joke, making it a perfect reaction image for awkward or skeptical moments.

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Skeptical, amused, and slightly confused.
cards.why: This mood captures a universal feeling of doubt or side-eye, which drives shares and comments.

cards.label: 钩子
cards.why: 没有文字会迫使观众解读狗的表情，这让模因瞬间产生共鸣并易于分享。
alts: 带有讽刺说明的文字叠加

cards.label: 布局
cards.value: 单个方形画面，主体居中，无边框或网格。
cards.why: 单一干净的画面将焦点完全集中在表情上，使其易于以任何格式添加说明文字。
alts: 满版并顶部和底部加文字

cards.label: 调色板
cards.value: 暖米色和奶油色调为主，眼睛和鼻子带来深色点缀。
cards.why: 柔和温暖的色调让人感到亲切且中性，因此该模因可以重复使用而不会产生视觉冲突。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 一只浅色狗的近距离肖像，正侧目看。
cards.why: 狗斜眼一瞥是笑话的核心，使其成为尴尬或怀疑时刻的完美反应图。

cards.label: 情绪
cards.value: 怀疑、觉得好笑，又略带困惑。
cards.why: 这种情绪捕捉了普遍的怀疑或侧目感，从而推动分享和评论。

sourcePrompt.en: Create a new [Meme Template] concept Title Turn Doge into a fresh social meme Subtitle Keep the classic visual rhythm, swap in a new punchline and audience insight. Creative direction: meme template Method: preserve the original template structure, conflict, eye-line, and reversal timing while replacing the situation with an English-language social insight. Please output: 1. A concise English title and subtitle for social posting; 2. 2-4 short English caption lines that can be placed directly on the meme; 3. A visual prompt for image generation or image editing, covering subject, composition, typography, stickers, and whitespace; 4. Posting advice: use case, hashtags, and engagement hook. Constraints: do not recreate a real person's identity, trademark, or watermark; do not claim source authorization; when keeping the source image, use it only as a composition reference.
sourcePrompt.zh-CN: 创建一个新的[模因模板]概念 标题：将Doge打造成全新的社交模因 副标题：保留经典的视觉节奏，替换成新的笑点和受众洞察。 创意方向：模因模板 方法：保留原始模板结构、冲突、视线和反转时机，同时将情境替换为英语社交洞察。 请输出：1. 用于社交发布的简洁英文标题和副标题；2. 2-4条可直接放在模因上的简短英文说明文字；3. 用于图像生成或图像编辑的视觉提示，涵盖主体、构图、排版、贴纸和留白；4. 发布建议：使用场景、话题标签和互动钩子。 限制：不得重建真实人物的身份、商标或水印；不得声称来源授权；保留源图像时，仅将其用作构图参考。

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: 公開前 / 公開後
cards.why: The left-right contrast with time anchors instantly makes it clear this is a diagram about expectation gaps, making viewers unable to stop scrolling.
alts: Use a question as the title

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Two equal panels left and right, connected by a dark blue arrow in the middle, with a timeline running across the bottom and a black-framed caption in each corner.
cards.why: The mirrored structure with symmetry and a timeline makes the contrast instantly readable without explanation.
alts: Remove the timeline and keep only the arrow

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Light gray-blue background with dark blue arrows, low-saturation warm accents on characters and speech bubbles, overall cool and restrained.
cards.why: The cool base color doesn't steal attention from the text, making opinion-based content look rational and trustworthy, suitable for WeChat public-account illustrations.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: Left side: one person lying down looking at a computer; right side: one person sitting in a cinema seat, each with speech bubbles.
cards.why: Specific scenes with emotional bubbles turn abstract concepts into universally relatable imagery, easy to screenshot and share.

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Contrasting calm snark, expectation in the first half and disappointment in the second, with a touch of light self-deprecation.
cards.why: Light humor reduces preachiness, making readers more willing to save this image that has both emotion and information.

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 左右两块等分面板，中间用深蓝箭头连接，底部贯穿一条时间轴，两角各放一个黑框图注。
cards.why: 对称加时间轴的镜像结构让对比一眼可读，信息不需要解释就能被看懂。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 浅灰蓝底配深蓝箭头，人物与气泡用低饱和暖色点缀，整体冷调克制。
cards.why: 冷静的底色不会抢走文字，让观点型内容显得理性可信，适合公众号配图。

cards.value: 左侧一人趴着看电脑，右侧一人坐在影院座椅上，两边各有对话气泡。
cards.why: 具体场景加情绪气泡把抽象概念演成人人经历过的画面，容易被截图转发。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 反差式的冷静吐槽感，前半期待后半失望，带一点轻松自嘲。
cards.why: 轻幽默降低了说教味，读者更愿意保存这种既有情绪又有信息量的图。

sourcePrompt.en: Based on the reference cover's composition, visual metaphor, and WeChat public-account thumbnail readability, generate a new horizontal WeChat public-account cover. Output size: 1456x582, ratio about 2.5:1; the core subject and necessary title information must also work within the WeChat safe square crop. WeChat article title: {fill in the WeChat article title} Description: {fill in the description} Original cover method: Don't Pollute the "First Touch" of Information: Lessons from "National Treasure" and "Slam Dunk" Style dual-skill Create a horizontal WeChat public-account article cover, 2.35:1 aspect ratio, for an article titled "Don't Pollute the 'First Touch' of Information: Lessons from 'National Treasure' and 'Slam Dunk'". Central concept: visualize the growth mechanism as a flywheel, funnel, customer journey, revenue dashboard, or team collaboration system. Style: preserve the reference cover's visual direction: black-and-white or low-saturation editorial illustration/photo. Use a palette inspired by #dae3f2 (white), #f6f8fb (white), #898c93 (gray), #dce3f0 (white). Keep the image editorial, conceptual, and readable as a small WeChat thumbnail. Composition: lots of whitespace, suitable for a large headline, a few icons, and a clear left-text/right-image or center-title layout. Keep the main subject and any essential title text inside the safe square crop, while using the full wide frame for atmosphere, secondary symbols, or directional motion. Text strategy: use either no text or a very short headline fragment from the title. If text is used, make it large, clean, and integrated into the layout rather than pasted on top. Mood: match the article skill "Don't Pollute the 'First Touch' of Information: Lessons from 'National Treasure' and 'Slam Dunk'... Style dual-skill" -- useful, sharp, high-signal, and slightly more memorable than a normal tutorial thumbnail. Avoid: photorealistic clutter unless the source cover is photo-led, fake logos, unreadable tiny text, generic gradient blobs, stock-office imagery, watermark-like marks, and literal screenshots unless the article is explicitly about software interfaces.

cards.label: Hook
cards.why: The visual information overload directly suggests complex technology, making people curious about AI tools unable to resist clicking to see the explanation.
alts: Use code rain to create mystery
Multiple screens surrounding to highlight hardcore feel
No text, pure visual, strong immersion

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Single horizontal composition, person centered, over a dozen screens surrounding to form enclosing depth of field
cards.why: A large number of repeated elements fill the frame, creating high information density that makes people want to zoom in and examine the content of each screen.

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Dark base with high-saturation neon green and magenta, cyan as accent
cards.why: Cyberpunk colors have strong contrast in the feed; the dark base makes green code the visual focus.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A person facing away from the camera, wearing over-ear headphones, both hands raised and reaching toward screens on either side
cards.why: The back view lets readers take the operator's perspective, and the hands spread open convey control and immersion.
alts: Close-up of hands typing on keyboard

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Immersive, tense, and tech-mysterious like a late-night hacker studio
cards.why: Low light and dense screens create a highly focused atmosphere, evoking a scene of an expert studying alone.

spec: A person facing away from the camera
Both hands raised, pointing toward screens on both sides

cards.label: 钩子
cards.why: 视觉上的信息过载直接暗示复杂技术，让对 AI 工具好奇的人忍不住点开看解释。

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 单幅横构图，人物居中，十余块屏幕环绕形成包围式景深
cards.why: 大量重复元素填满画面，信息密度高，让人想放大细看每块屏幕的内容。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 暗黑底加高饱和霓虹绿与品红，青色作点缀
cards.why: 赛博朋克配色在信息流里对比强烈，暗色底让绿色代码成为视觉焦点。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 一个背对镜头的人，戴头戴式耳机，双手抬起伸向两侧屏幕
cards.why: 背影让读者代入操作者视角，双手张开的动作传递掌控与沉浸感。

cards.label: 氛围

cards.why: 暗光与密集屏幕营造高专注氛围，让人联想到高手独自钻研的场景。

sourcePrompt.en: Refer to the case study "Education lifts up the seedling, it doesn't gamble the whole family #education #kids #family #parentingclass" for its content structure, cover hook, visual rhythm, and posting tone to generate a new set of viral image-text posts. New topic: {fill in the topic you want to generate} Reference platform: Douyin Content direction: English learning image-text Creation method: Keep the original case's learning scenarios, short-sentence density, and memory rhythm, and break knowledge points into cards that can be saved for review. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. 6-8 page image-text script, each page including visual description, main copy, information points, and interaction/save action; 3. Visual prompts that can be used directly for image generation, explaining subject, scene, lighting, composition, font, or layout; 4. Posting suggestions: title length, tags, image ratio, and platform tone. Constraints: Do not replicate the original author, original characters, or brand logos; do not fabricate data; avoid promising results when it involves health, mysticism, investment, or educational outcomes.

cards.label: Hook
cards.why: A tiny subject in a vast empty frame triggers instant 'what am I looking at' curiosity.
alts: Add a caption to label the dare

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Single undivided frame, one centered vertical mast, tiny subjects near top-center, huge empty space on all sides
cards.why: Extreme negative space around a small subject reads as scale and stakes in one glance.

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Washed grey-beige background with near-black clothing and a black billowing cloth as the darkest anchor
cards.why: Muted haze makes the black shapes pop, so the eye locks onto them without colour noise.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: Two small figures in dark clothing and masks on a pole platform, a large dark cloth streaming to the right
cards.why: Masked, faceless figures plus a flying cloth give a cinematic, story-ready silhouette.

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Hazy, tense, documentary-style; low visibility and distance make the scene feel precarious and voyeuristic
cards.why: That uneasy spectator feeling is what makes people screenshot and pass it on.

cards.label: 钩子
cards.why: 广阔空白画面中的微小主体会立即引发“我到底在看什么”的好奇心。
alts: 添加说明文字来标注这个挑战
将特技的之前/之后做成分屏

cards.label: 布局
cards.value: 单一未分割画面，中央一根垂直桅杆，微小主体位于中上部附近，四周有巨大空白空间
cards.why: 围绕小主体的极端负空间一眼就能传达出尺度和风险。
alts: 下方带反应的双面板模因
全出血并带底部文字条

cards.label: 调色板
cards.value: 泛灰米色背景，近黑色服装和一块黑色翻滚布料作为最暗的视觉锚点
cards.why: 柔和的雾霭让黑色形状更突出，因此视线会锁定它们，而不会受到色彩噪点干扰。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 两名身穿深色服装、戴着面罩的小人物站在杆状平台上，一大块深色布料向右飘动
cards.why: 蒙面、无脸的人物加上飘动的布料，形成电影感十足、适合叙事的剪影。
alts: 移除布料以获得干净剪影
更宽镜头，展示更多结构

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 朦胧、紧张、纪录片风格；低能见度和距离让场景显得危险且带有窥视感
cards.why: 那种不安的旁观感正是让人们截图并转发的原因。

sourcePrompt.en: Referencing the case "Humans Failing to Tame AI Footage" and its old-photo restoration style, vintage texture, visual storytelling, and posting tone, generate a new set of retro old-photo image-text posts. New topic: {fill in the photo topic you want to restore, reconstruct, or recreate} Reference platform: Xiaohongshu Content direction: retro old-photo image-text Creation method: keep the original case's nostalgic emotion, film/photographic-paper texture, character relationships, period setting, and restoration constraints; if it is photo restoration, it must stay faithful to the original identity, facial features, composition, and historical context, avoiding excessive beautification, redrawing, false historical information, and a modern digital plastic feel. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. A 6-9 page image-text script, each page containing a visual description, main copy, era/texture keywords, and a save prompt; 3. Visual prompts that can be used directly for image generation or photo restoration, explaining requirements for characters, scene, lighting, film grain, damage repair, and color restoration; 4. cards.label: Hook
cards.value: 家里有模糊、发黄、破损、褶皱的老照片吗？
cards.why: A single question lays out the four problems of old family photos at once, then throws in "free," making people immediately want to flip through their albums and see if it fits.
alts: Old photos blurry and yellowed? I'll restore them for free
Free restoration for damaged old family photos
Creased old photos, no charge at all

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Four lines of text centred at the top, two photos side by side at the bottom, two small arrows in the middle
cards.why: The top half is for reading text, the bottom half is for seeing the comparison; the eye follows the arrows and you get the before-and-after at a glance.
alts: Text pressed to the top, photos in a centred row
Split top and bottom, photos tilted and staggered
Comparison image in the middle, text wrapping around

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Warm golden-yellow gradient background filling the frame, both photos in black-and-white tones, photo-paper edges in off-white
cards.why: Warm yellow like the paper of an old album; paired with black-and-white old photos it carries a sense of the era without stealing attention from the text.
alts: Off-white background with brown old-paper feel
Dark grey background with warm yellow highlights
Pale blue-grey background with black-and-white photos

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: One hand at the bottom, one portrait photo on each side, damaged on the left and clean on the right
cards.why: The before-and-after of the same face is the most direct comparison; a hand holding the photo paper turns "I'll fix it for you" into a visible action.
alts: Only the damaged photo, with blank space left for restoration
Restored before-and-after stacked top and bottom
Hands holding two photos at a tilt for comparison

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Nostalgic and warm, with a touch of public-welfare feel, like digging out an old album pressed at the bottom of a box
cards.why: Warm light plus the promise of "no charge" turns nostalgia into trust, making people willing to comment and save.
alts: Nostalgic with a sense of remembrance

spec: 家里有模糊、发黄、破损、褶皱的老照片吗？
Centred at the top of the image, four lines in total
About one quarter of the image height at the top
#EFB94A warm golden-yellow gradient, covering most of the image
#E9E2D2 off-white, along the outer edges of the two photos
Even, soft warm light with no hard shadows

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: 家里有模糊、发黄、破损、褶皱的老照片吗？
cards.why: 一句提问把家里旧照的四种毛病一次说清，再抛出“免费”，让人立刻想翻相册对号入座。
alts: 旧照片模糊发黄？我帮你免费修
家里破损的老照片免费修复
褶皱老照片，全程不收费用

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 上方四行文字居中，下方两张照片左右并排，中间两个小箭头
cards.why: 上半屏读文字、下半屏看对比，视线顺着箭头走，一眼就懂前后效果。
alts: 文字压顶，照片横排居中
上下分区，照片斜放错落
对比图放中间，文字绕排

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 暖金黄渐变背景铺满，两张照片为黑白调，相纸边米白
cards.why: 暖黄像旧相册纸色，配黑白老照片自带年代感，又不抢文字的注意力。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 下方一只手，两侧各一张人物照片，左破损右干净
cards.why: 同一张脸的前后对照最直观，手托相纸让“帮你修”变成看得见的动作。
alts: 只放破损照片，留白待修
修复前后上下叠放对比
手举两张照片倾斜对比

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 怀旧温暖，带一点公益感，像翻出压在箱底的旧相册
cards.why: 暖光加“不要钱”的承诺，把怀旧情绪转成信任，愿意留言和收藏。

sourcePrompt.en: Referencing the old-photo restoration approach, era texture, visual storytelling and publishing tone of the case study "Free Restoration of Old Photos," generate a new set of vintage old-photo image-text posts. New theme: {fill in the photo theme you want to restore, rebuild or recreate} Reference platform: Xiaohongshu Content direction: vintage old-photo image-text Creation method: keep the original case's nostalgic emotion, film/photo-paper texture, relationships between people, era atmosphere of the scene and restoration constraints; if it is photo restoration, it must stay faithful to the original image's identity, facial features, composition and historical context, avoiding excessive beautification, redrawing, false historical information and a modern digital plastic feel. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. A 6-9 page image-text script, each page containing a visual description, main copy, era/texture keywords and a save prompt; 3. Visual prompts that can be used directly for image generation or photo restoration, explaining requirements for people, scene, lighting, film grain, damage repair and colour restoration; 4. Publishing suggestions: title length, tags, image ratio and platform tone. Constraints: do not replicate the original author, original people or brand logos; do not fabricate historical facts; when real people's photos are involved, prioritise preserving identity consistency, and do not make them younger, beautify, slim the face or rewrite facial features.
sourcePrompt.zh-CN: 参考案例《公益修复老照片》的老照片修复方式、年代质感、画面叙事和发布语气，生成一组新的复古老照片图文。 新主题：{填写你要修复、重建或复刻的照片主题} 参考平台：小红书 内容方向：复古老照片图文 创作方法：保留原案例的怀旧情绪、胶片/相纸质感、人物关系、场景年代感和修复约束；如果是照片修复，必须忠于原图身份、五官、构图和历史语境，避免过度美颜、重绘、虚假历史信息和现代数码塑料感。 请输出： 1. 封面标题与副标题； 2. 6-9 页图文脚本，每页包含画面描述、主文案、年代/质感关键词和收藏引导； 3. 可直接用于图像生成或照片修复的视觉提示词，说明人物、场景、光线、胶片颗粒、破损修复和色彩还原要求； 4. 发布建议：标题长度、标签、图片比例和平台语气。 约束：不要复刻原作者、原人物或品牌标识；不要编造历史事实；涉及真实人物照片时优先保留身份一致性，不做年轻化、美颜、瘦脸或五官改写。

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: $0 INFRASTRUCTURE → $10,000+/YEAR SAVED
cards.why: A strong contrasting number directly shows the savings result, sparking the urge to click.

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Horizontal icons connected in a flow, top title, bottom result comparison, left-right symmetry.
cards.why: A linear flow lowers comprehension cost, while the result comparison amplifies the sense of gain.

cards.label: Palette

cards.why: A dark background makes glowing elements stand out more, boosting the tech and premium feel.

cards.label: Subject

cards.why: Brand icons build trust, and the money-bag icon directly hits the money-saving pain point.

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: A tech-savvy, efficient, and trustworthy solution atmosphere.
cards.why: A professional and crisp visual conveys an actionable money-saving solution.

cards.label: 钩子

cards.why: 线性流程降低理解成本，结果对比放大收益感。

cards.label: 配色

cards.why: 暗色背景让发光元素更醒目，提升科技感和高级感。

cards.label: 主体

cards.why: 品牌图标建立信任，钱袋图标直击省钱痛点。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 科技感、高效、可信赖的解决方案氛围。
cards.why: 专业且利落的视觉传递出可执行的省钱方案。

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: 我和我女朋友，从13岁一直谈到现在20岁。
cards.why: A single handwritten confession lays out the time span, and readers are instantly struck by the length of "from 13 to 20," making them want to read on.
alts: From school uniforms to couples' outfits, it took us seven years
Met you at 13, still together at 20
She and I went from desk mates to the same home

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: A single panel with no divisions, three groups of figures arranged horizontally from left to right, connected by two arrows and three age labels, with the three groups similar in size.
cards.why: The horizontal timeline lets you understand the story's direction without reading a word, and the three parallel groups make "growing up" visible at a glance.
alts: Three rows top to bottom, one couple per row
Three sections left, center, right, connected by arrows
Single group portrait with ages written above the characters

cards.label: Color Palette
cards.value: Large areas of off-white blank space, black line art for shapes, with bright yellow accents only on collars and one top.
cards.why: The clean background keeps the hand-drawn lines from being harsh, and a small amount of bright yellow adds energy, making it feel crisp and worth saving when scrolling by.
alts: Off-white background + black-and-white line art, with only one bright accent
Low-saturation gray-blue with warm yellow accents
Full monochrome line art with no color added

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: Three groups of figures, each with one man and one woman standing side by side, progressing from left to right with age labels.
cards.why: Figures appearing in pairs makes "we" concrete, and readers will automatically project their own relationship onto it.
alts: Three couples standing side by side
The same couple at three age stages
Scene switching from campus to street

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Soft lines, flat lighting with no obvious shadows, overall gentle and nostalgic, like flipping through a youthful journal.
cards.why: The gentle nostalgia makes people recall their own youth and easily earns likes and shares.
alts: Fresh and healing, like flipping through an old photo album
Youthful nostalgia with a light sweetness
A feeling of growing up that is both awkward and warm

Centered at the top of the image, in three lines
Takes up about a quarter of the top of the image, with very large lettering
#f2c53d bright yellow, appearing on collars and one top
Uncolored white clothes and pants blend into the blank space
Even flat light, with only faint shadows under the figures' feet
Mainly warm white, with a quiet mood
From awkward to relaxed, overall gentle

低饱和灰蓝配暖黄点缀

sourcePrompt.en: Referencing the case study "Glimpses of the Ming Tombs: Yu Mausoleum of Emperor Yingzong Zhu Qizhen (Part 1)" for its old-photo restoration approach, period texture, visual storytelling and posting tone, generate a new set of vintage old-photo image-text content. New topic: {填写你要修复、重建或复刻的照片主题} Reference platform: Xiaohongshu Content direction: vintage old-photo image-text Creative method: retain the original case's nostalgic mood, film/photo-paper texture, character relationships, period feel of the scene and restoration constraints; if it is photo restoration, it must stay faithful to the original image's identity, facial features, composition and historical context, avoiding over-beautification, redrawing, false historical information and a modern digital plastic look. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. A 6-9 page image-text script, each page including a scene description, main copy, period/texture keywords and a save prompt; 3. Visual prompts ready for image generation or photo restoration, specifying requirements for characters, scene, lighting, film grain, damage repair and colour restoration; 4. Posting tips: title length, tags, image aspect ratio and platform tone. Constraints: do not replicate the original author, original people or brand logos; do not fabricate historical facts; when real people's photos are involved, prioritise preserving identity consistency, with no rejuvenation, beautification, face slimming or facial-feature rewriting.
sourcePrompt.zh-CN: 参考案例《明十三陵掠影：明英宗朱祁镇之裕陵（上）》的老照片修复方式、年代质感、画面叙事和发布语气，生成一组新的复古老照片图文。 新主题：{填写你要修复、重建或复刻的照片主题} 参考平台：小红书 内容方向：复古老照片图文 创作方法：保留原案例的怀旧情绪、胶片/相纸质感、人物关系、场景年代感和修复约束；如果是照片修复，必须忠于原图身份、五官、构图和历史语境，避免过度美颜、重绘、虚假历史信息和现代数码塑料感。 请输出： 1. 封面标题与副标题； 2. 6-9 页图文脚本，每页包含画面描述、主文案、年代/质感关键词和收藏引导； 3. 可直接用于图像生成或照片修复的视觉提示词，说明人物、场景、光线、胶片颗粒、破损修复和色彩还原要求； 4. 发布建议：标题长度、标签、图片比例和平台语气。 约束：不要复刻原作者、原人物或品牌标识；不要编造历史事实；涉及真实人物照片时优先保留身份一致性，不做年轻化、美颜、瘦脸或五官改写。

sourcePrompt.en: Referencing the content structure, first-image hook, visual pacing, and publishing tone of the case study "💗Good Luck Aura✨💫🌟🌈", generate a new set of viral image-and-text posts. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. A 6-8 page image-and-text script, each page including visual description, main copy, information point, and interaction/save action; 3. Visual prompts that can be directly used for image generation, explaining the subject, scene, lighting, composition, font, or layout; 4. Publishing suggestions: title length, tags, image ratio, and platform tone. Constraints: do not replicate the original author, original characters, or brand logos; do not fabricate data; when it involves health, mysticism, investment, or educational outcomes, avoid promising results.

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: THE GOOGLE MAPS PLAY / $26,957 PER MONTH / $20 SETUP
cards.why: Juxtaposing a specific dollar figure down to the single digit with a twenty-dollar entry cost creates a huge contrast that makes people stop and do the math immediately.
alts: Use only the dollar amount as the hook

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Horizontal three-part formula graphic: two square icons and a plus sign on the left, an orange arrow in the middle, a large amount card on the right, one explanatory line and four small labels below, black right-angle frames in the four corners.
cards.why: The plus-to-arrow sequence compresses a complex business into a formula readable at a glance, so readers get it instantly without reading the text.
alts: Split the labels into two lines

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Off-white dotted background, black-gray main image blocks, orange-red as the accent color, white text with small mint-green accents.
cards.why: The low-saturation background makes the orange-red amount and labels look highlighted, forcing the eye toward the number.
alts: Dark background with reversed white text
All black-and-white plus a single fluorescent color

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: Three square icons: a pixel-style avatar icon, a green map-location icon, and a large black amount card, connected by a plus sign and an arrow.
cards.why: Iconized tools and results turn an abstract method into three replicable steps, making people feel they can just follow along.
alts: Connect three cards with flow arrows

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Cool, rational retro pixel-tech feel, with a touch of gamified level-clearing ease.
cards.why: Pixel icons evoke early gaming memories, making the act of earning money feel like a walkthrough you can beat.

sourcePrompt.en: Referencing the case study "Is GPT image 2 Real or Fake?"—its old photo restoration approach, period texture, visual storytelling and posting tone—generate a new set of retro old-photo image-text posts. New topic: {fill in the photo topic you want to restore, rebuild or recreate} Reference platform: Xiaohongshu Content direction: retro old-photo image-text Creation method: keep the original case's nostalgic mood, film/photo-paper texture, relationships between people, period feel of the scene and restoration constraints; for photo restoration, you must stay faithful to the original subject's identity, facial features, composition and historical context, avoiding over-beautification, redrawing, false historical information and a modern digital plastic look. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. A 6-9 page image-text script, each page including a visual description, main copy, period/texture keywords and a save prompt; 3. Visual prompts ready for image generation or photo restoration, specifying requirements for people, scene, lighting, film grain, damage repair and colour restoration; 4. Posting suggestions: title length, tags, image aspect ratio and platform tone. Constraints: do not replicate the original author, original people or brand marks; do not fabricate historical facts; when real people's photos are involved, prioritise identity consistency—no making them younger, no beautification, no face slimming, no altering facial features.
sourcePrompt.zh-CN: 参考案例《G PT image 2 你真的假的？》的老照片修复方式、年代质感、画面叙事和发布语气，生成一组新的复古老照片图文。 新主题：{填写你要修复、重建或复刻的照片主题} 参考平台：小红书 内容方向：复古老照片图文 创作方法：保留原案例的怀旧情绪、胶片/相纸质感、人物关系、场景年代感和修复约束；如果是照片修复，必须忠于原图身份、五官、构图和历史语境，避免过度美颜、重绘、虚假历史信息和现代数码塑料感。 请输出： 1. 封面标题与副标题； 2. 6-9 页图文脚本，每页包含画面描述、主文案、年代/质感关键词和收藏引导； 3. 可直接用于图像生成或照片修复的视觉提示词，说明人物、场景、光线、胶片颗粒、破损修复和色彩还原要求； 4. 发布建议：标题长度、标签、图片比例和平台语气。 约束：不要复刻原作者、原人物或品牌标识；不要编造历史事实；涉及真实人物照片时优先保留身份一致性，不做年轻化、美颜、瘦脸或五官改写。

sourcePrompt.en: Referring to the old photo restoration approach, vintage texture, visual storytelling and publishing tone of the case study "GPT Image 2 Old Photo Restoration Prompt", generate a new set of retro old photo image-text content. New theme: {填写你要修复、重建或复刻的照片主题} Reference platform: Xiaohongshu Content direction: retro old photo image-text Creation method: keep the nostalgic mood, film/photo paper texture, character relationships, era-specific scene feel and restoration constraints of the original case; if it is photo restoration, it must be faithful to the original image's identity, facial features, composition and historical context, avoiding excessive beautification, redrawing, false historical information and modern digital plastic feel. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. A 6-9 page image-text script, each page containing a visual description, main copy, era/texture keywords and a save prompt; 3. Visual prompts that can be used directly for image generation or photo restoration, explaining requirements for characters, scene, lighting, film grain, damage repair and color restoration; 4. Constraints: do not replicate the original author, original people or brand logos; do not fabricate historical facts; when real people's photos are involved, prioritize preserving identity consistency, and do not make them younger, beautify, slim the face or alter facial features.
sourcePrompt.zh-CN: 参考案例《GPT Image 2 老照片修复指令》的老照片修复方式、年代质感、画面叙事和发布语气，生成一组新的复古老照片图文。 新主题：{填写你要修复、重建或复刻的照片主题} 参考平台：小红书 内容方向：复古老照片图文 创作方法：保留原案例的怀旧情绪、胶片/相纸质感、人物关系、场景年代感和修复约束；如果是照片修复，必须忠于原图身份、五官、构图和历史语境，避免过度美颜、重绘、虚假历史信息和现代数码塑料感。 请输出： 1. 封面标题与副标题； 2. 6-9 页图文脚本，每页包含画面描述、主文案、年代/质感关键词和收藏引导； 3. 可直接用于图像生成或照片修复的视觉提示词，说明人物、场景、光线、胶片颗粒、破损修复和色彩还原要求； 4. 发布建议：标题长度、标签、图片比例和平台语气。 约束：不要复刻原作者、原人物或品牌标识；不要编造历史事实；涉及真实人物照片时优先保留身份一致性，不做年轻化、美颜、瘦脸或五官改写。

cards.label: Hook
cards.why: The yellow date-time stamp in the bottom-right corner is like a watermark on an old photo — triggering nostalgia in a second and making people want to tap in and read the story.
alts: Enlarge the date and centre it
Replace it with a handwritten year
Remove the timestamp and keep only the photo

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Single frame with no panels; three people occupy the centre of the image, with a park waterscape in the background, and the people positioned slightly lower.
cards.why: The people are centred and the close-up is full, so the information is clear at a glance and easy to notice quickly in a feed.

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Large areas of green trees, grey water and stone-paved path; the people's clothes are black, purple and blue, with overall natural colours.
cards.why: Green and grey form the everyday park base tone, and the old-photo filter feel makes the image look real yet nostalgic.
alts: Change it to a black-and-white old photo
Add a warm yellow faded filter

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: Three people posing side by side, with a pavilion, water and green trees in the background, and the people occupying the lower centre of the image.
cards.why: A group photo carries a natural sense of story, and viewers will be curious about the relationships and the scene where it was taken.
alts: Shoot only the water and pavilion
Change it to a solo portrait
Shrink the people into a distant view

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: A feeling of an everyday outing under natural daylight, with the nostalgia and ease of an old photo.
cards.why: A relaxed, natural atmosphere lowers the sense of distance, making users willing to linger and think of their own old photos.

spec: Small numbers, spanning about one third of the image width

cards.label: 钩子
cards.why: 右下角黄色日期时间戳像老照片水印，一秒触发怀旧记忆，让人想点开看故事。

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 单幅无分格；三个人物占据画面中央，背景为公园水景，人物略偏下。
cards.why: 人物居中且近景饱满，信息一目了然，适合在信息流里快速被看到。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 大面积绿色树丛、灰色水面与石板路，人物衣着黑、紫、蓝，整体自然色。
cards.why: 绿色与灰色构成日常公园底色，旧照滤镜感让画面显得真实又怀旧。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 三个人并排合影，背景有亭子、水面和绿树，人物占据画面中央下部。
cards.why: 多人合影自带故事感，观众会好奇人物关系和拍照场景。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 白天自然光下的日常出游感，带旧照片的怀旧与轻松。
cards.why: 轻松自然的氛围降低距离感，让用户愿意停留并联想自己的旧照。

spec: 小号数字，横向占画面约三分之一

cards.label: Hook
cards.why: There is no readable text in the image at all; it relies entirely on a wedding-banquet photo that looks like a re-shot old film to make people believe it first, then look back at the title.
alts: Large white question sentence at the top
Add a date corner mark at the bottom right

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: A single full-frame photo, no panels, no border, filling the whole screen
cards.why: The whole frame is not divided into panels, like a single photo pulled out of an album, which feels more like a real old photo than a carefully designed layout.
alts: Diptych: original image versus film-filter version
Four-panel collage of multiple banquet photos
Full frame with a handwritten date corner mark

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Large areas of red clothing as the absolute dominant colour, with dark formal wear and off-white tablecloth anchoring the image
cards.why: The clash of red and dark colours is the visual memory of a Chinese wedding banquet, pinning down the period feel at a glance.
alts: Warm brown and off-white, with red only as an accent
Cool grey-blue tone, weakening the red

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: Two people standing side by side in the centre of the frame, each with a red flower on the chest, with several people seated around a table in the foreground
cards.why: The two standing side by side are framed by the backs of people seated around a table, like a moment caught casually, more believable than a posed shot.
alts: Shoot only a table of dishes and liquor bottles
Shoot only a close-up of the red flower on the chest
Shoot a full view of the banquet crowd

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Warm yellow fading, grain and scratch feel, with the noisy nostalgia of a banquet scene
cards.why: Fading and grain fill in the conclusion of "old photo" for the viewer; the emotion arrives before the judgement.

spec: A red banner in the upper left, with blurred writing on it
Does not rely on text; uses the image itself to create doubt about whether it is real
Overall warm yellow, with red the brightest and most eye-catching
Grain and scratch feel, soft edges
A faded keepsake from a noisy banquet

cards.label: 钩子
cards.why: 画面里没有任何可读文字，全靠一张像旧胶片翻拍的喜宴照让人先信了它，再回头看标题。
alts: 加一行手写「一九八七」标注

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 单张整幅照片，无分格、无边框，铺满一屏
cards.why: 整幅不分格像相册里抽出来的一张，比排版精致的图更像真实旧照。
alts: 双联：原图对胶片滤镜版

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 大片红衣为绝对主色，深色礼服与米白桌布压住画面
cards.why: 红与深色对撞是中式喜宴的视觉记忆，一眼就把年代感钉住。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 画面中间两人并立，胸前各有一朵红花，前景有数人围桌而坐
cards.why: 并立的两人被围桌的背影框住，像被随手抓拍的一刻，比摆拍可信。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 暖黄褪色、颗粒与划痕感，带着宴席现场的喧闹怀旧气
cards.why: 褪色和颗粒替观众补上「老照片」的结论，情绪先于判断到达。

spec: 左上方红色条幅，其上字迹模糊
不靠文字，靠画面本身制造真假疑问
整体暖黄，红色最亮最抢眼
颗粒与划痕感，边缘发虚

Central concept: 围绕“GraniphSummerF…”提炼一个单一视觉隐喻，避免把全文信息塞进画面。 Style: preserve the reference cover's visual direction: 高饱和海报/科技广告视觉. Use a palette inspired by #26bec9 (teal), #155056 (charcoal), #85d58d (gray), #26bec8 (teal). Keep the image editorial, conceptual, and readable as a small WeChat thumbnail. Composition: 中等密度，适合一个主视觉隐喻配少量标题文字。 Keep the main subject and any essential title text inside the safe square crop, while using the full wide frame for atmosphere, secondary symbols, or directional motion. Text strategy: use either no text or a very short headline fragment from the title. If text is used, make it large, clean, and integrated into the layout rather than pasted on top. Mood: match the article skill "GraniphSummerFestival2…风格双技能" -- useful, sharp, high-signal, and slightly more memorable than a normal tutorial thumbnail. Avoid: photorealistic clutter unless the source cover is photo-led, fake logos, unreadable tiny text, generic gradient blobs, stock-office imagery, watermark-like marks, and literal screenshots unless the article is explicitly about software interfaces.

Two people sitting side by side
A close-up of a pet in the center of the frame

A three-part layout with a small image above and a large one below
A four-grid layout with multiple comparison sets

cards.label: Color Palette

cards.why: The gap between monochrome and color is the largest, and the skin tones in the bottom panel pop out right away, strengthening the impression of a successful restoration.
alts: Keep both top and bottom in sepia tones
Increase the weight of warm orange in the bottom panel
Switch to a cyan-blue cool-tone restoration

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: The same three-person half-body photo in the panels, wearing hats and buttoned jackets, appearing once each in the top and bottom panels
cards.why: The same group of people appears repeatedly, so viewers naturally compare details panel by panel; the longer they look, the more likely they are to save it.
alts: Only include a single-person close-up comparison
Switch to a family group portrait
Change the subject to an elderly person

cards.label: Mood

alts: Make it a sad nostalgic copy style
Change it to a tutorial-step style
Make it a conversational question style

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: 直接 / 迂回
cards.why: Use a pair of antonyms to directly present the core contradiction, letting people instantly compare and feel recognition or the urge to share.
alts: The two poles of communication styles
One sentence that hits a workplace pain point

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Two equal-width comparison images on the left and right, blue on the left and red on the right, separated by a vertical line in the middle.
cards.why: A symmetrical contrast structure makes the difference obvious at a glance, so readers understand instantly without thinking.
alts: A vertical line dividing the two halves

cards.label: Color Palette
cards.value: The left side is mainly blue, the right side is mainly red-orange, forming a cool-warm opposition.
cards.why: Blue represents smooth efficiency, red represents chaos and obstruction; the colors themselves convey emotional value.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: On the left, a man and a woman with a large blue arrow; on the right, four people entangled in red messy lines.
cards.why: The combination of people and arrows is highly narrative, showing at a glance the complexity of the two communication paths.
alts: Two pairs of people in comparison

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: The left side is relaxed and smooth, the right side is chaotic and anxious.
cards.why: The strong emotional contrast makes people associate it with their own work scenarios, sparking comments and saves.

spec: Top center-left in blue, right in red
Thin vertical line in the middle
Two people, large blue arrow, speech bubbles
Four people, red tangled lines, question marks

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: 直接 / 迂回
cards.why: 用一对反义词直接抛出核心矛盾，让人瞬间对比并产生认同或转发冲动。

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 左右各一幅等宽对比图，左蓝右红，中间竖线分隔。
cards.why: 对称的对比结构让差异一目了然，读者无需思考就能秒懂。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 左侧以蓝色为主，右侧以红橙色为主，形成冷暖对立。
cards.why: 蓝代表顺畅高效，红代表混乱受阻，色彩本身就在传递情绪价值。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 左侧男女二人与蓝色大箭头；右侧四人被红色乱线缠绕。
cards.why: 人物加箭头的组合故事性强，一眼看出两种沟通路径的复杂程度。
alts: 简单箭头 vs 复杂绳结

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 左侧轻松通畅，右侧混乱焦躁。
cards.why: 强烈的情绪反差让人联想到自己的工作场景，激发评论和收藏。

spec: 顶部居中偏左蓝字，偏右红字
男女二人、蓝色大箭头、对话框
四人、红色缠绕线条、问号
A 与 B 字母标记

cards.label: Color Scheme

cards.label: Hook
cards.why: The blank space lets readers fill in the icons with familiar AI brands themselves, creating the suspense of "which three is this about?" and the urge to click.
alts: Add question marks on the back icons to create a guessing-game effect
Add a very short headline at the top
Replace the three icons with clearly recognizable symbols

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: A single large horizontal image, no panels; the figures are centered and occupy the middle, with sky and distant mountains filling the full frame
cards.why: A 16:9 banner feels open and calm in the feed, making it suitable as a long-article cover without stealing attention from the body text.
alts: Turn the left and right margins into text-safe areas
Change the rule-of-thirds composition to a centered symmetrical close-up

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: High-brightness blue sky and cyan-green dominate; the three figures use purple-blue, bright blue, and orange-yellow to form a triangular color contrast
cards.why: A cool-toned environment with three contrasting warm and cool blocks keeps the image clean and distinct, and it stays clearly readable as a phone thumbnail.
alts: Unify the whole image in a single blue tone
Change to a deep-night purple-blue starry background
Use red, yellow, and blue primary colors for the figures

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: Three cloaked figures seen from behind sit cross-legged at the edge of a cliff, each with a white symbol on their back
cards.why: Backs turned and faces unseen make it easier to project yourself into the scene, and the "looking into the distance side by side" pose naturally conveys comparison and shared exploration.
alts: Change to three small robots side by side
Change to three small cats seen from behind, side by side
Change to three people standing at a fork in the road

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Clear sky, distant mountains and thin mist, bright and soft; overall quiet and open with a slight sense of adventure
cards.why: The feeling of "looking at the view after crossing mountains" lets readers experience a money-saving guide as a journey, making them more likely to save it.
alts: Change to a warm sunrise horizon
Change to a morning with rolling seas of clouds
Change to silhouettes under a starry night sky

spec: One on each of the three figures' backs
Trigger the association of "which three are they?"
About the upper 1/3 of the image

xray.short: Three cloaked figures seen from behind
spec: Sitting cross-legged, backs to the viewer
One white pattern on each back

xray.short: Gazing into the distance under a clear sky
spec: Layered mountains with a misty feel

cards.label: 钩子
cards.why: 留白让读者自己把图标代入到常见的 AI 品牌，产生“这是在说哪三家”的悬念和点击冲动。
alts: 在背部图标上加问号制造竞猜
顶部加一行极短标题文字
把三个图标换成明确可识别符号

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 单幅横向大图，无分格；人物居中占中段，天空与远山铺满全幅
cards.why: 16:9 横幅在信息流里视野开阔、氛围安静，适合作为长文封面而不抢正文注意力。
alts: 左右留白改为文字安全区
三分构图改为居中对称特写

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 高明度蓝天青绿为主，三个人物用紫蓝、亮蓝、橙黄形成三角色对比
cards.why: 冷色大环境配三块暖冷撞色，画面干净又有区分度，缩略图在手机上依然清晰可辨。
alts: 改为深夜紫蓝星空底色

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 三个披斗篷的背影盘坐于山崖边，背部分别有一个白色符号
cards.why: 背影不露脸更易代入，“并排看远方”的姿态天然传达对比与共同探索。
alts: 改为三个并排的小机器人
改为三只并排的小猫背影
改为三个人站在岔路口

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 晴空、远山薄雾、明亮柔和，整体安静开阔而带一点冒险感
cards.why: “翻山越岭后看风景”的情绪让读者把省钱指南读成一段旅程，更愿意收藏。
alts: 改为日出暖光的地平线
改为夜色星空下的剪影

spec: 背部各有一个白色图案

Mark the saved portion in red

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Two horizontal progress bars stacked top and bottom, a square icon centered in the middle, and a diagonal dotted downward arrow on the right
cards.why: A top-middle-bottom vertical reading flow with an arrow strings the "result" and the "method" into a process that can be understood at a glance.

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Mainly white background, progress bars with dark gray outlines, blue fill, icon in a blue-purple gradient
cards.why: A white background with a small amount of blue keeps the image clean and restrained, like a system interface screenshot, making readers more likely to believe it is real data.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A centered rounded square icon containing a cloud shape and a ">_" symbol, with Codex written below
cards.why: The icon is the visual anchor of the whole piece, letting people identify at a glance which tool is being discussed.

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Clean, calm, minimalist tech product diagram style
cards.why: No extra decoration, conveying "this is a rational technical person's real test," which boosts the credibility of tutorial content.
alts: Add a bit of hand-drawn doodling
Change to dark terminal interface style

spec: Small gray text at the right end of the progress bars
Stacked top and bottom, icon centered, arrow on the right pointing diagonally down

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 白底为主，深灰描边的进度条，蓝色填充，图标用蓝紫渐变
cards.why: 白底加少量蓝色让画面干净克制，像系统界面截图，读者更容易相信是真实数据。

cards.label: 主体

cards.value: Claude Agent Memory in 12 Steps

cards.label: Layout

cards.why: The symmetrical structure of text on the left and table on the right lets the eye be caught by the title first, then quickly scan all twelve steps along the grid.

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Cream white background, bold black title, orange numbers and highlight blocks, thin red connecting lines
cards.why: The orange-and-black clash creates high contrast on a light background, looking both professional and not dull, fitting the practical-sharing tone.
alts: Low-saturation warm base with bright orange

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: Title text with twelve-step table and icon symbols (portrait, file, database, speech bubble, circular arrow, etc.)
cards.why: Icons make abstract concepts concrete, so readers can map each stage's function at a glance.

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Clean, systematic, actionable tutorial feel, with light handwritten marks and doodle accents
cards.why: Hand-drawn-style check marks and doodles make hardcore technical content feel approachable and easy to read, increasing save rate.

spec: Upper left of the image, occupying about 30% of the left width
"12 Steps" is orange, with an orange hand-drawn highlight bar beneath it
Left title area about 35% wide, right table area about 65% wide
Right side is a 4-row by 3-column grid of 12 step cells
Four stage labels across the top: SETUP / STORE / RECALL / IMPROVE
Four equal-height rows, separated by thin lines
#E8862E orange, used for numbers and highlights
Four large icons -- portrait, file, speech bubble, bullseye -- corresponding to four memory dimensions
Each cell contains a small icon and explanatory text
Numbers 1-12 in orange circles run through the twelve cells
Hand-drawn asterisks and short arcs beneath the title

cards.value: Claude Agent Memory in 12 Steps

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 左侧大标题区，右侧4行3列共12格步骤表，整体左右分栏
cards.why: 左文右表的对称结构让眼睛先被标题抓住，再顺着网格快速扫完十二步。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 米白底、黑色粗标题、橙色数字与高亮块、细红线连接

cards.label: 主体

cards.label: 氛围

cards.why: 手写感的勾线与涂鸦让硬核技术内容显得亲切、易读，提高收藏率。

“12 Steps”为橙色，下有一道橙色手绘高亮条

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: How to Turn an IB-Grade / Hermes Into Finance Analyst
cards.why: The mismatched collage of long English phrases creates a cognitive gap, making people want to click and see how exactly Hermes becomes a financial analyst.

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: A single full-screen black-and-white illustration, with English titles on both sides split into left and right columns by the centered figure, and a white curve running from bottom-left to bottom-right.
cards.why: The symmetric structure with text on both sides framing a central figure forces the eye to lock onto the middle; by the time both sides are read, the whole image has been seen.
alts: Two-column split with text left and image right
Poster style with all text centered

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Pure black background + white handwritten type and line-art figure, with only one white line as visual guidance and no third color.
cards.why: Extremely high-contrast black and white makes people stop at a glance in the feed; it feels cold, professional, and carries the pressure of a financial report.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A centered standing line-art figure with short black hair, a white shirt, and a black suit, with facial features of brows and eyes, and no background details.
cards.why: The neutral, cold-faced figure works like a relatable "analyst" symbol, making it easy for readers to project themselves into it.
alts: Figure scaled down and placed bottom-right
Only draw a hand holding a pen

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: A cold, restrained, slightly oppressive financial workplace temperament, created through black-and-white contrast and simple lines.
cards.why: The seriousness of "investment-banking-grade" makes the tutorial feel credible, and readers are willing to save it as a tool post.

spec: How to Turn an IB-Grade / Hermes Into Finance Analyst
Both sides of the figure, two lines left and two lines right
Left text — center person — right text
A white curve running across the bottom
Outlined in white lines, white shirt filled white, coat black
Short hair, brows and eyes, suit silhouette
Figure looks slightly down, gaze directed downward

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: How to Turn an IB-Grade / Hermes Into Finance Analyst
cards.why: 错位拼接的英文长句制造认知缺口，让人想点开看看到底怎么把 Hermes 变成金融分析师。

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 单幅全屏黑白插画，两侧英文标题被人物居中分割成左右两栏，一条白色曲线从左下贯穿到右下。
cards.why: 左右文字夹住中心人物的对称结构，视线被强制锁在中间，读完两边文字正好看完画。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 纯黑底 + 白色手写字体与线稿人物，仅一条白线做视觉引导，无第三色。
cards.why: 极高对比的黑白让人在信息流里一眼停住，冷、专业、有金融报告的压迫感。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 一个居中站立的人物线稿，黑色短发、白衬衫黑西装，面部带眉眼，无背景细节。
cards.why: 中性冷脸人物像一个可代入的“分析师”符号，读者容易把自己投射进去。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 冷峻、克制、略带压迫感的金融职场气质，靠黑白反差和简洁线条营造。
cards.why: “投行级”的严肃感让教程显得可信，读者愿意收藏当工具帖。

人物两侧，左两行右两行

Creative direction: meme template Method: preserve the original template structure, conflict, eye-line, and reversal timing while replacing the situation with an English-language social insight. Please output: 1. A concise English title and subtitle for social posting; 2. 2-4 short English caption lines that can be placed directly on the meme; 3. A visual prompt for image generation or image editing, covering subject, composition, typography, stickers, and whitespace; 4. Posting advice: use case, hashtags, and engagement hook. Constraints: do not recreate a real person's identity, trademark, or watermark; do not claim source authorization; when keeping the source image, use it only as a composition reference.

cards.label: Palette

alts: Dark background setting off the old photo

cards.label: Subject

cards.why: A genuinely damaged physical photo proves it is a real old photo better than any text.

Photo laid flat on a table, shot from above
Only the photo, no hands visible

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Nostalgic yet restrained, the tone of longing and request outweighs the image itself
cards.why: Restrained remembrance is the easiest way to get help, comments and reposts.

Background colour of the upper text area
Off-white border of the old photo
The portrait and background in the old photo
Soft and even, no obvious shadows

sourcePrompt.en: Refer to the content structure, first-image hook, visual pacing, and posting tone of the case study "I'm back! New topic: {fill in the topic you want to generate} Reference platform: Xiaohongshu Content direction: mystical energy image-text Creation method: keep the original case's emotional reassurance, sense of ritual, and save motivation; in expression, avoid promising outcomes, and write the content as spiritual support and action reminders. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. A 6-8 page image-text script, each page including scene description, main copy, information points, and interaction/save actions; 3. Visual prompts that can be used directly for image generation, specifying subject, scene, lighting, composition, font or layout; 4.
