cards.label: Hook
cards.value: I Connected Claude to Obsidian 90 Days Ago.
cards.why: First person + a specific number of days turns tool integration into a verifiable personal experiment, making people want to know the result.
alts: What changed after I used it for 90 days
The result of connecting two tools
A real-world report with a specific number of days

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Full dark background; icon process on the top half, two lines of text stacked and centered on the bottom half
cards.why: Image and text are split top and bottom, giving the process first and the conclusion second, so readers grasp the structure at a glance.
alts: Two columns with image left and text right
Three icons in a row plus a title
Large title in the center with small text at the bottom

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Mainly black background, with purple and orange highlighting key words and icons
cards.why: Two bright colors on a dark background correspond to the two tools, visually reinforcing the idea of "connection."
alts: Dark blue background with cyan-green accents
Gray background with a single red accent

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A purple polyhedron on the left, an orange radial shape in the middle, a line drawing of a head and brain on the right, connected by dashed lines
cards.why: Two abstract symbols plus a connecting line in the middle express "connecting A to B" without needing words.
alts: Two icons plus a plus sign
Two circles left and right plus a connecting line

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Calm, rational, tech-leaning dark tech style
cards.why: Dark colors plus white space make the content feel like a serious retrospective rather than a casual share.

spec: I Connected Claude to Obsidian / 90 Days Ago. / Here Is What Happened to How I Work.
Centered in the lower half of the frame: first line on top, second line slightly larger and centered, third line smallest at the bottom
The word Claude is orange, the word Obsidian is purple
A thin purple underline beneath the second line
Graphic process in the top half, text block in the bottom half
Graphics and text are both horizontally centered
Even dark whitespace around the edges, tight line spacing inside the text block
Three graphics + two dashed lines + three lines of text

xray.short: Black background with purple and orange
spec: Around #8A5CF6 purple, used for the left polyhedron and Obsidian
Around #E2703A orange, used for the central radial shape and Claude
High contrast, bright text on a dark background
White line drawing of a human head, with line texture inside the brain
Two dashed lines made of small dots, from left to center and center to right
No gradients or light effects, pure flat color
Like the opening of a real-world test retrospective
Purple represents the tool, orange represents intelligence, and the black background emphasizes the conclusion

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: I Connected Claude to Obsidian 90 Days Ago.
cards.why: 第一人称 + 具体天数，把工具整合变成一段可验证的个人实验，让人想知道结果。
alts: 我用了90天后发生的变化
把两个工具连起来的结果

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 深色整幅；上方图标流程占上半，下方两行文字居中堆叠
cards.why: 图文上下分区，先给流程再给结论，读者一眼就懂结构。
alts: 中央大标题加底部小字

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 黑底为主，紫色与橙色点出关键词和图标
cards.why: 深底上两个亮色分别对应两个工具，视觉上强化“连接”这件事。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 左侧紫色多面体、中间橙色放射形、右侧头与脑线条图，虚线相连
cards.why: 两个抽象符号加中间连接线，无需文字就能表达“把A接到B”。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 冷静、理性、偏技术感的暗色科技风
cards.why: 暗色加留白让内容显得像一次认真复盘，而不是随手分享。

spec: I Connected Claude to Obsidian / 90 Days Ago. / Here Is What Happened to How I Work.
画面下半部居中，第一行在上、第二行略大居中、第三行最小在下
Claude 一词为橙色，Obsidian 一词为紫色
第二行下方有一条紫色细下划线
上半部图形流程，下半部文字块
图形与文字均水平居中
四周均匀深色留白，文字块内部行距紧凑
三个图形 + 两段虚线 + 三行文字
#8A5CF6 左右紫色，用于左侧多面体与 Obsidian
#E2703A 左右橙色，用于中间放射形与 Claude
白色线条人头，脑内为线条纹理
两段由小圆点组成的虚线，从左到中、中到右
像一次实测复盘的开场
紫代表工具，橙代表智能，黑底突出结论

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: skill.md / best_skill.md
cards.why: The two filenames placed side by side create a strong contrast, instantly capturing the theme of evolution "from casual to standardized."

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Three columns left, center, right, with notebooks on the left and right and a cycle diagram in the center, width about 1:1:1
cards.why: The three-part structure makes "problem-mechanism-result" clear at a glance, suitable for screenshot sharing.
alts: Left-right symmetry + small image in the middle

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Off-white background + black line art + red and green accents
cards.why: Red and green form strong signals on a low-saturation background; red means wrong, green means right, understood at a glance.
alts: All black and white plus blue

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A cycle flowchart in the center, with four small portraits around it
cards.why: Use a cycle diagram to explain the mechanism, and people add friendliness, making technical concepts less dull.

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Hand-drawn draft feel, study-notes style relaxed but serious
cards.why: The draft feel lowers the reading barrier, making people feel "I can learn this too," increasing saves.

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: skill.md / best_skill.md
cards.why: 两个文件名并置形成强烈对照，让人瞬间抓住“从随意到规范”的进化主题。

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 左中右三栏，左右为笔记本，中间是循环图，宽度约1:1:1
cards.why: 三段式结构让“问题—机制—结果”一目了然，适合截图传播。
alts: 左右对称 + 中间小图

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 米白底 + 黑线稿 + 红绿点睛
cards.why: 低饱和底色上红绿形成强信号，红色代表错、绿色代表对，一眼理解。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 中间一张循环流程图，四周有四个人物小像
cards.why: 用循环图讲机制，人物增加亲切感，让技术概念不枯燥。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 手绘草稿感，学习笔记式的轻松但认真
cards.why: 草稿感降低阅读门槛，让人觉得“我也能学会”，提升收藏欲。

cards.label: Hook
cards.why: On a cover with no text, the person's closed-eyed smile directly triggers the audience's emotional resonance with food and warmth, making them unable to resist pausing.
alts: Add a short handwritten line of dialogue
Place the title above the bread
Use the moment of tearing open the bread as the subject

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Single horizontal composition, close-up person on the left, group portrait and window view in the right distance, with front, middle, and back layers stacked
cards.why: The three-layer depth in the wide banner makes the image read like a film frame, suitable for a WeChat lead image where information unfolds layer by layer afterward.
alts: Stack two layers top and bottom
Center the person in the middle

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Mainly beige, milk white, and light blue, accented with warm orange-brown bread, low-saturation watercolor feel
cards.why: The low-saturation warm tones make the image feel quiet and healing, while the warm orange bread becomes the only focal color, naturally drawing the gaze.
alts: Cool gray-blue tones with warm light

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: An old person eating bread in bed and, in the foreground, a bitten-open bun with a molten center on a plate
cards.why: The person and food appear together, binding the action of "eating" with the emotion of "being cared for," which is more moving than shooting food alone.
alts: Only a close-up of the bread
A family sitting around the dining table

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: A warm, peaceful, everyday healing atmosphere with a faint sense of nostalgia
cards.why: Soft light and a calm expression create a sense of safety, soothing readers emotionally and making them willing to like, save, or forward it to someone they miss.

spec: The person's closed-eyed smile and expression while biting the bread
Middle ground on the left side of the image, starting at about 8% horizontally
Wooden tabletop and white plate with bread at the lower right, about the lower-right 1/3 of the image
Person on the bed at the left, about the left 1/3
The backs of four people by the window on the right, plus curtains and sky
An older person in round glasses, sitting propped up under a blanket, holding bread with both hands
A bun on a white round plate, bitten open to reveal a pale yellow filling
A glass bottle with a few small flowers and grass on the bedside table
Soft natural light coming in from the window on the right, with no harsh shadows
Overall low-saturation warm tones, with lots of negative space

cards.label: 钩子
cards.why: 没有文字的封面上，人物闭眼微笑的表情直接触发观众对美食与温暖的情绪共鸣，让人忍不住停留。
alts: 用撕开面包的瞬间做主体

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 单幅横构图，左近景人物、右远景群像与窗景，前中后三层叠加
cards.why: 长横幅三层景深让画面读起来像一帧电影，适合做公众号首图后信息层层展开。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 米黄、奶白、浅蓝为主，面包用暖橙棕点缀，低饱和水彩感
cards.why: 低饱和暖调让画面显得安静治愈，暖橙的面包成为唯一焦点色，视线自然被吸过去。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 床上吃面包的老人与前景盘中被咬开、流心的面包
cards.why: 人物与食物同时出现，把“吃”这个动作和“被照顾”的情感绑在一起，比单拍食物更打动人。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 温暖、宁静、带淡淡怀念感的日常治愈氛围
cards.why: 柔光与平静表情制造安全感，读者在情绪上被抚慰，愿意点赞、收藏或转发给想念的人。

spec: 人物闭眼微笑、正咬面包的神情
画面左侧中景，约横向 8% 起始处
右下木质桌面与白盘面包，约占画面右下 1/3
左侧床上人物，约占左侧 1/3
右侧窗前四个人物背影与窗帘、天空
一位戴圆框眼镜的老人，盖被坐靠，双手捧着面包
白色圆盘上一个被咬开、露出淡黄内馅的面包
床头柜玻璃瓶插着几枝小花与草
从右侧窗户洒入的柔和自然光，无强烈阴影
整体低饱和暖调，留白多

cards.value: AI DENSITY & PER CAPITA POWER / HARDWARE AUTONOMY & SCALING / AI INNOVATION & VENTURE CAPITAL
cards.why: Three parallel large English words throw out a conclusion-style label directly, making readers want to know at a glance which pole they belong to.
alts: Change to a question for more interaction

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Three equal left-center-right flag platforms, flags above, devices and labels below, city background spread horizontally across the whole frame
cards.why: The symmetrical rule of thirds lays out the three-way comparison information all at once, naturally creating a psychology of comparison visually.
alts: Make it a top-middle-bottom three-layer comparison
Change to two columns left and right

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Cold blue city background plus neon green, red-orange and cyan-blue light effects, marking the three zones respectively
cards.why: The three-color light effects echo the flag colors, looking professional with the on-site feel of a tech launch event.
alts: Use gold and red for more intensity

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: Three flags planted on three glowing tech display stands, each with chips, solar panels and a robotic arm, or circuit board models
cards.why: Turning abstract AI strength into comparable physical objects lowers the barrier to understanding and makes it easy for readers to screenshot and discuss.
alts: Use map outlines instead of flags

cards.label: Mood

Central concept: visualize abstract tool capabilities as interface windows, code snippets, node networks, control panels, AI workflows, or a glowing system core. Style: preserve the reference cover's visual direction: black-and-white or low-saturation editorial illustration/photo. Text strategy: use either no text or a very short headline fragment from the title. If text is used, make it large, clean, and integrated into the layout rather than pasted on top. Style Dual Skill" -- useful, sharp, high-signal, and slightly more memorable than a normal tutorial thumbnail. Avoid: photorealistic clutter unless the source cover is photo-led, fake logos, unreadable tiny text, generic gradient blobs, stock-office imagery, watermark-like marks, and literal screenshots unless the article is explicitly about software interfaces.

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: もし大谷翔平が サラリーマンの世界線を歩んでいたら どのように成功していたのか
cards.why: Hypothetically casting a top athlete as an office worker creates a strong contrast and curiosity, making people click to see the answer.
alts: Lead directly with a conclusion number

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Split vertically into two equal left and right halves, separated by a white torn-paper gap in the middle, with text pressed into the lower-left area
cards.why: The symmetrical two-panel structure creates contrasting tension, letting viewers first grasp the "two lives" visually before reading the text.
alts: Single large figure with a sidebar

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Mainly black-and-white halftone comic grayscale, with text in white on a blue background plus a yellow outline
cards.why: Grayscale unifies the image texture, while bright blue-yellow text pops out from the gray background and grabs attention immediately.
alts: Pure black-and-white with no colored text

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: Left panel: a person wearing a cap and holding a baseball bat; right panel: a person in a suit and tie standing by a window
cards.why: The two figures directly correspond to the two identities of "athlete" and "office worker," making the content understandable at a glance.
alts: Draw only one person in two looks
Zoom in on a facial close-up

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Shonen manga passion set alongside urban calm, with a touch of hypothetical narrative suspense
cards.why: The emotional contrast lets people imagine the "what if," sparking comments and shares.

xray.short: White text on blue at left
spec: Three lines mixing Japanese kana and kanji
Lower left of the image, about half the width
Throws out a hypothetical question hook
Vertical white torn-paper gap in the middle
Pressed into the lower part of the left panel
White text on blue with yellow edge
Person wearing a baseball cap, holding a bat with both hands
Person in a suit and tie
Speed lines on the left, window and city buildings on the right
Black-and-white comic halftone and speed lines
A sense of suspense combining hypothetical and contrast

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: もし大谷翔平が サラリーマンの世界線を歩んでいたら どのように成功していたのか
cards.why: 把顶级运动员假设成上班族，制造强烈反差与好奇，让人忍不住点开看答案。

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 左右两等分竖切，中间白色撕裂缝分隔，文字压在左下角区域
cards.why: 对称双格形成对比张力，视觉上先看懂“两种人生”再读文字。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 黑白网点漫画灰阶为主，文字用蓝底白字加黄描边
cards.why: 灰阶统一画面质感，亮蓝黄字从灰底里跳出来，第一时间抓住视线。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 左格一人戴帽持棒球棍，右格一人穿西装打领带站在窗前
cards.why: 两个人物形象直接对应“运动员”与“上班族”两个身份，一眼读懂内容。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 热血漫画感与都市冷静感并置，带一点假设性的叙事悬念
cards.why: 情绪反差让人代入“如果”的想象，激发评论与转发讨论。

spec: 三行日文假名与汉字混排
戴棒球帽、双手持棍的人
左为速度线，右为窗与城市楼
黑白漫画网点与速度线
假设与反差并存的悬念感

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: 有这8种感觉 / 请立刻休息
cards.why: Numbers plus imperative phrasing create urgency, making people worry they're affected and stop scrolling.
alts: Turn it into a question: How many did you hit?
Make it a countdown: #3 is the deadliest
Add a reversed statement: Stop pushing through

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Single vertical image layout: two lines of large title, one line of small parenthetical text, a large square illustration area below, and one line of credit at the bottom
cards.why: The title takes the top third, the illustration fills the visual weight, and information reads top to bottom effortlessly.
alts: Center the title over the top of the illustration
Two columns: text left, image right
Put text at the bottom with white space on top

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Deep purple title, black small text, light purple background with a pink cartoon character and black outlines
cards.why: Low-saturation purple-pink feels gentle and healing; the deep purple title has strong contrast on a light background and catches the eye from afar.
alts: Switch to off-white with ink green
Cream yellow with dark brown text
Misty blue background with white text

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A pink cartoon humanoid character with multiple diagonal lines on its head, tongue sticking out, limbs splayed and toppled over
cards.why: The exaggerated collapsed cartoon figure makes "worn out" concrete, making it easier to relate to and share than a real photo.
alts: A cartoon character slumped over a desk
A dumpling-like character in a blanket
A simple stick figure lying flat

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: A light, self-deprecating tiredness; the soft light purple background keeps the image from feeling oppressive
cards.why: Making "tired" cute rather than heavy lets readers smile and become more willing to save and share.

xray.short: Two lines of bold purple large title
spec: If You Feel These 8 Things / Go Rest Right Now
Top of the image, two lines centered slightly left
Sans-serif bold, deep purple, extra-large size
One line of small parenthetical text, black, below the main title

xray.short: Single-column structure with text on top and image below
spec: 4 blocks: large title, parenthetical small text, square illustration area, bottom credit
Two title lines take about the top 1/3, the square illustration takes about the middle 1/2
Even left and right margins; the illustration is about 5% from the left and right edges
Pink cartoon humanoid with diagonal lines on the head, tongue out, limbs splayed
An illustration pose that is tilted and unsteady
Thick black outlines, flat color blocks
Located in the light purple square area in the lower-middle part of the image
Light, self-deprecating, a reminder to rest
No realistic light and shadow, pure flat color
Express tiredness in a cute rather than heavy way
Cover mood for health-reminder image-text posts

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: 有这8种感觉 / 请立刻休息
cards.why: 数字加命令式句式制造紧迫感，让人担心自己中招而停下划动。
alts: 改成倒计时式：第3条最致命

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 单图竖向排布：两行大标题、一行括号小字说明、下方一个大方形插画区、底部一行署名
cards.why: 标题占上方三分之一，插画补足视觉重心，信息从上到下顺读不费力。
alts: 标题居中压住插画顶部

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 深紫标题、黑色小字、浅紫底色配粉色卡通角色与黑色描边
cards.why: 低饱和紫粉显得温柔疗愈，深紫标题在浅底上对比强，远看也抓眼。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 一个粉色卡通人形角色，头部有多条斜线纹，吐着舌，四肢张开歪倒状
cards.why: 夸张瘫倒的卡通形象把“累趴”具象化，比真人照片更容易被代入和转发。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 轻松自嘲式的疲惫感，柔和浅紫底让画面不压抑
cards.why: 把“累”做成可爱而非沉重，读者会心一笑后更愿意收藏和转发。

spec: 有这8种感觉 / 请立刻休息
画面顶部，两行居中偏左
无衬线粗体，深紫色，字号极大
括号小字一行，黑色，位于大标题下方
4 块：大标题、括号小字、方形插画区、底部署名
标题两行约占上方 1/3，插画方形约占中部 1/2
左右留白均匀，插画左右贴边约 5%
粉色卡通人形，头部斜线纹、吐舌、四肢张开
歪斜站不稳的插画造型
位于画面中下方浅紫色方形区域内
把疲惫表达得可爱而不沉重
健康提醒类图文的封面氛围

sourcePrompt.en: Referencing the gentle expression, white-space ratio, and sense of companionship in the image-text post "If You Feel These 8 Things, Go Rest Right Now," generate a new set of emotional healing themes: title "7 Small Actions to Slowly Nurture Yourself Back," subtitle "A gentle recovery checklist you can follow even during low periods." Please output a cover hook, 6 content cards, and an ending save prompt; each page should include one empathetic line and one actionable step.
sourcePrompt.zh-CN: 参考图文《有这8种感觉，请立刻去休息》的温柔表达、留白比例和陪伴感，生成一组新的情绪疗愈主题：标题《7个把自己慢慢养回来的小动作》，副标题“低谷期也能照着做的温柔恢复清单”。请输出封面钩子、6 页内容卡和结尾收藏引导，每页都给一句共情话和一个可执行动作。

cards.label: Hook
cards.why: The black-and-white unknown deep forest and the lone figure walking away create suspense, making people want to click in to find the answer.
alts: Add a large suspenseful question headline
Use large text to break open the key word
Keep only one small text label

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: A single full-bleed horizontal image, with a path in the center leading to a black opening
cards.why: The centered, symmetrical tunnel-like composition pushes the eye straight toward the blank center, stretching dwell time.
alts: Two columns with image on the left and text on the right
Central circular crop with negative space

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Pure black-and-white high contrast, using only line density to distinguish levels
cards.why: The strong contrast stands out sharply in the feed, while the black-and-white tone feels restrained and premium.
alts: Black and white with a touch of fluorescent color
White lines on a deep blue background
Ink-black lines on an off-white background

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A person facing away from the camera, wearing clothing with a backpack, standing on a path in dense woods
cards.why: The turned back lets readers instantly project themselves into it, and the image of walking into the unknown naturally matches themes of exploration and growth.
alts: Switch to a climber's side profile
Switch to an abstract figure standing alone

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Mysterious, quiet, slightly lonely sense of exploration
cards.why: The restrained yet oppressive atmosphere evokes curiosity and resonance, suitable for talking about long-term persistence and self-exploration.

spec: Dense woods on both sides form a centered passage
The central black blank area forms the focal point

xray.short: A person facing away from the camera
spec: One person facing away from the camera, with clear head and shoulder contours
Clothing with a backpack silhouette, with horizontal stripes on the arms and legs
Slightly left of center, facing the central dark area
No obvious light source, overall low brightness

cards.label: 钩子
cards.why: 黑白的未知深林与独行背影制造悬念，让人想点进去寻找答案。
alts: 加一句大标题悬念问句

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 单幅满版横图，中心一条小路通向黑色洞口
cards.why: 居中对称的隧道式构图把视线直接压向中央空白，停留时间被拉长。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 纯黑白高对比，仅用线条疏密区分层次
cards.why: 强对比在信息流里极其醒目，黑白色调又显得克制、有高级感。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 一个背对镜头、穿带背包服装的人物站在密林小路上
cards.why: 背影让读者自动代入成自己，走向未知的意象天然对应探索与成长主题。
alts: 换成独自站立的抽象人体

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 神秘、沉静、略带孤独的探索感
cards.why: 克制而压抑的氛围唤起好奇心与共鸣，适合讲长期坚持与自我探索。

spec: 两侧密林夹出一条居中通道
中央黑色空白形成焦点
一人背对镜头，头部与肩部轮廓清晰
带有背包轮廓的服装，手臂与腿部有横向条纹
画面正中偏左，面向中央黑暗区域
无明显光源，整体低明度

sourcePrompt.en: Referencing the old photo restoration approach, era texture, visual storytelling and posting tone of the case study "Image generated by gpt image2 (image tutorial on homepage)", generate a new set of retro old photo image-text content. New topic: {fill in the photo topic you want to restore, rebuild or recreate} Reference platform: Xiaohongshu Content direction: retro old photo image-text Creation method: keep the nostalgic emotion, film/photo paper texture, character relationships, era feel of the scene and restoration constraints of the original case; if it is photo restoration, it must stay faithful to the original image's identity, facial features, composition and historical context, avoiding excessive beauty filters, redrawing, false historical information and modern digital plastic feel. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. A 6-9 page image-text script, each page including scene description, main copy, era/texture keywords and a save prompt; 3. Visual prompts that can be used directly for image generation or photo restoration, explaining requirements for characters, scene, lighting, film grain, damage repair and color restoration; 4. Posting suggestions: title length, tags, image ratio and platform tone. Constraints: do not replicate the original author, original characters or brand logos; do not fabricate historical facts; when real people's photos are involved, prioritize identity consistency, and do not do rejuvenation, beauty filters, face slimming or facial feature rewriting.

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: 3か月以内に、AIにプロンプトを投げるエンジニアは時代遅れに!?
cards.why: Uses a deadline-threat rhetorical question with "within 3 months" and "obsolete," creating anxiety and curiosity that makes people want to know what the replacement is.
alts: Change to a question: Is this really true?
Add a specific number: 90% of people will lose their jobs
Shorten to an assertive statement headline

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Left text, right image, single-column wide format; the left headline and a small label at bottom-left align as one block, with the right graphic taking about half.
cards.why: The left-heavy, right-light balance makes the text get read first, then draws the eye to the right-side graphic, perfect for a horizontal cover to be scanned at a glance in a feed.
alts: Swap left and right, graphic on the left

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Light gray-white background with a blue-purple gradient ring, overall cool-toned and low-saturation, close to #E9EDF2 and #4F7FE0.
cards.why: The cool tech feel appears professional and trustworthy; low saturation is easy on the eyes, suitable for a reading-oriented cover, and makes the headline text stand out enough.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A 3D blue-purple gradient looping arrow ring, surrounded by floating white rounded squares with icons.
cards.why: The looping arrow turns the abstract "loop engineering" into a symbol understood at a glance; floating small squares suggest processes and modules, lowering the comprehension cost.
alts: Use a robot avatar instead of icon blocks

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Clean, rational, slightly futuristic tech atmosphere; the image is bright and airy.
cards.why: The clean futuristic feel conveys authority and being ahead of the curve; paired with the threat-style headline, it creates the tension of "calmly discussing something big," making people more willing to click.

sourcePrompt.en: Based on the reference cover's composition, visual metaphor, and readability as a WeChat thumbnail, generate a new horizontal WeChat public-account cover. Article title: {enter the WeChat article title} Intro: {enter intro} Original cover approach: In 3 Months, Prompt Engineering Will Be Obsolete? The Rise of Loop Engineering Dual-Skill Style Create a horizontal WeChat public-account article cover, 2.35:1 aspect ratio, for an article titled "In 3 Months, Prompt Engineering Will Be Obsolete? The Rise of Loop Engineering". Central concept: visualize abstract tool capabilities as interface windows, code snippets, node networks, control consoles, AI workflows, or a glowing system core. Style: preserve the reference cover's visual direction: light-background minimalist infographic/product slide. Use a palette inspired by #f7f7f9 (white), #dee6f0 (white), #fafafa (white), #e6ebf3 (white). Keep the image editorial, conceptual, and readable as a small WeChat thumbnail. Keep the main subject and any essential title text inside the safe square crop, while using the full wide frame for atmosphere, secondary symbols, or directional motion. Text strategy: use either no text or a very short headline fragment from the title. If text is used, make it large, clean, and integrated into the layout rather than pasted on top. Mood: match the article skill "In 3 months prompt engineering PromptEnginee… dual-skill style" -- useful, sharp, high-signal, and slightly more memorable than a normal tutorial thumbnail. Avoid: photorealistic clutter unless the source cover is photo-led, fake logos, unreadable tiny text, generic gradient blobs, stock-office imagery, watermark-like marks, and literal screenshots unless the article is explicitly about software interfaces.

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Two columns left and right, text on the left, image on the right, with a sphere and orbiting data cards on the right
cards.why: The classic cover structure of narrow left and wide right lets people read the conclusion first, then be convinced by the visual evidence.

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Deep blue-black background with white text, accented by bright blue glowing dots
cards.why: A deep-space background creates a high-end feel for the tech narrative, while blue highlights make data points pop like signals.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A sphere with crater texture on the right, surrounded by blue glowing dots and data labels
cards.why: Hanging abstract performance numbers onto a physical planet makes readers subconsciously treat it as a touchable result.

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Deep space, calm, with a sense of data authority
cards.why: The dark scene plus faint glow makes readers feel this is verified hardcore information, not a casually written recommendation.

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: Kimi K2.6 RUNS 300 PARALLEL AGENTS.
cards.why: Use large numbers and "parallel agents" to create a sense of scale and lead directly with the core result.

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Central flow diagram + left and right data panels + bottom six-icon strip, unfolding the information layer by layer.
cards.why: A strong central focal point with modular information around it lowers cognitive load and makes it save-worthy.

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Mainly white background with black text, blue accents, and a few dark cards for contrast.
cards.why: Clean and rational, fitting the tone of a tech tool, with blue highlighting key data.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A central black K icon, surrounded by multiple robot icons connected by dashed arrows.
cards.why: A graphical "300 agents" concept is more intuitive and easier to understand than plain text.

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: An efficient, rational, quantifiable tech feel that conveys the practical sense of saving time and money.
cards.why: Data-dense but orderly, suitable for B2B and AI-tool audiences, and sparks the desire to try it.

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: Kimi K2.6 RUNS 300 PARALLEL AGENTS.
cards.why: 用大写数字和“并行代理”制造规模化冲击感，直接抛出核心成果。

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 中央流程图+左右数据面板+底部六图标横条，信息层层展开。
cards.why: 中间视觉焦点强，四周信息模块化，降低认知负荷，适合收藏。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 白底黑字为主，蓝色强调，少量深色卡片形成对比。
cards.why: 干净理性，符合科技工具调性，蓝色高亮关键数据。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 中央黑色K图标，周围多个机器人图标与虚线箭头连接。
cards.why: 图形化“300个代理”概念，比纯文字更直观易懂。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 高效、理性、可量化的科技感，传递“省时省钱”的务实感。
cards.why: 数据密集但有序，适合B端和AI工具受众，激发尝试欲。

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: FINDING THE SWEET SPOT
cards.why: Highlights the suspense of the "sweet spot," making readers want to know how the left, middle, and right options differ.
alts: Change to a question: "Which one is the sweet spot?"

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: A single horizontal comparison graphic: title at the top, a double-arrow axis in the middle, three equal-width cards below the axis, and two lines of small italic notes under each card.
cards.why: Three horizontal columns let readers scan all three options at a glance, while the middle card uses a colour block to emphasize and guide the eye to the answer.
alts: Change the three columns to a vertical stack
Enlarge the middle card and centre it
Remove the italic notes below and keep only the cards

cards.label: Colour palette
cards.value: Off-white background with light grey text and lines; only the middle card is filled with pale mint green and outlined in dark green, forming the sole colourful focal point.
cards.why: The low-saturation background makes the only green card the visual anchor, so readers naturally associate their attention with the "correct option."
alts: Switch to a dark background with light text
Use red, yellow, and green for the three cards
Replace mint green with brand blue

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A horizontal double-arrow axis with three circular point markers, each connected by a vertical line to one of the three rectangular cards below.
cards.why: It turns an abstract trade-off into a measurable coordinate, so readers can understand "both extremes are bad" without reading the whole paragraph.
alts: Change it to a spring balance diagram
Change it to a slider control
Change it to a three-position knob

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: A calm, restrained technical-document feel: even diffused light, no shadows, like a page from a design spec or product guide.
cards.why: The clean, rational look conveys "this is an actionable engineering conclusion," prompting technical readers to save it for reference.
alts: Add slight shadows for more depth
Switch to a dark terminal style

spec: Top centre, occupying the middle section of the width
Sans-serif uppercase, grey, wide letter spacing
1 title row + 1 coordinate axis + 3 equal-width cards
Horizontally centred side by side, evenly spaced
Each card aligns vertically with a point on the axis
Pale mint green fill with dark green outline
Horizontal double-arrow line with three hollow circles
Short vertical lines lead down from the circles to the cards
The three cards each contain a technical term phrase

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: FINDING THE SWEET SPOT
cards.why: 点出「最佳平衡点」这一悬念，让读者想知道左中右三种方案差别在哪。
alts: 改为疑问句「哪一种是甜点区」
用数字「3 种结构，1 个甜点」

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 单幅横向对比图：上方标题，中部一条双箭头坐标轴，轴下三个等宽卡片，每卡下方两句斜体小注。
cards.why: 横向三栏并排让读者一眼扫完三种选项，中间卡用色块强调，视觉引导到答案。
alts: 去掉下方斜体注释只留卡片

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 米白背景配浅灰文字与线条，仅中间卡片用淡薄荷绿填充加深绿描边形成唯一彩色焦点。
cards.why: 低饱和底色让唯一的绿色卡片成为视觉落点，读者自然把注意力和「正确选项」绑定。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 一条水平双箭头轴，轴上有三个圆点刻度，分别以竖线连接下方三个矩形卡片。
cards.why: 把抽象取舍画成可测量的坐标，读者不用读完整段文字就能理解「两端都不好」。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 冷静克制的技术文档感，均匀漫射光、无阴影，像一页设计规范或产品说明。
cards.why: 干净理性的观感传递「这是可落地的工程结论」，促使技术读者收藏备查。

spec: 顶部居中，约占宽度中间段
无衬线大写，灰色，字距偏宽
1 个标题行 + 1 条坐标轴 + 3 个等宽卡片
横向居中并排，间距均匀
每张卡片与轴上圆点垂直对齐
淡薄荷绿填充配深绿描边
水平双箭头线，三个空心圆点
圆点向下引出短竖线接卡片
三张卡片分别为技术名词短语

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: 味的井盖
cards.why: Add an orange dot as an icon and compare the manhole cover to food, creating a contrast that makes people want to click and look.
alts: One short title line at the top

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: A single full-frame overhead shot, with the manhole cover occupying the left-center and shoes and pant legs left at the bottom
cards.why: There are no panels; the eye follows the doodle from top to bottom straight to the manhole cover's expression.

cards.label: Color Palette
cards.value: Gray floor tiles as the base, white road markings for highlights, and a dark brown manhole cover anchoring the image
cards.why: The large area of cool gray makes the white hand-drawn lines pop, so the doodle is immediately noticed.
alts: Black and white plus a touch of red

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A round manhole cover painted with eyes and teeth, with white lines extending out from it
cards.why: Bringing a dead object on the ground to life is the part of this kind of doodle image-text that is most likely to be screenshotted.
alts: Close-up of a cat's big head
A hand holding a cup of drink
Overhead shot of breakfast on a table

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: The relaxed feel of casual street graffiti, with small white dots scattered around
cards.why: The casual hand-drawn feel reduces the advertising vibe and makes it feel like a life record.

spec: Upper part of the image, slightly left, one horizontal line
#8C8C8C cement floor tiles covering a large area as the base
Overall even, with no strong light-dark contrast
White dots scattered throughout the image

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: 味的井盖
cards.why: 配上一个橙色圆点当图标，把井盖比作食物，制造反差让人想点开看。

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 单张俯拍全幅，井盖占据左侧中部，底部留出鞋与裤腿
cards.why: 没有分格，视线从上往下顺着涂鸦一路落到井盖表情上。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 灰色地砖打底，白色路面标线提亮，深褐井盖压住画面
cards.why: 大面积冷灰让白色手绘线条显得跳，涂鸦立刻被看见。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 圆井盖被画上眼睛和牙齿，白色线条从它连出去
cards.why: 把地面上的死物画活，是这类涂鸦图文最容易被截图的部分。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 街头随手涂鸦的轻松感，白色小圆点散落四周
cards.why: 随性的手绘感降低了广告味，让人觉得是生活记录。

spec: 画面上方偏左，横排一行
整体均匀，没有强烈明暗对比
白色圆点散布在画面各处

sourcePrompt.en: Refer to the case study "Let Happiness Fly" for its content structure, first-image hook, visual rhythm, and publishing tone to generate a new set of viral image-text content. New topic: {填写你要生成的主题} Reference platform: Douyin Content direction: AI image-text creation case Creation method: Break down the original case's tool entry points, visual style, step density, and replicable parameters, and turn the abstract method into a step-by-step image-text tutorial that people can follow. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. A 6-8 page image-text script, each page including visual description, main copy, key information points, and interaction/save actions; 3. Visual prompts that can be used directly for image generation, explaining the subject, scene, lighting, composition, font, or layout; 4. Publishing suggestions: title length, tags, image ratio, and platform tone. Constraints: Do not replicate the original author, original characters, or brand logos; do not fabricate data; avoid promising results when it involves health, mysticism, investment, or educational outcomes.
sourcePrompt.zh-CN: 参考案例《让快乐飞起来》的内容结构、首图钩子、画面节奏和发布语气，生成一组新的爆款图文。 新主题：{填写你要生成的主题} 参考平台：抖音 内容方向：AI 图文创作案例 创作方法：拆解原案例的工具入口、画面风格、步骤密度和可复制参数，把抽象方法写成能照做的图文教程。 请输出： 1. 封面标题与副标题； 2. 6-8 页图文脚本，每页包含画面描述、主文案、信息点和互动/收藏动作； 3. 可直接用于图像生成的视觉提示词，说明主体、场景、光线、构图、字体或版式； 4. 发布建议：标题长度、标签、图片比例和平台语气。 约束：不要复刻原作者、原人物或品牌标识；不要编造数据；涉及健康、玄学、投资、教育结果时避免承诺效果。

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: 做个有城府的女生
cards.why: Use a slightly contrasting identity label to directly call out readers, making them want to confirm whether they count as this type of person.
alts: Be a Girl Who's Not to Be Messed With
3 Workplace Savvy Tips, the Sooner You Know Them the Better
Depth Is Not Scheming, It's Self-Protection

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Single-column layout, with one large title at the top, followed by three groups of numbered subheadings with body text, all left-aligned
cards.why: List-style short paragraphs are easy to scan quickly, and readers will casually screenshot or save them as a memo.
alts: Two-column layout with image on the left and text on the right
Large title with chat record screenshots

cards.label: Color Palette
cards.value: Full off-white background with black body text, close to monochrome, with almost no colored blocks
cards.why: The quiet background color keeps long text from being harsh on the eyes, making it read like notes rather than an ad.
alts: Dark background with white text for high contrast
Off-white background with Klein blue titles

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: The main subject of the image is a text block composed of one large title line and three numbered body paragraphs
cards.why: Without people or scenes as distractions, the information itself is the protagonist, making it more credible.
alts: Half-body photo of a workplace woman appearing on camera

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: A checklist feel of black text on a white background, calm and pragmatic, with a slight reminder-style vigilance
cards.why: The restrained tone makes people feel it is the voice of experience and willing to forward it to colleagues or friends.

spec: Upper part of the image, spanning left to right
Largest text in the whole image
Light background with dark text, strong contrast
A notes-checklist feel of black text on a white background

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: 做个有城府的女生
cards.why: 用略带反差的身份标签直接点名读者，让人想确认自己算不算这种人。
alts: 3个职场心眼子，越早知道越好

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 单栏排版，顶部一个大标题，下方三组编号小标题加正文，全部左对齐
cards.why: 清单式短段落便于快速扫读，读者会顺手截图或收藏当备忘。
alts: 大字标题配聊天记录截图

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 整幅米白底配黑色正文，接近单色，几乎没有彩色块面
cards.why: 安静的底色让长文字不刺眼，读起来像笔记而不像广告。
alts: 米白底加克莱因蓝标题
莫兰迪灰粉低饱和配色

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 画面主体是一行大号标题与三段编号正文组成的文字块
cards.why: 没有人物和场景干扰，信息本身就是主角，可信度更高。
alts: 真人出镜的职场女性半身照

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 白底黑字的清单感，冷静、务实，带点提醒式的警惕
cards.why: 克制的语气让人感觉是经验之谈，愿意转发给同事或朋友。

spec: 画面上方，横跨左右宽度
白底黑字的笔记清单感

cards.label: Hook
cards.why: With no text at all, the brain-shaped maze's unusual structure creates confusion, making people stop and look for two more seconds.
alts: Use a question as the hook
Keep only a close-up of part of the maze

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Single full-bleed image, subject centered and slightly high, black margin left at the bottom
cards.why: A single visual center with no distractions, and the wide negative space makes the graphic feel quiet yet prominent in the feed.
alts: Image on top with title banner below

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Pure black background with white dot matrix, no color
cards.why: Minimal black-and-white contrast breaks out in reverse within a colorful feed, and the coldness reinforces the hint of rationality and thought.
alts: Black background with a touch of neon green

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: Hemispherical outline filled with a stepped maze
cards.why: Replacing the familiar brain shape with an inescapable maze is understood at a glance yet feels off, naturally suited to a metaphorical cover.
alts: Gears embedded in a brain shape

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Cold, rational, slightly oppressive
cards.why: High-contrast black and white and the dense dot matrix bring a restrained yet tense tone, making people sense the content will be deep rather than light reading.

spec: Centered and slightly high, taking about 90% of the width
Light and shadow simulated by dot density
Stepped passages embedded in a hemispherical outline
Light and dark surfaces made of dense white dots
Outer contour blends naturally with the black background
No directionality, shaped by dot matrix
Pure black and white, no warm colors

cards.label: 钩子
cards.why: 没有一句文字，靠脑形迷宫的反常结构制造困惑，让人忍不住停下来多看两秒。

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 单幅满版画面，主体居中偏上，底部留黑边
cards.why: 单一视觉中心没有干扰，宽幅留白让图形在信息流里显得安静又突出。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 纯黑底配白点阵，无彩色
cards.why: 极简黑白对比在彩色信息流中反向突围，冷峻感强化了理性与思考的暗示。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 布满阶梯迷宫的半球形轮廓
cards.why: 把熟悉的脑形替换成走不出的迷宫，一眼就能读懂又觉得不对劲，天然适合做隐喻封面。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 冷峻、理性、略带压迫感
cards.why: 高反差黑白与密集点阵带来克制又紧张的调性，让人预感到内容会有深度而非轻阅读。

spec: 半球形轮廓内嵌阶梯状通道
密集白点组成的明暗面
外轮廓与黑色背景自然融合

Central concept: visualize psychological changes as doors, roads, abysses, mirrors, maps, game levels, or a person facing a giant metaphor. Style: preserve the reference cover's visual direction: black-and-white or low-saturation editorial illustration/photo. Use a palette inspired by #020202 (black), #a1a1a3 (gray), #f2f2f2 (white), #dadadb (cream). Keep the image editorial, conceptual, and readable as a small WeChat thumbnail. Composition: the image is information-dense, suitable for a central subject with supporting information on the left and right, keeping the thumbnail readable. Keep the main subject and any essential title text inside the safe square crop, while using the full wide frame for atmosphere, secondary symbols, or directional motion. Text strategy: use either no text or a very short headline fragment from the title. If text is used, make it large, clean, and integrated into the layout rather than pasted on top. Mood: match the article skill "Life Is a Psychological Game, Here's How to Win style dual-skill" -- useful, sharp, high-signal, and slightly more memorable than a normal tutorial thumbnail. Avoid: photorealistic clutter unless the source cover is photo-led, fake logos, unreadable tiny text, generic gradient blobs, stock-office imagery, watermark-like marks, and literal screenshots unless the article is explicitly about software interfaces.

cards.label: Hook
cards.why: The image has no text, relying on expression and whitespace to resonate, making people pause emotionally in the feed.
alts: Overlay the title in the whitespace
Use a question as the hook

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: A single horizontal frame, character centered slightly right, large whitespace on the left and top, coffee cup anchoring the horizontal line at the bottom
cards.why: Large whitespace draws the eye first to the character's expression, then lets it glide along the empty space, making it easy to read.

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Dark blue ink lines + mint green top + light pink hair, off-white background, gray-purple cushion
cards.why: Low-saturation soft contrasting colors are both clean and emotional, easily appearing quiet and trustworthy in the feed.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A person sitting with both hands propping up their chin, flat expression, a cup of coffee beside them, simple line-drawing style
cards.why: Posture and expression are the most universal emotional symbols; viewers automatically project their own state onto them.
alts: A person looking down at a phone

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Quiet, stifled, slightly weary state of thought
cards.why: This unforced emotion leaves room for interpretation, making readers willing to project the title's conclusion onto their own lives.

spec: No readable text in the image
Only a handwritten signature-like stroke in the bottom right
Replaces the title with expression and whitespace
Character centered slightly right, occupying about one-third of the frame width
Large blank areas on the left and top
A horizontal line at the bottom supporting the coffee cup
One person, both hands propping up chin, gaze to the side
A cup of coffee in front, steam lines above the rim
No light or shadow, pure flat color
Soft, low saturation, on the cool side

cards.label: 钩子
cards.why: 画面没有文字，靠神态与留白引发共鸣，让人在信息流里产生情绪停顿。

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 单幅横向画面，人物居中偏右，左侧与上方大面积留白，底部咖啡杯压住水平线
cards.why: 大留白让视线先落在人物表情上，再顺着空处滑动，读起来不费劲。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 深蓝墨线＋薄荷绿上衣＋浅粉头发，米白底，灰紫靠垫
cards.why: 低饱和的柔和撞色既干净又带情绪，容易在信息流中显得安静可信。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 一个人双手托腮坐着，表情平淡，旁边一杯咖啡，线条简笔风格
cards.why: 姿态和表情是最通用的情绪符号，观众会自动把自己的状态代入进去。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 安静、发闷、带点疲惫的思考状态
cards.why: 这种不激烈的情绪留出解释空间，让读者愿意把标题的结论代入自己的生活。

spec: 仅右下角有手写签名式笔迹
靠表情与留白代替标题
人物居中偏右，占画面约三分之一宽
左侧与上方大面积空白
底部一条水平线承接咖啡杯
#F0C6B8 浅粉头发、#9A93B5 灰紫靠垫
一个人，双手托腮，目光侧向
前方一杯咖啡，杯口有热气线条

cards.label: Layout

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Muted taupe backdrop with large black fur and cream chest areas, low saturation throughout
cards.why: The soft neutral tones make the subject read as gentle and premium rather than loud, which suits a calming product.

cards.label: Subject

cards.why: An animal plus a wearable product shows the item in use, which is what makes this shoppable rather than decorative.

Dog next to the product packaging
Two pets wearing the same necklace

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Quiet, soft studio calm with even light and a plain backdrop
cards.why: The calm tone mirrors the promise of relieving anxiety, so the feeling itself sells the benefit.

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: Crystal Mala for Pets struggling
cards.why: 它在一行内点明具体产品和宠物的痛点，让养焦虑宠物的主人停下来看是否与自己相关。
alts: 专为焦虑宠物打造的念珠

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 一张满版照片，标题居中置于顶部，下方小箭头指向右侧
cards.why: 单一干净的画面搭配一个文本块，让整张图在快速滑动的信息流中也能扫读。
alts: 分屏构图，文字在左照片在右

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 柔和灰褐色背景，大面积黑色毛发与奶油色胸毛，整体低饱和度
cards.why: 柔和的中性色调让主体显得温和高级而非张扬，契合安抚类产品。

cards.label: 主体

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 安静柔和的影棚氛围，光线均匀，背景简洁
cards.why: 平静的调性呼应缓解焦虑的承诺，让这种感受本身就在传递卖点。

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: 老鼠死后会去哪？
cards.why: The upper half uses a question format to build suspense, making people unable to resist finding out the answer.
alts: What happens if a mouse dies

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Two equal-sized panels stacked top and bottom, hand-drawn thick black borders, text centered above each panel
cards.why: Two panels, one question one answer, readers can scan it at a glance, with a crisp rhythm that doesn't drag.
alts: Single large image with corner dialogue

cards.label: Color Palette
cards.value: Earthy yellow with light brown background, gray mouse body with pink ears, outlined in thick black lines
cards.why: The low-saturation warm yellow background looks clumsy and friendly, suitable for self-deprecating humor.
alts: Off-white background with bright yellow title

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A cartoon mouse with gray fur and pink ears, holding rat poison in the first panel, sitting in the second panel
cards.why: The round, simple-stroke mouse image itself is cute, and pairing it with a dangerous prop creates a contrasting punchline.

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Light self-deprecating cold humor, with a playful student-style homophone pun feel
cards.why: Using homophone punchlines to dissolve the serious topic of death, making people smile knowingly and want to share.

spec: Where do mice go after they die?
Rhetorical question builds suspense, leading into the homophone punchline in the lower panel
Stacked top and bottom, equal size
Narrow white gap with thick black border
About 30% of the height above each panel
Round-headed round-eared gray cartoon mouse, pink inner ears and tail
Holding a yellow package with writing on it in both hands
Using homophones to turn a heavy topic into a playful punchline

cards.why: 两格漫画一题一答，读者一眼就能扫完，节奏干脆不拖沓。

cards.why: 低饱和的暖黄底显得笨拙亲切，适合自嘲式幽默。

cards.label: 主体

cards.why: 圆润简笔的鼠形象本身就有萌点，配上危险道具形成反差笑点。

cards.label: 氛围

cards.label: 主体

cards.why: 一个人物在做完全不合常理的动作，另一个表情平淡，反差是转发的主要理由。

sourcePrompt.en: Referencing the rhythm, contrast punchlines, panel density, and title tone of the illustrated post "LMAO, the author really knows how to do absurd humor," generate a new set of Xiaohongshu funny comic themes: title "8 Absurd Moments Contemporary People Are Experiencing," subtitle "Turn life's little breakdowns into light, funny serialized images, great for comment-section interaction." Please output a 6-9 page illustrated script, with each page containing the visual description, main copy, character emotions, and an interactive question on the last page.
sourcePrompt.zh-CN: 参考图文《笑的我，作者搞抽象有一手》的节奏、反差包袱、分镜密度和标题语气，生成一组新的小红书搞笑漫画主题：标题《当代人正在经历的8个离谱瞬间》，副标题“把生活小崩溃画成轻松好笑的连环图文，适合评论区互动”。请输出 6-9 页图文脚本，每页包含画面描述、主文案、角色情绪和最后一页互动提问。

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: 寻找 老照片里的 隆林。
cards.why: Using staggered large brush-calligraphy characters to give the action first and then the place name, like an invitation, making people want to click and see what Longlin actually looks like.
alts: Highlight only the two large characters "Longlin"
Change it to "Searching for Longlin in Memory"
Add the line "Do you still remember?"

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Torn-paper collage: a full color street scene as the base, with a black-and-white old photo pressed diagonally at the lower left
cards.why: An old photo is inserted diagonally into a new photo, completing the old-and-new contrast with just one image, looking like flipping through an album.
alts: Left and right panels comparing old and new
Vertical text on the left and a full image on the right
Three old photos staggered and stacked

cards.label: Color palette
cards.value: Rice-gray paper surface and gray-green rooftops as the base, with kraft-paper torn edges showing at the four corners
cards.why: Faded rice gray plus old-paper brown instantly gives the yearbook feel of old photos, making them easy to save.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A small town of gray tile rooftops, white buildings in the distance, green mountains and a stone arch bridge
cards.why: A real hometown scene where rooftops and mountains blend together evokes hometown recognition better than any text.
alts: Photograph only that stone arch bridge
Use only a partial view of the old photo
Switch to a person's back view

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: A faded, quiet hometown memory with a touch of old-times flavor
cards.why: A quiet nostalgic atmosphere makes people slow down their scrolling, willing to stop and finish viewing before forwarding it to fellow townspeople.

spec: 寻找 老照片里的 隆林。
Upper half of the image, staggered on the left and right sides
Three lines of text spanning most of the image width
Rice white for the sky and light paper surfaces
Gray green of the dense rooftops and distant mountains
Faded warm gray and green, very low contrast
Paper surface texture and worn old-photo edges

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: 寻找 老照片里的 隆林。
cards.why: 用错落的毛笔大字先给动作再给地名，像一句邀请，让人想点开看看隆林到底长什么样。
alts: 改成「寻找记忆中的隆林」

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 撕纸拼贴：一整幅彩色街景打底，左下角斜压一张黑白旧照
cards.why: 旧照斜插进新照片，用一张图就完成了新旧对照，看着像翻相册。
alts: 左侧竖排文字右侧整图

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 米灰纸面与灰绿屋顶打底，四角露出牛皮纸撕边
cards.why: 褪色的米灰加旧纸棕，一眼就有老照片的年份感，容易被收藏。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 成片灰瓦屋顶的小镇、远处白色楼房、绿山与一座石拱桥
cards.why: 屋顶和山连成片的家乡实景，比任何文字都更能唤起同乡的认同。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 褪色、安静、带点旧时光味道的故乡回忆感
cards.why: 不吵闹的怀旧氛围让人放慢手指，愿意停下来看完再转发给老乡。

spec: 寻找 老照片里的 隆林。
画面上半部，左与右侧错落排布
三行字横跨画面大部分宽度
天空与浅色纸面的米白
成片屋顶与远山的灰绿
褪色的暖灰与绿，对比很低
纸面纹理与磨损的旧照边

sourcePrompt.en: Refer to the case "Longlin in Old Photos" for its old-photo restoration approach, period texture, visual narrative and publishing tone, and generate a new set of retro old-photo image-and-text posts. New theme: {fill in the photo theme you want to restore, rebuild or recreate} Reference platform: Xiaohongshu Content direction: retro old-photo image-and-text Creative method: keep the original case's nostalgic mood, film/photo-paper texture, relationships between people, period feel of the scene and restoration constraints; if it is photo restoration, it must stay faithful to the original image's identity, facial features, composition and historical context, avoiding over-beautification, repainting, false historical information and a modern digital plastic feel. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. A 6-9 page image-and-text script, each page containing a visual description, main copy, era/texture keywords and a save prompt; 3. Visual prompts that can be used directly for image generation or photo restoration, explaining requirements for people, scene, lighting, film grain, damage repair and color restoration; 4. Publishing suggestions: title length, tags, image ratio and platform tone. Constraints: do not replicate the original author, original people or brand logos; do not fabricate historical facts; when real people's photos are involved, prioritize identity consistency, and do not make them younger, beautify, slim the face or rewrite facial features.
sourcePrompt.zh-CN: 参考案例《老照片里的隆林》的老照片修复方式、年代质感、画面叙事和发布语气，生成一组新的复古老照片图文。 新主题：{填写你要修复、重建或复刻的照片主题} 参考平台：小红书 内容方向：复古老照片图文 创作方法：保留原案例的怀旧情绪、胶片/相纸质感、人物关系、场景年代感和修复约束；如果是照片修复，必须忠于原图身份、五官、构图和历史语境，避免过度美颜、重绘、虚假历史信息和现代数码塑料感。 请输出： 1. 封面标题与副标题； 2. 6-9 页图文脚本，每页包含画面描述、主文案、年代/质感关键词和收藏引导； 3. 可直接用于图像生成或照片修复的视觉提示词，说明人物、场景、光线、胶片颗粒、破损修复和色彩还原要求； 4. 发布建议：标题长度、标签、图片比例和平台语气。 约束：不要复刻原作者、原人物或品牌标识；不要编造历史事实；涉及真实人物照片时优先保留身份一致性，不做年轻化、美颜、瘦脸或五官改写。

cards.label: Hook
cards.why: There is no text in the image, so viewers' curiosity is drawn entirely by the contrast between the cat and the underwater reflection, creating a strong urge to click.
alts: Directly show a before-and-after AI generation comparison
Use a striking title to call out the AI video

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Single frame, upper half is water surface and reflection, lower half is tile, cat is at the lower right
cards.why: The horizontal wide composition suits an article cover, with the visual weight balanced between the cat on the right and the reflection on the left, creating a balanced and story-driven feel.
alts: Split-screen left and right showing different perspectives
Overlay a text title at the top

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Main colors are peacock blue and teal, accented with a white cat and yellow-green tiles
cards.why: The cool tones convey mystery and quiet, the white cat creates a strong visual focal point, and the small warm accents of the mosaic tiles keep the image from feeling dull.
alts: Warm tones for a cozier feel
Minimal black, white, and gray palette

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A white cat stands at the edge of the tiles, looks down at the water, and beneath the surface is a giant peacock shadow
cards.why: The size contrast between the cat and the giant reflection creates a surreal effect, hinting at an AI-generated fantastical setup and sparking curiosity and a desire to share.
alts: The cat and its own reflection in the water
Multiple people watching the cat and reflection
The cat with floating AI elements

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Quiet, mysterious, with a touch of fantasy and surrealism
cards.why: The quiet atmosphere makes people pause, and the surreal reflection provokes thought and curiosity, suitable for the opening of an explainer article and attracting deep reading.

spec: Diagonal between water surface and tiles
White cat standing in side profile

cards.label: 钩子
cards.why: 画面中没有文字，观众的好奇心完全被猫与水下倒影的反差吸引，产生强烈的点击欲望。
alts: 直接展示AI生成前后对比

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 单一画幅，上半为水面与倒影，下半为瓷砖，猫位于右下方
cards.why: 横向宽幅构图适配文章封面，视觉重心在右侧猫与左侧倒影的呼应上，平衡且有故事感。
alts: 左右分屏展示不同视角

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 主色调为孔雀蓝与青绿，辅以白猫与黄绿瓷砖点缀
cards.why: 冷色调传递神秘与静谧，白猫形成强烈视觉焦点，马赛克瓷砖的暖色小面积点缀让画面不沉闷。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 一只白猫站在瓷砖边缘，低头看向水面，水面下有巨大的孔雀暗影
cards.why: 猫与巨大倒影的体型反差制造超现实感，暗示AI生成的奇幻设定，激发人们的探索欲和分享欲。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 静谧、神秘，带有一丝奇幻与超现实
cards.why: 安静的氛围让人驻足，超现实的倒影引发思考与好奇，适合解释型文章开篇，吸引深度阅读。

sourcePrompt.en: Please generate a new horizontal WeChat public-account cover based on the reference cover's composition, visual metaphors, and thumbnail readability for a WeChat public account. Output size: 1456x582, ratio about 2.5:1; the core subject and necessary title information should also work within the safe square crop for WeChat public accounts. WeChat article title: {填写公众号文章标题} Summary: {填写简介} Original cover method: "LouvreCat" AI video: a deep dive into the full process of creating a viral hit, dual-skill style. Create a horizontal WeChat public-account article cover, 2.35:1 aspect ratio, for an article titled ""Louvre Cat" AI 视频：深入解析爆款创作全过程". Central concept: visualize abstract tool capabilities as interface windows, code snippets, node networks, control consoles, AI workflows, or a glowing system core. Style: preserve the reference cover's visual direction: high-saturation poster/tech-advertising visuals. Use a palette inspired by #15466d (charcoal), #166089 (teal), #618da8 (gray), #9eb7c4 (cream). Keep the image editorial, conceptual, and readable as a small WeChat thumbnail. Composition: the image has a high information density, suitable for a central subject with supporting information on the left and right, keeping the thumbnail readable. Keep the main subject and any essential title text inside the safe square crop, while using the full wide frame for atmosphere, secondary symbols, or directional motion. Text strategy: use either no text or a very short headline fragment from the title. If text is used, make it large, clean, and integrated into the layout rather than pasted on top. Mood: match the article skill "LouvreCatAI视频深入解析爆款创作全…风格双技能" -- useful, sharp, high-signal, and slightly more memorable than a normal tutorial thumbnail. Avoid: photorealistic clutter unless the source cover is photo-led, fake logos, unreadable tiny text, generic gradient blobs, stock-office imagery, watermark-like marks, and literal screenshots unless the article is explicitly about software interfaces.

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: 爱自己的刺
cards.why: It grounds "loving yourself" in a specific "quill" — counterintuitive yet hitting the pain point, making people want to tap in and see how to love.
alts: Love Every One of Your Quills

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Text concentrated in the upper half, dark pointed mountain shape anchoring the lower half, whitespace on the off-white paper surface.
cards.why: The top half has whitespace for reading text, the bottom half anchors with the shape; the eye reads the title first then falls to the little animal — a comfortable rhythm.

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Off-white paper base with dark brown irregular pointed shape, red-brown first character accent, light-skinned little animal.
cards.why: Low-saturation warm tones feel quiet and healing; red-brown is given to just one character, creating a gentle visual focal point.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A hand-drawn-style little animal peeks out from the dark pointed shape, two front paws resting on the edge.
cards.why: The soft, cute little animal neutralizes the sharpness of the "quills", making abstract emotions approachable and relatable.
alts: Whitespace with only the little animal

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Quiet, soft, with a touch of self-deprecating warmth, like the cover of a handmade picture book.
cards.why: No slogans — clumsy hand-drawing conveys a feeling of being accepted, making it easy for people to save and share with themselves or friends.

spec: Upper part of image, left to right side
Handwritten-style sans-serif, first character red-brown, rest dark black
First character largest, rest equal size
Upper half text with whitespace, lower half dark pointed shape as base
Text about upper 1/3, pointed shape about lower 2/3
Title starts from left, little animal centered slightly low
Hand-drawn little animal, round ears, squinting eyes, smile
Two paws resting on the dark pointed shape edge, only upper body visible
Small orange-red dot on one side

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: 爱自己的刺
cards.why: 把“爱自己”落在一个具体的“刺”上，反常识又戳中痛点，让人想点开看怎么爱。

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 文字集中上半部，深色尖角山形压在下半部，米白纸面留白。
cards.why: 上半留白读字、下半造型压阵，视线先读标题再落到小动物，节奏舒服。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 米白纸底配深褐不规则尖形，红棕首字点缀，浅肤色小动物。
cards.why: 低饱和暖色安静治愈，红棕只给一个字，形成温和的视觉焦点。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 一只手绘风格的小动物从深色尖角中探出，两只前爪搭在边缘。
cards.why: 软萌小动物把“刺”的锋利感中和掉，让抽象情绪变得可亲近、可代入。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 安静、柔软、带一点自嘲的暖意，像手作绘本的封面。
cards.why: 不喊口号，用笨拙手绘传递被接纳的感觉，容易让人收藏转发给自己或朋友。

spec: 手写感黑体，首字红棕、其余深黑
上半部文字留白，下半部深色尖形铺底
文字约占上1/3，尖形约占下2/3
标题左起，小动物居中偏下
手绘小动物，圆耳、眯眼、微笑
两爪搭在深色尖形边缘，只露上半身

sourcePrompt.en: Referencing the gentle expression, generous whitespace, and sense of companionship in the illustrated post "Loving Yourself Starts With Loving Every One of Your Quills!", generate a new set of emotional healing themes: title "7 Small Actions to Slowly Nurture Yourself Back", subtitle "A gentle recovery checklist you can follow even during low periods". Please output a cover hook, 6 content cards, and an ending save prompt; each page should include one empathetic line and one actionable step.
sourcePrompt.zh-CN: 参考图文《爱自己从爱自己的每一根刺开始！》的温柔表达、留白比例和陪伴感，生成一组新的情绪疗愈主题：标题《7个把自己慢慢养回来的小动作》，副标题“低谷期也能照着做的温柔恢复清单”。请输出封面钩子、6 页内容卡和结尾收藏引导，每页都给一句共情话和一个可执行动作。

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: 幸せ / 不幸せ
cards.why: Two big contrasting words pressed onto the image make you want to know at a glance how this diagonal line is divided.

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: A single coordinate chart: the horizontal axis runs from self to others, the vertical axis runs from now to society's future, a small dark square in the lower left, and a beige diagonal arrow cutting across the image
cards.why: Using a ready-made coordinate framework to carry the emotion lets readers place themselves without having to think.
alts: Crop just one section and enlarge it

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Light gray-blue grid base, beige arrow as the visual focus, dark square in the lower left anchoring the starting point
cards.why: The low-saturation gray-blue feels like an explanatory diagram, while the warm yellow arrow pulls the eye away at once, feeling credible without being harsh.
alts: Dark blue background with white blocks

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: The entire diagram itself: the diagonal arrow and four groups of people labels (unlucky people, ordinary people, altruistic people)
cards.why: Drawing an abstract concept as a map you can "step into" makes people screenshot and save it or forward it to friends.

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: A calm explanatory-diagram tone, lots of whitespace, only small annotations around the edges, no extra decoration
cards.why: The more it looks like a lecture slide, the more it feels 'reasonable', and readers are willing to treat it as a point of view to discuss rather than an ad.

spec: Above and inside the diagonal arrow, spanning the middle of the image
Warm yellow arrow against gray-blue background sets off the text
One large rectangle divided into multiple small cells
Self, family, relatives, lover, friends, acquaintances, others
Now, your own future, your children's future, society's future
A small "scope of consideration" box at the top pointing downward
A thick diagonal arrow pointing from lower left to upper right
Unlucky people, ordinary people, altruistic people
Egoistic people, criminals with an arrow pointing to the starting point
Large blank areas on all sides

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: 幸せ / 不幸せ
cards.why: 两个反向的大字压在图上，一眼就想知道这条斜线到底怎么分界。

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 单张坐标图：横轴由自己到他人，纵轴由现在到社会将来，左下一小块深色方块，图上一条米黄色斜箭头贯穿
cards.why: 用现成的坐标框架承载情绪，读者不用思考就能对上自己的位置。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 浅灰蓝格子打底，米黄箭头做视觉焦点，左下深色方块压住起点
cards.why: 低饱和灰蓝显得像说明图，暖黄箭头把视线一把拉走，显得可信又不刺眼。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 整张示意图本身：斜箭头与四组人物标签（运气不好的人、普通人、利他主义的人）
cards.why: 把抽象概念画成一张可以「站进去」的地图，人们会截图收藏或者转发给朋友。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 冷静的说明图语气，留白多，四周只有小字注释，没有多余装饰
cards.why: 越像讲义越是显得「有道理」，读者愿意把它当作可以讨论的观点而不是广告。

spec: 斜箭头上方与内部，横跨画面中部
灰蓝底上暖黄箭头衬字

Visual prompts that can be used directly for image generation, explaining subject, scene, lighting, composition, font, or layout; 4. cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Vertical magazine cover centered, wood-grain desktop left and right, top and bottom edges slightly cropped

alts: Left image, right text split columns

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Warm yellow wood grain base sets off the deep blue cosmos, orange-yellow spaceship, and large white text
cards.why: The warm tones of the wood and the cool deep blue of space create maximum contrast, making the title pop.
alts: Switch to a dark gray desktop

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A person holding up a retro sci-fi style magazine cover with both hands, showing a spaceship and planets
cards.why: The pose of holding a physical object in both hands looks like showing off a collectible, making it easier to save and share than a purely digital poster.
alts: Switch to holding a book one-handed
Switch to laying the whole book flat
Switch to the cover appearing alone

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Nostalgic futurism, the calm excitement of retro print media and space sci-fi
cards.why: A familiar old-magazine texture wraps a new topic, creating a reliable sense of tech authority.

Cover width about one third of the image
Two hands, only fingers and back of hands visible
A vertical cover showing a spaceship and planets
Both hands supporting the cover from below
Center of the image, fingers at the bottom on both sides
Even and soft, no obvious shadows
Paper texture and wood grain coexist

cards.value: Cool blue skin tones with vivid green eyes and dark shading

cards.why: The relatable emotion makes it easy for users to project their own situations onto the image.

Please output: 1. A concise English title and subtitle for social posting; 2. 2-4 short English caption lines that can be placed directly on the meme; 3. cards.label: Hook
cards.value: 目黑記念 最終予想
cards.why: Extra-large bold typography is too eye-catching to ignore, directly dropping suspenseful prediction info and sparking curiosity to click and see the conclusion.
alts: Change to a pure-number result teaser

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Single horizontal cover; the left two-line large text block takes about 70% of the frame width, and the right side leaves a vertical character area, forming an asymmetric left-heavy, right-light diagonal balance.
cards.why: The text block and the character each occupy one side; the eye is caught by the text first and then lands on the face, giving a clear reading path with no conflict.

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Red-yellow clash dominates, black outlines lower the saturation, and the pink-blue sky and sakura tones bring out a lively feel.
cards.why: High-saturation red and yellow with thick black outlines create strong contrast, popping out instantly in the feed; cherry-blossom pink also softens the aggression and makes it likable.
alts: Black white gray plus a single bright color

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: On the right, a young black-haired female anime character looks back over her shoulder, with cherry blossoms, lanterns, and a distant street scene.
cards.why: The retro animation-style character brings closeness and nostalgia; her gaze points toward the text, hinting that she is also following the same topic and drawing readers in.
alts: Add a group of multiple characters
Change to pure scenery with no people

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: A lively, nostalgic pre-race atmosphere with a sense of competition, relaxed yet tinged with nervous anticipation.
cards.why: Bright daylight and pink sakura create a relaxed feel, while the bold red-yellow text conveys a 'betting' urgency; the emotional contrast makes people want to find out more.
alts: Change to a dark suspenseful feel

Left side of the frame, stacked in two lines taking about 70% of the width
Extra-bold strokes, black outline, red-yellow color separation
Left text block and right character, about 7:3 ratio
Text block left-aligned, tight line spacing
#111111 thick black outline with white edge
A black-haired anime-style woman looking back over her shoulder
Pink cherry blossoms, red-and-white lanterns, a distant bridge and buildings
Warm pink and bright blue contrast, saturated colors
Relaxed nostalgia with a hint of pre-race tension

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: 目黑記念 最終予想
cards.why: 超大字号加粗排版醒目到无法忽略，直接抛出具悬念的预测信息，勾起人点开看结论的好奇心。

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 单幅横版封面，左侧双行大字块占画面宽度约七成，右侧竖留出人物区，形成左重右轻的对角平衡。
cards.why: 文字块与人物各占一侧，视线先被文字抓住再落到人脸上，阅读路径清晰不打架。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 红黄撞色为主，黑描边压低饱和度，背景粉蓝天空与樱色衬出热闹感。
cards.why: 高饱和红黄与黑色粗边形成强对比，在信息流中一眼跳出来，樱花粉又中和了攻击性，显得讨喜。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 右侧一位黑发年轻女性动漫角色侧身回望，另有樱花、灯笼与远处街景。
cards.why: 复古动画风格人物带来亲近与怀旧感，视线朝向文字，暗示她也在关注同一个话题，引导读者代入。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 热闹、怀旧又带竞争感的赛前气氛，轻松中透着紧张期待。
cards.why: 明亮日光与粉樱营造轻松感，粗体红黄字又传递出“押注式”的紧迫，情绪反差让人想一探究竟。

Remove the figure and leave only the forest

Contracts inward from all sides into a funnel
Quiet with a sense of pressure

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: LUXURY CAT COLLORS
cards.why: A two-word promise of 'luxury' for a pet product sets an upmarket expectation that stops the scroll before any cat is even seen.

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Black headline band across the top, three equal vertical panels below divided by thin black stripes.
cards.why: The three-up grid lets one image show three product options, so a viewer compares and saves instead of scrolling past.

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Black top band and dividers, white background, grey and ginger cat fur, small bright bead accents.
cards.why: A near-monochrome stage makes the small coloured beads read as the product, pushing the eye to the jewellery.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: Three cats, one per panel, wearing beaded collars and a plain leather collar.
cards.why: Showing the same product category on different animals makes buyers picture their own pet wearing it.

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Polished studio product photography, bright even light, high contrast against the black band.
cards.why: The boutique-catalogue feel justifies a premium price and makes the post feel like a shop window worth saving.

spec: centred in the top black band, two lines
largest text block on the image
grey #9AA3A8 and ginger #D98E4A across the panels
bright even light on a white sweep
hard black band against the pale scene

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: LUXURY CAT COLLORS
cards.why: 用两个词承诺宠物产品的“奢华”，营造高端期待，在任何猫出现之前就让人停下滚动。

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 顶部黑色标题带，下方三个等宽竖版面板，由细黑条分隔。
cards.why: 三联网格让一张图展示三种产品选择，观众会对比并收藏，而不是直接滑过。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 黑色顶部带和分隔线，白色背景，灰色和姜黄色猫毛，小颗明亮珠子点缀。
cards.why: 近乎单色的舞台让彩色小珠子成为产品焦点，把视线引向珠宝。

cards.label: 主体

cards.why: 在同一产品类别中展示不同动物，能让买家想象自己的宠物戴上它。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 精致棚拍产品摄影，明亮均匀光线，与黑色带形成高对比。
cards.why: 精品目录感支撑高价，让帖子像值得收藏的橱窗。

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: 刷牙 / 是你唯一清理骨头的时间
cards.why: Using the counterintuitive "bone" phrasing turns everyday small things into a creepy yet funny suspense, making people want to click and see what's going on.
alts: Change to "You chew bones every day"

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Two horizontal panels stacked top and bottom; the top panel about 50% height shows the character, the bottom panel about 50% height shows the building and the tooth queue
cards.why: Give the emotion first, then the explanation; reading top and bottom as a contrast feels like the setup and punchline of a joke.
alts: Change to left and right two panels
Change to top large, bottom small three panels
Change to a full-page single panel

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Off-white background plus light mint green bottom panel, skin tone, dark brown hair, and pink accents
cards.why: Low-saturation fresh background colors contrast with the bizarre characters, lighthearted and not oppressive, good for saving and sharing.
alts: Change to dark blue night tone

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: Top half: an exaggerated human face brushing teeth; bottom half: a small hut labeled bathhouse and a queue of anthropomorphic teeth
cards.why: Anthropomorphizing body parts into cartoon characters with expressions is cute and absurd, easy for people to screenshot and share.
alts: Change to a big tooth as the protagonist
Change to a full-body little person brushing teeth
Change to a full bathroom scene

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Bizarre and comical everyday feel, like a dry-humor science comic
cards.why: Telling ordinary teeth brushing as a party inside the body creates a dual motivation to resonate and laugh.

A few anthropomorphic little characters, one holding a red balloon

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: 刷牙 / 是你唯一清理骨头的时间
cards.why: 用反常识的“骨头”说法把日常小事变成惊悚又好笑的悬念，让人想点开看究竟。
alts: 改成“你每天都在啃骨头”

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 上下两块横向分格，上格约五成高画人物，下格约五成高画建筑与牙齿队列
cards.why: 先给情绪再给解释，上下对照读起来像一句笑话的铺垫与抖包袱。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 米白底加浅薄荷绿下格，肤色、深棕头发与粉色点缀
cards.why: 低饱和清爽底色反差出怪诞角色，心情轻松不压抑，适合收藏转发。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 上半一个夸张人脸在刷牙，下半一间写着洗浴的小屋和排队的拟人牙齿
cards.why: 把身体部位拟人成有表情的卡通角色，可爱又荒诞，容易让人截图分享。
alts: 改成一颗大牙齿当主角

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 怪诞滑稽的日常感，像冷笑话式科普漫画
cards.why: 把平平无奇的刷牙讲成一场身体内部的派对，制造共鸣加幽默的双重转发动机。

spec: 是你唯一清理骨头的时间
一张夸张卡通脸，嘴含白色泡沫，手拿粉色牙刷

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: 八十年的足迹 / 我爷爷的一生
cards.why: Calling an unfamiliar old photo 'my grandpa' makes readers immediately think of their own elders and stop to keep reading.
alts: Add a year range as the hook

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Single full-bleed portrait, two lines of large text centered at the bottom over the image, no border and no grid
cards.why: Full-bleed with only one text area, the eye lands on the face first then the text, stretching dwell time.
alts: Two-column layout with image left and text right
Split top and bottom for two old photos
Text on top with portrait centered

cards.label: Color palette
cards.value: Beige background with gray-brown jacket, overall warm aged tone, close to old photo paper
cards.why: Old photo paper tones bring an inherent sense of era, interlock with the 'life' theme, and make it easier to be saved.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: One half-body portrait occupying the middle of the frame, plain wall as background
cards.why: A young face contrasts with 'a lifetime', making readers wonder what happened later in this photo's story.
alts: Switch to a full-body standing old photo
Switch to a photo of two people together
Switch to a close-up holding an old object

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Warm nostalgic old image texture, quiet and restrained without clamor
cards.why: A quiet sense of remembrance reduces commercial feel, like a private memorial, making readers more willing to share it with family.

xray.short: Two lines of large text at the bottom

Occupies about one quarter of the height at the bottom of the image

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: 八十年的足迹 / 我爷爷的一生
cards.why: 把一张陌生老照片说成「我爷爷」，读者会立刻联想到自家长辈，停下来想看下去。

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 单张满幅人像，底部居中两行大字压在画面上，无边框无分格
cards.why: 满幅只留一处文字，视线先落在脸上再落到字上，停留时间被拉长。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 米黄背景配灰褐外套，整体暖调做旧，接近旧相纸
cards.why: 旧相纸色调自带年代感，与「一生」的主题咬合，更容易被收藏。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 一个人半身像占画面中部，素色墙面为背
cards.why: 年轻面孔与「一生」形成落差，读者会追问这张照片后来的故事。

cards.label: 氛围

cards.why: 安静的追忆感削弱商业味，像私人纪念，读者更愿意转发给家人。

Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. 6-9 pages of image-text script, each page includes scene description, main copy, era/texture keywords and save prompt; 3. alts: See the before-and-after restoration comparison here
Old photos can become colorized too
The group photo of our ancestors has been saved

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Two photos of similar size are placed side by side, each with a dark text band about one-tenth the image height below it
cards.why: The same image is shown side by side for comparison, so viewers can understand what the restoration did without swiping; the more direct the contrast, the more they want to save it.
alts: Original on top, restored image below
Three restoration cases side by side
Large image with a small comparison image at the bottom

cards.label: Color palette
cards.value: The left side is overall gray-toned, while the right side is also low-saturation but the clothing appears dark and the background is warm and light
cards.why: The low-saturation collision of gray and warm tones clearly conveys both the sense of the era and the clarity after restoration.
alts: All black and white with one spot of color
High-contrast black and white with warm skin tones

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A group of people in a group photo, with the same clothing and poses in both left and right images, differing only in color and clarity
cards.why: The same group photo is presented twice exactly as it is, so viewers will actively look for differences and naturally stay longer.
alts: Only the restored color group photo
Single-person portrait before and after restoration
Partial enlarged comparison of a family portrait

cards.label: Mood

cards.why: The emotion of nostalgia plus warmth is most likely to be forwarded to family and evoke shared memories.

sourcePrompt.en: Referencing the old photo restoration approach, vintage texture, visual storytelling and posting tone of the case study 'Old photo group portrait restoration, can go deeper, charging 200 is too little', generate a new set of retro old photo image-text content. New theme: {fill in the photo theme you want to restore, rebuild or recreate} Reference platform: Xiaohongshu Content direction: retro old photo image-text Creation method: retain the nostalgic emotion, film/photo paper texture, character relationships, era atmosphere of the scene and restoration constraints of the original case; if it is photo restoration, it must be faithful to the original image's identity, facial features, composition and historical context, avoiding excessive beautification, redrawing, false historical information and modern digital plastic feeling. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. 6-9 page image-text script, each page containing visual description, main copy, era/texture keywords and save prompt; 3. Visual prompts that can be used directly for image generation or photo restoration, explaining requirements for characters, scene, lighting, film grain, damage repair and color restoration; 4. Posting suggestions: title length, tags, image ratio and platform tone. Constraints: do not replicate the original author, original people or brand marks; do not fabricate historical facts; when real people's photos are involved, prioritize identity consistency, do not do rejuvenation, beautification, face slimming or facial feature rewriting.

cards.label: Layout

Add orange as the main color
Switch to a cool gray-blue tone

cards.label: Subject

cards.why: A baby naturally evokes emotional resonance, and the small hand gesture makes people want to step into the scene and protect.

cards.label: Mood

Centered slightly right, occupying the right half
