cards.label: Hook
cards.why: The image itself has no text; the isolated spire building in the distance and the curved waterway in front create a strong sense of longing, making people want to save the destination immediately.
alts: Add a line of lonely copy in the sky
Place the title on the grass in the lower third
Use the destination name as a small corner label

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: A single full-screen photo; the horizon runs across the middle-lower part of the frame; the foreground ravine narrows from near to far, pointing toward the central building.
cards.why: A single vanishing point pushes the gaze from the foreground all the way to the distant building, keeping viewers looking longer and making them likely to save it.
alts: Split top and bottom with text whitespace
Left image, right text in two vertical columns
Enlarge the building to fill the top half

cards.label: Color palette
cards.value: Cool blue-gray sky, warm orange cloud light along the horizon, large areas of saturated green grass, restrained warm-cool contrast.
cards.why: A cool-toned base with a touch of warm light; quiet yet expectant, matching the premium feel of a travel cover.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A stone building complex with a spire on flat green tidal flats, open and unobstructed all around, with a curved waterway in the foreground.
cards.why: An isolated landmark plus an open environment creates a sense of scarcity, the most direct reason to click on a guide-type cover.
alts: Close-up of the street at the building entrance
Same angle with golden sunrise light version
Aerial drone shot of the full beach panorama

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: The quiet and vastness of approaching dusk, soft light, overall lonely yet peaceful.
cards.why: Emotion comes before information; giving atmosphere first and the guide second makes it easier for people to forward it to someone they'd travel with.

spec: No visible text in the image
Isolated landmark and waterway leading lines
#A9B6C6 cool blue-gray, covering the upper half
#E7C9AE warm orange, concentrated in a band above the horizon
#4F6B34 deep green, covering the lower half
Soft diffused light, warmer near the horizon
Mainly cool tones with warm light accents

cards.label: 钩子

alts: 加一句孤独感文案在天空
标题压在下三分之一草地
用目的地名做小字角标

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 单幅满屏照片，地平面横贯画面中部偏下，前景沟壑由近向远收束指向中央建筑。
cards.why: 单一消失点把视线从近处一路推到远方建筑，停留时间长，容易被保存。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 冷蓝灰天空、地平线一带暖橘云光、大面积饱和绿草地，冷暖对比克制。
cards.why: 冷调打底加一抹暖光，安静里带期待，符合旅行封面的高级感。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 平坦绿色滩地上一座带尖塔的石砌建筑群，四周开阔无遮挡，前景是弯曲的水道。
cards.why: 孤立地标加空旷环境制造稀缺感，是攻略类封面最直接的点击理由。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 天色将暮的静谧与辽阔，光线柔和，整体孤独而宁静。
cards.why: 情绪先于信息，先给氛围再给攻略，更容易被转发给同行的人。

柔和散射光，地平线处偏暖

sourcePrompt.en: Referencing the content structure, cover hook, visual rhythm, and publishing tone of the case study "Someday You'll Come Here Alone," generate a new set of viral image-text posts. New topic: {填写你要生成的主题} Reference platform: Xiaohongshu Content direction: travel guide image-text Creation method: keep the original case's destination hook, route rhythm, and save-worthy value, and fill in time, location, pitfalls to avoid, and photo spots. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. A 6-8 page image-text script, each page including visual description, main copy, information points, and interaction/save action; 3. Visual prompts ready for image generation, specifying subject, scene, lighting, composition, fonts, or layout; 4. Publishing suggestions: title length, tags, image ratio, and platform tone. Constraints: do not replicate the original author, original characters, or brand logos; do not fabricate data; avoid promising results when it comes to health, metaphysics, investing, or educational outcomes.
sourcePrompt.zh-CN: 参考案例《总有一天你会一个人来到这里》的内容结构、首图钩子、画面节奏和发布语气，生成一组新的爆款图文。 新主题：{填写你要生成的主题} 参考平台：小红书 内容方向：旅行攻略图文 创作方法：保留原案例的目的地钩子、路线节奏和收藏价值，补齐时间、地点、避坑和拍照点。 请输出： 1. 封面标题与副标题； 2. 6-8 页图文脚本，每页包含画面描述、主文案、信息点和互动/收藏动作； 3. 可直接用于图像生成的视觉提示词，说明主体、场景、光线、构图、字体或版式； 4. 发布建议：标题长度、标签、图片比例和平台语气。 约束：不要复刻原作者、原人物或品牌标识；不要编造数据；涉及健康、玄学、投资、教育结果时避免承诺效果。

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: Bro
cards.why: A single term of address thrown out directly pulls people instantly into the context of being called out, creating the pause of "is this talking to me?"

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: 2×2 four-panel equal division, one frame on each side of the dark background, the image is split evenly
cards.why: Four equal panels have a comic-strip rhythm that makes people read in order and anticipate the twist in the next panel.
alts: Change to two panels top and bottom
Change to three panels in a row

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Dark gray-blue background with flesh-pink skin tones, black line outlines, white text with black outlines
cards.why: The low-saturation cool background makes the flesh-toned arm stand out, and the text outline keeps it legible on complex textures.
alts: Change to pure black and white

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: All four panels show a partial hairy arm, and one panel shows two fingers and another arm
cards.why: Showing only a partial view without a face reduces the person's recognizability, so anyone can project themselves into it.
alts: Change to a person seen from behind
Change to a close-up of a cat's paw

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Rough hand-drawn texture with a bit of playful dark humor, like a casually drawn webcomic
cards.why: Being unpolished makes it feel sincere and down-to-earth, making it easy to spread as a template for remixes.

spec: Middle of the left panel, slightly right
Each panel about half width and half height

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: Bro
cards.why: 一个称呼词直接甩出，让人瞬间代入被喊话的语境，制造“这是在跟我说？”的停顿感。

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 2×2四宫格等分排布，深色底上下左右各一帧，画面被均分切割
cards.why: 四格等分像连环画的节奏，让人按顺序读完，并期待下一格的反转。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 深灰蓝背景配肉粉肤色，黑线勾边，文字用白字黑边
cards.why: 低饱和冷底把肉色手臂衬托得突出，文字描边保证在复杂纹理上也读得清。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 四格里都是带毛的手臂局部，其中一格出现两根手指与另一只手臂
cards.why: 只拍局部、不出现脸，降低了人物辨识度，任何人都能把自己套进去。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 粗糙手绘质感带点戏谑冷幽默，像随手画的网络漫画
cards.why: 不精致反而显得真诚、接地气，容易被当作模板二次创作传播。

alts: A man gestures with pinched fingers

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: One full-frame image, no blank caption area
cards.why: The single image makes it easy for anyone to overlay their own text anywhere, which is why it spreads as a template.
alts: One frame with bottom blank bar

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Warm amber and brown tones dominate the scene
cards.why: The warm, golden light feels cinematic and nostalgic, making the image feel like a frozen film moment that invites reuse.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: One person with facial hair, wearing a dark jacket, hand raised
cards.why: The clearly depicted expression and gesture provide a strong non-verbal cue that works in countless contexts.

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Slightly amused and serious, cinematic drama
cards.why: The mix of a half-smile and low-key lighting makes the character feel relatable yet theatrical, ideal for ironic commentary.

cards.why: 清晰描绘的表情和手势提供了强烈的非语言线索，适用于无数场景。

sourcePrompt.en: Create a new [Meme Template] concept Title Turn patrick to do list actually blank into a fresh social meme Subtitle Keep the classic visual rhythm, swap in a new punchline and audience insight. Creative direction: meme template Method: preserve the original template structure, conflict, eye-line, and reversal timing while replacing the situation with an English-language social insight. Please output: 1. A concise English title and subtitle for social posting; 2. 2-4 short English caption lines that can be placed directly on the meme; 3. A visual prompt for image generation or image editing, covering subject, composition, typography, stickers, and whitespace; 4. Posting advice: use case, hashtags, and engagement hook. Constraints: do not recreate a real person's identity, trademark, or watermark; do not claim source authorization; when keeping the source image, use it only as a composition reference.

sourcePrompt.en: Referencing the case study "Photos Fade, Longing Doesn't" — its old-photo restoration approach, vintage texture, visual storytelling and publishing tone — generate a new set of retro old-photo image-and-text posts. New topic: {fill in the photo topic you want to restore, reconstruct or recreate} Reference platform: Xiaohongshu Content direction: retro old-photo image-and-text Creation method: keep the original case's nostalgic emotion, film/photo-paper texture, human relationships, era-specific scene feel and restoration constraints; if it is photo restoration, it must stay faithful to the original image's identity, facial features, composition and historical context, avoiding excessive beautification, redrawing, false historical information and a modern digital plastic look. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. A 6-9 page image-and-text script, each page containing a visual description, main copy, era/texture keywords and a save prompt; 3. Visual prompts that can be used directly for image generation or photo restoration, specifying requirements for people, scene, lighting, film grain, damage repair and colour restoration; 4. Publishing suggestions: title length, tags, image ratio and platform tone. Constraints: do not recreate the original author, original people or brand logos; do not fabricate historical facts; when real people's photos are involved, prioritise identity consistency and do not make them younger, beautify, slim the face or alter facial features.
sourcePrompt.zh-CN: 参考案例《照片会泛黄 思念不会》的老照片修复方式、年代质感、画面叙事和发布语气，生成一组新的复古老照片图文。 新主题：{填写你要修复、重建或复刻的照片主题} 参考平台：小红书 内容方向：复古老照片图文 创作方法：保留原案例的怀旧情绪、胶片/相纸质感、人物关系、场景年代感和修复约束；如果是照片修复，必须忠于原图身份、五官、构图和历史语境，避免过度美颜、重绘、虚假历史信息和现代数码塑料感。 请输出： 1. 封面标题与副标题； 2. 6-9 页图文脚本，每页包含画面描述、主文案、年代/质感关键词和收藏引导； 3. 可直接用于图像生成或照片修复的视觉提示词，说明人物、场景、光线、胶片颗粒、破损修复和色彩还原要求； 4. 发布建议：标题长度、标签、图片比例和平台语气。 约束：不要复刻原作者、原人物或品牌标识；不要编造历史事实；涉及真实人物照片时优先保留身份一致性，不做年轻化、美颜、瘦脸或五官改写。

sourcePrompt.en: Referring to the case study "Put yourself from ten years ago and now into a video"—its old photo restoration approach, era texture, visual storytelling and posting tone—generate a new set of retro old-photo image-and-text content. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. A 6-9 page image-and-text script, each page containing a visual description, main copy, era/texture keywords and a save prompt; 3. sourcePrompt.en: Referencing the old-photo restoration approach, vintage texture, visual storytelling, and publishing tone of the case study "Restoring Old Photos from Your Wild Youth with AI," generate a new set of retro old-photo image-and-text posts. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. A 6-9 page image-and-text script, each page including scene description, main copy, era/texture keywords, and a save prompt; 3. Visual prompts that can be used directly for image generation or photo restoration, specifying requirements for people, scene, lighting, film grain, damage repair, and color restoration; 4. Publishing suggestions: title length, tags, image ratio, and platform tone. New topic: {fill in the topic you want to generate} Reference platform: Xiaohongshu Content direction: e-commerce product-promotion image-text Creation method: keep the original case's product scene, selling-point order, trust reasons, and conversion actions, and highlight why it's worth buying or saving. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. A 6-8 page image-text script, with each page containing the visual description, main copy, information points, and interaction/save action; 3. Visual prompts that can be used directly for image generation, explaining the subject, scene, lighting, composition, font, or layout; 4. sourcePrompt.en: Based on the reference cover's composition, visual metaphor, and WeChat public-account thumbnail readability, generate a new horizontal WeChat public-account cover. Output size: 1456x582, aspect ratio about 2.5:1; the core subject and necessary title information should also work within WeChat's safe square crop. WeChat article title: {fill in the WeChat article title} Intro: {fill in the intro} Original cover method: Saudi Media and Digital Illusions style dual-skill Create a horizontal WeChat public-account article cover, 2.35:1 aspect ratio, for an article titled "Saudi Media and Digital Illusions". Central concept: distill a single visual metaphor around "Saudi Media and Digital Illusions" and avoid cramming the whole article into the frame. Style: preserve the reference cover's visual direction: high-saturation poster/tech-advertising visuals. Use a palette inspired by #06060c (black), #020204 (black), #402a46 (charcoal), #1f1223 (charcoal). Keep the image editorial, conceptual, and readable as a small WeChat thumbnail. Composition: the frame carries a high density of information, so use a central subject plus left and right supporting information, keeping the thumbnail readable. Keep the main subject and any essential title text inside the safe square crop, while using the full wide frame for atmosphere, secondary symbols, or directional motion. Text strategy: use either no text or a very short headline fragment from the title. If text is used, make it large, clean, and integrated into the layout rather than pasted on top. Mood: match the article skill "Saudi Media and Digital Illusions style dual-skill" -- useful, sharp, high-signal, and slightly more memorable than a normal tutorial thumbnail. Avoid: photorealistic clutter unless the source cover is photo-led, fake logos, unreadable tiny text, generic gradient blobs, stock-office imagery, watermark-like marks, and literal screenshots unless the article is explicitly about software interfaces.

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: 体寒可劲吃
cards.why: Directly calls out the body-type group and gives permission to 'eat freely', hitting the fear of dietary restrictions and making people stop instantly.
alts: Change to 'Cold hands and feet, look here'
Change to 'The fruit you should eat most in summer'
Change to a question 'Can people with a cold constitution eat it?'

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Single vertical image, three sections top-middle-bottom: big title centered, green bar subtitle centered, fruit image centered below, one line of small text at the bottom.
cards.why: Centered on the middle axis, the eye reads it all in one top-to-bottom pass, perfect for instant understanding in a cover thumbnail.

cards.label: Color scheme
cards.value: Rice-grey background + dark green text and green bar, with the fruit's highly saturated red as the visual accent.
cards.why: Low-saturation background sets off the red fruit, green text feels wellness-oriented and echoes the leaves, few colors but eye-catching.
alts: Cream white background + dark green text

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A cluster of lychees in the center, three with shells and one peeled to reveal white flesh, two green leaves behind.
cards.why: One peeled lychee creates an instant 'want to eat' feeling; the red shell and white flesh contrast strongly, more appetizing than a whole one.
alts: Lychees with a glass of ice water
A whole bunch of lychees on the branch

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Clean, flat e-commerce-style studio shot, soft even light, no shadows, calm and trustworthy.
cards.why: The background-free minimalist feel is like a science card, making people feel it's trustworthy wellness advice rather than an ad.

spec: Upper part of image, centered, about 10% from top
White text on green bar: Eat the right pure-yang fruit, drive away a year of cold-damp
Fruit image centered, one line of small text at bottom
Three with shells around, peeled one in front
Cutout with background removed, no shadow
Soft and even, no hard shadows
Bottom small text notes for reference only

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: 体寒可劲吃
cards.why: 直接点名体质人群并给出“可劲吃”的许可，戳中忌口焦虑让人立刻停下。
alts: 改成“夏天最该吃的果子”
换成疑问句“体寒能吃吗”

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 单幅竖版，上中下三段：大标题居中，绿条副标题居中，下方居中放果实图，底部一行小字。
cards.why: 重心中轴排列，视线从上到下一次性读完，适合封面缩略图秒懂。

cards.why: 低饱和底衬托红果，绿字带养生感又和叶片呼应，颜色少而醒目。

cards.why: 剥开的一颗制造“想吃”的即时感，红壳白肉对比强，比整颗更有食欲。

cards.label: 氛围

cards.why: 去背景的极简感像科普卡片，让人觉得是可信的养生建议而非广告。

果实图居中，底部小字一行
左右留白均匀，页脚留空
带壳三颗环绕，剥开颗居前
底部小字提示仅供参考

sourcePrompt.en: Refer to the structure, information density and recommendation tone of the image-text post 'Save this! 8 ways to enjoy lychee in summer wellness without getting heaty', and generate a new set of Xiaohongshu list themes: title '9 everyday little things/habits that make you feel better', subtitle 'Not expensive but useful, worth saving and following'. sourcePrompt.en: Referencing the case study "Seeing Isn't Always Believing" for its old-photo restoration approach, vintage texture, visual storytelling, and posting tone, generate a new set of retro old-photo image-and-text content. New topic: {fill in the photo topic you want to restore, reconstruct, or replicate}. Reference platform: Xiaohongshu. Content direction: retro old-photo image-and-text. Creative method: keep the original case's nostalgic emotion, film/photo-paper texture, character relationships, period scene feel, and restoration constraints; if it's photo restoration, it must stay faithful to the original subject's identity, facial features, composition, and historical context, avoiding excessive beautification, redrawing, false historical information, and modern digital plastic feel. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. A 6-9 page image-and-text script, each page containing a visual description, main copy, era/texture keywords, and a save prompt; 3. Visual prompts that can be used directly for image generation or photo restoration, specifying requirements for characters, scene, lighting, film grain, damage repair, and color restoration; 4. Posting suggestions: title length, tags, image ratio, and platform tone. Constraints: do not replicate the original author, original people, or brand logos; do not fabricate historical facts; when real people's photos are involved, prioritize preserving identity consistency, and do not make them younger, beautify, slim the face, or rewrite facial features.

sourcePrompt.en: Based on the reference cover's composition, visual metaphor, and readability as a WeChat public-account thumbnail, generate a new horizontal WeChat public-account cover. sourcePrompt.en: Based on the reference cover's composition, visual metaphor, and readability as a WeChat public-account thumbnail, generate a new horizontal WeChat public-account cover. Output size: 1456x582, aspect ratio about 2.5:1; the core subject and essential title information must also work within WeChat's safe square crop. Article title: {fill in the WeChat article title} Intro: {fill in the intro} Original cover method: Someone I know earns $3,200 a month through Airbnb, but he doesn't own any property — Claude finds the listings for him. Style dual-skill Create a horizontal WeChat public-account article cover, 2.35:1 aspect ratio, for an article titled "Someone I know earns $3,200 a month through Airbnb, but he doesn't own any property — Claude finds the listings for him.". Central concept: visualize abstract tool capabilities as interface windows, code snippets, node networks, control panels, AI workflows, or a glowing system core. Style: preserve the reference cover's visual direction: black-and-white or low-saturation editorial illustration/photo. Use a palette inspired by #fdfdfd (white), #fdfdfb (white), #bcbebb (cream), #fefefe (white). Keep the image editorial, conceptual, and readable as a small WeChat thumbnail. Composition: lots of negative space, suitable for a large headline, a few icons, and a clear left-text/right-image or centered-title layout. Keep the main subject and any essential title text inside the safe square crop, while using the full wide frame for atmosphere, secondary symbols, or directional motion. Text strategy: use either no text or a very short headline fragment from the title. If text is used, make it large, clean, and integrated into the layout rather than pasted on top. cards.label: Hook
cards.value: YOU OWN THE MEMORY
cards.why: The large English declaration in the center of the image throws the benefit point "the memory is yours" right in front of the reader.

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: A large central circle in the middle, round icons in the four corners, connected by dashed lines
cards.why: The radial central composition makes the eye land on the center first, then get drawn outward by the four dashed lines, making the many-to-one relationship clear at a glance.
alts: Split the center into two images left and right

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: A warm golden mesh sphere on a white background, accented with red, orange, blue, and gray in the four corners
cards.why: Large areas of whitespace make the golden sphere glow stand out more, while the four colored dots form memory anchors, as clean and trustworthy as a product homepage.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A large sphere made of a central golden network of light points, containing a human-shaped icon
cards.why: It depicts abstract "memory/context" as a glowing net, so readers immediately understand this is the center of data aggregation.

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Clean, rational, techy, white background with soft shadows
cards.why: There is no extra decoration or emotion, matching the psychology of tool-content readers who "want the good stuff."

spec: Dead center of the image, two centered lines
Sans-serif bold uppercase, dark navy black
1 large central circle + 4 corner round icons
4 dashed lines radiate outward from the center
The four icons are distributed in 2×2 symmetry
A round sphere formed by dense light points and thin lines into a mesh
A dark human-shaped icon, positioned above the text
The four corner round icons are a red cartoon head, an orange radiating icon, a blue cloud-shaped icon, and a gray crowd icon
Self-illuminating center, soft shadow around it
High brightness, low saturation; gold is the only warm color
Flat graphics with slight dimensional shadow

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: YOU OWN THE MEMORY
cards.why: 站在画面正中的大写英文宣言，直接把“记忆归你所有”这个利益点砸到读者眼前。

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 中央大圆居中，四角圆形图标环绕，虚线连接
cards.why: 放射状中心构图让视线先落在中心再被四条虚线引向四周，一图看懂“多对一”的关系。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 暖金网状球体配白底，四角各用红、橙、蓝、灰点缀
cards.why: 大面积留白让金球发光更突出，四个彩色圆点则形成记忆锚点，像产品官网一样干净可信。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 中央金色光点网络组成的大圆球，内含人形图标
cards.why: 把抽象的“记忆/上下文”画成一张发光的网，读者一眼就懂这是数据聚合的中心。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 干净、理性、科技感，白底柔和阴影
cards.why: 没有多余的装饰和情绪，符合工具类内容读者“想看干货”的心理预期。

spec: 无衬线粗体大写，深蓝黑色
1个中心大圆 + 4个四角圆形图标
#D9534F 红、#E8734A 橙、#5B6EF5 蓝、#4A4A4A 灰
圆形球体，由密集光点与细线构成网状
深色人形图标，位于文字上方
四角圆形图标分别为红色卡通头、橙色放射图标、蓝色云形图标、灰色人群图标
中心自发光，四周柔和投影
高明度低饱和，金色为唯一暖色
扁平图形加轻微立体阴影

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: DELAY YOUR CLAUDE USAGE LIMIT
cards.why: Large text directly names the pain-point product and the consequence, making users troubled by usage limits stop scrolling immediately.
alts: Change to a question: "Quota maxed out again?"
Add a countdown number to create urgency
Switch to a promise line: "10x free quota"

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: The large title on the left takes about 40% width, the screen and person on the right take 60%, and a four-cell icon bar runs across the bottom
cards.why: Text on the left, image on the right, plus a bottom list: conclusion first, then key points, matching the scanning habits for tutorial content.
alts: Center the title in top and bottom sections
Change the bottom to two large icons

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Near-black background with orange-red title, cyan-gray and warm white inside the screen, overall dark high contrast
cards.why: Dark background plus orange-red accent feels like a technical terminal interface, giving a professional and urgent feeling.
alts: Switch to dark blue plus fluorescent green
White background with large orange-red text

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: One person sitting at a computer with their back to the camera, with three screens in front showing a quota-reached warning
cards.why: A back view plus a screen full of errors lets anyone limited by quota instantly project themselves into their own workspace.
alts: Switch to a phone screen popping up a warning
A front-facing person frowning at the screen
Only a screen close-up with no person

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Dim late-night server-room feel, cold screen light falling on the person, tense yet focused
cards.why: Dark tones plus cold light create the anxiety of "stuck at the last moment," pushing readers to click and find a solution.
alts: Warm yellow desk lamp personal desk

xray.short: Three lines of large orange title
spec: Left side of the image, taking about half the height of the left half
Bold sans-serif, mixed orange and white
One line of small text below with an orange underline

xray.short: Text left, image right, bottom bar

One full-width horizontal bar with 4 equal-width icon cells
Title left-aligned, screen group centered slightly right
A thin orange line separates the title and subtitle
#e8622a orange-red, used for title and progress bar
#8a9199 cyan-gray, used for small screen text
#f2f4f6 warm white, used for the first line of text
One person with their back to the camera, wearing a dark short-sleeve shirt, seated
Left screen shows a warning icon and two lines of text; right screen shows a 100% progress bar and countdown
A dark cup on the left side of the desk with an orange pattern
Background is a dark code interface
Cold screen light hits the person's back and shoulders from the front
High-contrast dark tones, background details fade into black
Tension and helplessness from being stuck by the quota limit

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: DELAY YOUR CLAUDE USAGE LIMIT
cards.why: 大字号直接点名痛点产品与后果，让被限额困扰的用户立刻停下滑动。
alts: 改成疑问句“额度又满了？”
加入倒计时数字制造紧迫
换成“免费翻10倍”的承诺句

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 左侧大标题占约四成宽，右侧屏幕与人物占六成，底部一条四格图标横栏
cards.why: 左文右图加底栏清单，先给结论再给要点，符合教程型内容的扫读习惯。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 近黑背景配橙红标题，屏幕内用青灰与暖白，整体暗色高对比
cards.why: 深色底加橙红强调色像技术终端界面，给人专业且紧迫的感觉。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 一人背对镜头坐在电脑前，面前三块屏幕显示额度已满的警告
cards.why: 背影加满屏报错，让每个被限额的人瞬间代入自己的工位。
alts: 换成手机屏幕弹出警告

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 昏暗深夜机房感，屏幕冷光打在人物身上，紧张又专注
cards.why: 暗调加冷光制造“卡在最后一刻”的焦虑，促使读者点开找解法。

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Collage layout. The whole image is made of multiple rectangular images of different sizes overlapping in a staggered arrangement, with a striking red square and serif letters overlaid in the center, and the slogan repeated horizontally along the bottom.
cards.why: It presents visual chaos and information overload, directly echoing the messy feel of "slop" while highlighting the central red focal point amid the clutter.
alts: Full-screen single image with overlaid text

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: High-contrast mixed colors. The background includes alternating warm and cool blocks of pink-purple, deep blue, and gray-brown, with a highly saturated true red rectangle and white text in the center, and black-white-red alternation at the bottom.
cards.why: The strong color clash and the warning feel of red are highly arresting in the feed, quickly interrupting the user's habitual scrolling.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: Multi-source visual collage. The image includes a serif letter "A" on the left, a red geometric square and logo in the center, a close-up face on the right, and nature scenery and object close-ups along the bottom.
cards.why: The mashup of multiple elements hints at the pieced-together nature of AI-generated content, giving viewers a concrete visual perception of "AI slop."
alts: A chaotic stack of color blocks

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Strong sense of critique and irony
cards.why: The whole image creates a sense of noise and manufactured chaos, carrying a satirical and cautionary tone toward the current flood of AI content.

Large bold sans-serif, alternating white and red
Overlapping collage of multiple image blocks
Background scenery and portrait photos, midground text, foreground red square
No obvious border, image edges cut into each other
Capital serif A on a purple gradient background
White streamlined logo embedded in a red square
A close-up of a person's face and a scenery photo
Strong composite feel, no obvious natural lighting logic
Information overload, the flood of AI slop

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: AI SLOP
cards.why: 极其直白且带有贬义的定义词，瞬间引发对低质内容的不满与情绪共鸣，从而产生点击欲望。

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 拼贴式排版。全图由多张不同大小的矩形图片交错重叠构成，中心区域叠加醒目的红色方块与衬线体字母，底部横向重复排列口号。
cards.why: 呈现出视觉上的混乱与信息过载，直观呼应了“垃圾内容”的杂乱感，并在杂乱中突出中央的红色视觉焦点。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 高对比度杂色。背景包含粉紫、深蓝、灰褐等冷暖交替的色块，中心使用饱和度极高的正红色矩形与白色文字，底部为黑白红交替。
cards.why: 强烈的色彩冲突和红色的警示感在信息流中极具抓取力，能迅速打断用户的惯性滑动。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 多源视觉元素拼贴。画面包含左侧的衬线体字母“A”、中央的红色几何方块与标志、右侧的人脸特写、以及底部的自然风景与物体特写。
cards.why: 多种元素的杂糅暗示了AI生成内容的拼凑本质，让观众对“AI垃圾”产生具象的视觉认知。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 强烈的批判与反讽感
cards.why: 整个画面营造出一种噪音感与人为制造的混乱，带有对当前AI内容泛滥现象的讽刺与警示意味。

spec: 画面上方正中、底部横向重复
大号加粗无衬线体，白色与红色交错
背景风景与人物照、中景文字、前景红色方块
无明显边框，图片边缘互相切割
紫色渐变背景上的大写衬线体 A
红色方块内嵌白色流线型标志
一张人物面部特写及风景照
合成感强，无明显自然光照逻辑

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: fileverse
cards.why: The eye-catching yellow circular brand mark paired with the crossed-out competitor products above creates a 'what's the alternative?' suspense that makes people want to learn what this tool is.

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Three equal-width columns side by side; each column has the old product on top, an arrow in the middle, and the new product below, forming a clear replacement relationship.
cards.why: The three-column symmetrical 'old → new' arrow structure lets readers grasp the replacement logic at a glance, lowering comprehension cost and making it easy to scan and compare quickly.

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Light gray gradient background, large red X marks, icons keep their original brands' high-saturation colors, and the new products at the bottom are mostly yellow, orange, and purple.
cards.why: The highly saturated brand colors pop against the light gray background, and the red X marks reinforce a feeling of 'rejection,' making the whole image both clear and visually striking.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: Six app icons: the top three are covered by red X marks, the bottom three are the replacement products, with gray downward arrows connecting them in the middle.
cards.why: Using familiar icons themselves as the main characters triggers 'I use that too' recognition without needing text and directly communicates the alternative solutions.

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Direct, challenging, slightly rebellious tech-review feel, as if saying 'stop using these.'
cards.why: Rejecting today's mainstream tools sparks curiosity and debate, making readers ask 'why not?' and enticing them to open the article to find out.

spec: Inside the yellow circular icon at the lower left, small proportion
Black text on a yellow background
Left, center, and right columns vertically centered
Even column spacing, each taking about 1/3 of the image width
High-saturation icons create strong contrast with the light gray background
Blue document, colorful ring, colorful envelope, all with red X marks
Yellow circle, orange shield, purple envelope
Challenges the mainstream, with a sense of rejection
Red X marks emphasize elimination, arrows point to replacements
Bright and even, no strong shadows

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 三列等宽并排，每列上为旧产品、中为箭头、下为新产品，形成清晰的替代关系。
cards.why: 三列对称的‘旧→新’箭头结构让读者一眼看懂替换逻辑，降低理解成本，便于快速扫视和比较。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 浅灰渐变背景，大红色叉号，图标保留原品牌高饱和色，底部新产品多黄、橙、紫。
cards.why: 高饱和的品牌色在浅灰背景上十分跳跃，红色叉号强化‘否定’情绪，整体既信息明确又有视觉冲击力。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 六个应用图标：上方三个被红叉覆盖，下方三个为替代产品，中间以灰色向下箭头连接。
cards.why: 用人们熟悉的图标本身当主角，无需文字说明就能触发‘我也在用’的共鸣，并直接传递替代方案。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 直接、挑战、略带叛逆的科技评测感，像在说‘别再用这些了’。
cards.why: 否定当下主流工具会激发好奇与争议，让读者产生‘凭什么’的疑问，从而愿意点开文章一探究竟。

Are you using systems that exploit this difference? Text strategy: use either no text or a very short headline fragment from the title. If text is used, make it large, clean, and integrated into the layout rather than pasted on top. Avoid: photorealistic clutter unless the source cover is photo-led, fake logos, unreadable tiny text, generic gradient blobs, stock-office imagery, watermark-like marks, and literal screenshots unless the article is explicitly about software interfaces.

cards.value: Two equal-height blocks of the same scene: the top block in black-and-white, the bottom block in color, with three lines of text pressed across the middle and lower area
cards.why: A top-and-bottom comparison lets you see the "before and after difference" at a glance, and you understand the selling point without reading the text.
alts: Left-right split: black-and-white on the left, color on the right
Full-screen black-and-white, with a small color image inset in the corner

cards.value: The upper half is grayscale black-and-white, and the lower half is mainly denim blue and gray-brown city colors
cards.why: Black-and-white and color are juxtaposed, and the color itself is the evidence of "becoming clear."
alts: The whole image is black-and-white with only one spot left in color
Overall warm sepia for an aged look

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A group of people sitting side by side on a steel beam, appearing once in black-and-white and once in color
cards.why: As soon as the familiar classic composition appears, viewers know this is an "old photo everyone has seen."
alts: Close-up of one person holding an old photo
A pair of hands holding a photo up to the screen
An empty shot with only steel beams and buildings

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Faded nostalgia against clean clarity, with a quiet sense of the era and a touch of technical satisfaction
cards.why: Nostalgic emotion plus a "I can do this too" sense of action encourages people to save it and try it.

cards.why: 上下对照一眼看懂“前后差别”，不需要读字就明白卖点。

黑白满屏，彩色小图嵌角
上中下三分：原片/处理/成片

sourcePrompt.en: Refer to the case study "Suddenly want to upgrade all the photos taken with a Nokia 20 years ago" for its old-photo restoration approach, era texture, visual storytelling, and posting tone, and generate a new set of retro old-photo image-text content. New topic: {fill in the photo topic you want to restore, rebuild, or recreate} Reference platform: Xiaohongshu Content direction: retro old-photo image-text Creation method: keep the original case's nostalgic emotion, film/photo-paper texture, character relationships, scene's sense of era, and restoration constraints; if it is photo restoration, it must stay faithful to the original image's identity, facial features, composition, and historical context, and avoid excessive beautification, repainting, false historical information, and a modern digital plastic feel. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. A 6-9 page image-text script, with each page containing a visual description, main copy, era/texture keywords, and a save prompt; 3. Visual prompts that can be used directly for image generation or photo restoration, explaining requirements for characters, scene, lighting, film grain, damage repair, and color restoration; 4. Posting suggestions: title length, tags, image ratio, and platform tone. Constraints: do not replicate the original author, original people, or brand logos; do not fabricate historical facts; when real people's photos are involved, prioritize identity consistency, and do not make them younger, beautify, slim the face, or rewrite facial features.
sourcePrompt.zh-CN: 参考案例《突然想把20年前诺基亚拍的照片全部升级一下》的老照片修复方式、年代质感、画面叙事和发布语气，生成一组新的复古老照片图文。 新主题：{填写你要修复、重建或复刻的照片主题} 参考平台：小红书 内容方向：复古老照片图文 创作方法：保留原案例的怀旧情绪、胶片/相纸质感、人物关系、场景年代感和修复约束；如果是照片修复，必须忠于原图身份、五官、构图和历史语境，避免过度美颜、重绘、虚假历史信息和现代数码塑料感。 请输出： 1. 封面标题与副标题； 2. 6-9 页图文脚本，每页包含画面描述、主文案、年代/质感关键词和收藏引导； 3. 可直接用于图像生成或照片修复的视觉提示词，说明人物、场景、光线、胶片颗粒、破损修复和色彩还原要求； 4. 发布建议：标题长度、标签、图片比例和平台语气。 约束：不要复刻原作者、原人物或品牌标识；不要编造历史事实；涉及真实人物照片时优先保留身份一致性，不做年轻化、美颜、瘦脸或五官改写。

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: 烂泥烂得好好的 / 你非要把它扶上墙
cards.why: Putting a self-deprecating complaint directly into the image lets readers instantly see themselves or the person next to them being forcibly propped up.
alts: Keep only the first line for more punch
Use the second line as the cover
Stack the two lines in parallel layout

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Two equal-width, equal-height comic panels stacked vertically, black outline borders, thin white gap in the middle
cards.why: A two-panel "current state—absurd action" contrast structure lets the whole punchline land before swiping.
alts: Compress the text below the image into a card

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Gray-blue walls and floor as the base, gray mud ball, light green robe as accent
cards.why: Low-saturation cool gray keeps the scene calm and restrained, making the absurd action stand out more and funnier.
alts: Use dark brown for the mud ball
Make the whole thing black-and-white line art

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A white round-headed figure holding a gray mud ball with both hands, pressing it onto the wall
cards.why: A faceless figure is easy for anyone to project onto, and the action of holding mud up to the wall turns "forcing it" into a visualized punchline.
alts: Change to a lying-flat mud figure
Change to a figure holding a brick with both hands
Keep only the mud ball without the figure

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: A cold, quiet wall corner, with helpless yet funny dull-humor sensibility
cards.why: No sentimentality, no slogans—using dry humor to expose inner friction, readers laugh and want to share it.
alts: A more bleak and gray mood
Add a toxic motivational ending line

Bold sans-serif, dark gray near black, centered
Placed at the top of each panel respectively
The two panels are roughly equal in height
Thick black outline, white space between panels
In the white space above each panel
White round-headed figure, no facial expression details
Arms extended forward, pressing the mud ball onto the wall
A lump of irregularly shaped gray mud
Small drip marks and motion lines beside the mud ball
Even flat light, no strong shadows
Using absurd action to talk about inner friction

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: 烂泥烂得好好的 / 你非要把它扶上墙
cards.why: 把一句自嘲式抱怨直接写进画面，读者一眼代入自己或身边那个被硬扶的人。

cards.value: 上下两格等宽等高漫画分镜，黑色描边框，中间留白细缝

cards.why: 没有脸的小人谁都能代入，捧泥上墙的动作把“强求”演成了可视化笑点。

sourcePrompt.en: Referencing the gentle expression, white-space ratio, and sense of companionship in the image-text post "Suddenly Woken Up by This Passage~", generate a new set of emotional healing themes: title "7 Small Actions to Slowly Nurture Yourself Back", subtitle "A gentle recovery checklist you can follow even during low periods". Please output a cover hook, 6 content cards, and an ending save prompt, with each page giving one empathetic line and one actionable step.
sourcePrompt.zh-CN: 参考图文《突然被这段话给点醒了～》的温柔表达、留白比例和陪伴感，生成一组新的情绪疗愈主题：标题《7个把自己慢慢养回来的小动作》，副标题“低谷期也能照着做的温柔恢复清单”。请输出封面钩子、6 页内容卡和结尾收藏引导，每页都给一句共情话和一个可执行动作。

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: SUMMER OASIS
cards.why: Large English title at the very top makes the theme clear at a glance, paired with a healing visual that makes people want to tap in and save the prompt.
alts: Change title to large Chinese characters
Add outline to title for more impact
Shrink title and place at bottom of image

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Single full-bleed image, title horizontally overlaid at the top, a line of small credit text at the bottom, no columns or borders.
cards.why: The entire image is not chopped up, the eye takes in the whole image at once, and it catches attention better when scrolling.
alts: Title top, diagonal negative space below
Large text in center with small text at bottom
Text on left, subject on right in columns

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Large areas of green as the base, cream light color spread in patches, deeper green shadows in the water ripples, overall low contrast.
cards.why: Green is fresh and clean, easy on the eyes even after long viewing, and the image is memorable at a glance.
alts: Dark green with misty blue cool tone
Cyan-green with goose yellow warm tone

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: Top-down view of a white boat with a person inside, scattered white water birds around, orange object on the boat.
cards.why: Top-down boat with flying birds feels story-driven, makes people want to zoom in to see details, increasing dwell time.
alts: Replace with an empty shot of a single boat
Replace with a school of swimming fish

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Quiet, relaxed summer vacation feel, soft even lighting, calm and healing emotion.
cards.why: Evokes summer and vacation, soothes emotions, and makes people willing to like, share, and save.

spec: Largest line of text in the image
Low contrast, green wraps the image in large areas

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: SUMMER OASIS
cards.why: 英文大字标题压在最上方，一眼看懂主题，配合治愈画面让人想点开收藏咒语。

cards.value: 单张通版画面，标题横排叠在画面上方，底部一行小字署名，无分栏无边框。
cards.why: 整幅画面不被切碎，视线一次看完整张图，滑动时更抓眼。

sourcePrompt.en: Create a new [Meme Template] concept Title Turn Surprised Pikachu into a fresh social meme Subtitle Keep the classic visual rhythm, swap in a new punchline and audience insight. Creative direction: meme template Method: preserve the original template structure, conflict, eye-line, and reversal timing while replacing the situation with an English-language social insight. Please output: 1. A concise English title and subtitle for social posting; 2. 2-4 short English caption lines that can be placed directly on the meme; 3. A visual prompt for image generation or image editing, covering subject, composition, typography, stickers, and whitespace; 4. Posting advice: use case, hashtags, and engagement hook. Constraints: do not recreate a real person's identity, trademark, or watermark; do not claim source authorization; when keeping the source image, use it only as a composition reference.
sourcePrompt.zh-CN: 创建一个新的[表情包模板]概念 标题 将惊讶皮卡丘变成新鲜社交表情包 副标题 保留经典视觉节奏，替换上新的笑点和受众洞察。 创意方向：表情包模板 方法：保留原模板结构、冲突、视线和反转时机，同时将情境替换为英语社交洞察。 请输出：1. 简洁的英语标题和副标题用于社交发布；2. 2-4条简短的英语说明文字，可直接放在表情包上；3. 用于图像生成或图像编辑的视觉提示，涵盖主体、构图、排版、贴纸和留白；4. 发布建议：使用场景、话题标签和互动钩子。 限制：不要重建真实人物的身份、商标或水印；不要声称来源授权；保留源图像时，仅将其用作构图参考。

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: 卫生巾 / 棉条
cards.why: Two contrasting words directly throw out a choice dilemma, making people want to keep reading to see the difference.

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Two equally sized panels stacked top and bottom, with a title word in the top-left of each, and blank space at the bottom
cards.why: The top-bottom comparison structure is clear at a glance, visually like a page-flip snapshot, making it easy to swipe to the second image.

cards.label: Color Palette
cards.value: White background with black outlines, orange skin tone paired with a grass-green vest, title in pure black bold
cards.why: The low-saturation background does not steal the spotlight, and the strong contrast of black text on a white background makes the title be read at first glance.
alts: Switch to a cream paper color

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A cartoon girl with double braids, wearing a white T-shirt and a green vest, appearing once in each of the top and bottom panels
cards.why: The same character appearing repeatedly reinforces the contrast, and the exaggerated expression makes people unable to resist screenshotting and sending it to group chats.
alts: Switch to a male character for comparison
Switch to a dialogue between two characters

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: A lighthearted, slightly self-mocking science-popularization feel
cards.why: Using a cute art style to dissolve the awkwardness of a private topic makes readers more willing to save and share it.
alts: Change to a serious science-popularization style
Change to a bestie chat style
Change to an exaggerated comedy style

Whitespace between the title area and the character

cards.label: 钩子

cards.why: 两个对比词直接抛出选择难题，让人想往下看区别。

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 上下两个等大画格，左上方各放一个标题词，底部留白
cards.why: 上下对比结构一目了然，视觉上像翻页快照，方便划到第二张。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 白底黑色描边，橙肤色配草绿背心，标题纯黑加粗
cards.why: 低饱和底色不抢戏，黑字白底强对比让标题第一眼被读到。

Keep only the icons and remove the character

sourcePrompt.en: Referencing the old photo restoration method, period texture, visual storytelling and publishing tone of the case study "The Era of Seeing Is Believing Is Over," generate a new set of retro old-photo image-and-text posts. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. A 6-9 page image-and-text script, with each page containing a visual description, main copy, period/texture keywords and a save prompt; 3. Visual prompts that can be used directly for image generation or photo restoration, explaining requirements for characters, scene, lighting, film grain, damage repair and color restoration; 4. Publishing suggestions: title length, tags, image ratio and platform tone. Constraints: Do not replicate the original author, original people or brand logos; do not fabricate historical facts; when real people's photos are involved, prioritize identity consistency, and do not make them younger, beautify, slim the face or rewrite facial features.

cards.why: The symmetrical left-right contrast makes a complex idea understandable at a glance and lowers comprehension cost.

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: 头部养生的重要性
cards.why: A large Chinese title directly throws out a health proposition most people overlook, paired with English backing above, creating a "professional science" sense of trust that makes people keep reading for the explanation.
alts: Change to a numbered list title
Put the conclusion first as a pain-point title

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Single-image full-bleed poster-style layout, text stacked centered from top to bottom along a vertical visual axis, English at top, big title in middle, dark rounded background at bottom carrying the body paragraph
cards.why: Top and bottom layered text stacking forms a reading flow, with strong contrast between big title and small body text, suitable for reading in one vertical phone screen, with strong motivation to save.
alts: Change to left text right image columns
Change body to three parallel cards
Add a divider line under the title

cards.label: Color Palette
cards.value: Overall warm brown-gold tone, dark areas deep brown, highlights leaning amber, white text pressed on opaque dark gray-brown blocks to ensure readability
cards.why: Warm brown-gold carries associations of herbs, therapy, and wellness; dark tones with white text look calm and premium, not like a cheap ad, and are easily saved as valuable content.
alts: Change to off-white + ink-green herbal feel
Change to light skin tone low saturation
Black background with gold foil premium texture

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A person lying on their side with face up and eyes closed in relaxation, with a hand and wooden tool near the top of their head on the right side of the frame
cards.why: The supine receiving posture conveys a sense of being cared for and relaxed, and viewers project themselves into it, creating the urge "I want to be massaged like that too."
alts: Change to self-massaging the head at home
Shoot a scalp close-up + technique demonstration

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Quiet, warm, healing, warm light falling from the upper side, a soft glow over the image, like a relaxed moment at a therapy clinic or home care
cards.why: The relaxed image first soothes emotions, then lets the text persuade reason; viewers are more willing to believe the content and save it when their emotions are cared for.
alts: Change to morning light dawn feel
Add mist and steam for more healing
Change cool tone to clinic professional feel

Open with a question to force people to read on

cards.label: Layout

Split the title into upper and lower sections with the image in between

Visual prompts that can be directly used for image generation, specifying subject, scene, lighting, composition, fonts, or layout; 4. sourcePrompt.en: Refer to the case 《The past is all fake, memories have no way back》's old photo restoration approach, vintage texture, visual storytelling and posting tone, and generate a new set of retro old-photo image-and-text posts. New theme: {fill in the photo theme you want to restore, rebuild or recreate} Reference platform: Xiaohongshu Content direction: retro old-photo image-and-text Creation method: keep the original case's nostalgic mood, film/photo-paper texture, character relationships, period feel of the scene and restoration constraints; if it is photo restoration, it must stay faithful to the original image's identity, facial features, composition and historical context, and avoid over-beautification, redrawing, false historical information and a modern digital plastic feel. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. A 6-9 page image-and-text script, each page containing the visual description, main copy, period/texture keywords and a save prompt; 3. Visual prompts that can be used directly for image generation or photo restoration, explaining the requirements for characters, scene, lighting, film grain, damage repair and color restoration; 4. Posting suggestions: title length, tags, image ratio and platform tone. Constraints: do not replicate the original author, original people or brand logos; do not fabricate historical facts; when real people's photos are involved, prioritize identity consistency, and do not make them younger, beautify, slim the face or alter facial features.

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: AI

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: A single horizontal composition: the top third is sky and city, the middle section is a chasm, and the lower part is packed with people.
cards.why: The horizon is deliberately lowered, creating an oppressive upward-looking viewpoint from the crowd and heightening the sense of anxiety.

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: A black, white, and gray monochrome, using dense line hatching to depict shadow and light.
cards.why: The high-contrast black-and-white woodcut texture makes the image feel heavy and serious, carrying the narrative weight of an apocalypse.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A large, dense crowd in the foreground, most faces turned forward or upward, with grave expressions.
cards.why: Countless similar faces create a grand sense of collective unconsciousness, making people think of their own place in the technological wave.
alts: A dense sea of dark silhouettes

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Oppressive and solemn, with a strong metaphor of dystopia and class division.
cards.why: The bright futuristic city and the gray underclass crowd are separated by an abyss, directly striking the fear of class rigidity.

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: THE PESHWA LEGACY STATECRAFT. STRATEGY. SUPREMACY.
cards.why: The huge all-caps headline and three parallel words create an epic feel, immediately telling viewers this is history worth saving.

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Top: four portraits plus map and chronology; middle: mounted figure centered; bottom: four equal-width image-text boxes
cards.why: Figures, map, battles, and conclusion are arranged in zones; though information is dense, the hierarchy is clear, making it easy to scan and screenshot.
alts: Keep only two columns at the bottom

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Deep brown-black base, orange flags and gold text for highlights, overall antique painting tone
cards.why: Low-brightness warm colors evoke old scrolls and oil paintings, making the history feel weighty and credible, while high-contrast gold text ensures readability.
alts: Add vermilion as the main color

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A mounted rider at center-left, with flags, army, castle, and map behind
cards.why: The mounted rider serves as the visual anchor; with flags and army, it turns abstract 'power' into a perceptible leader figure.
alts: Change to several people side by side

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: A solemn feel where epic, glory, war, and governance coexist
cards.why: The overall mood makes readers feel this is a grand narrative worth reading carefully, not scattered historical fragments.

spec: How the Peshwas took the Maratha Empire to its Zenith
Mounted rider centered, map and battle boxes on each side
Combination of left alignment and center alignment
A mounted rider wearing a turban and cloak
Oil painting and old map textures

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: THE PESHWA LEGACY STATECRAFT. STRATEGY. SUPREMACY.
cards.why: 巨大的全大写标题和三个并列词制造出史诗感，让人立刻判断这是一份值得收藏的历史干货。

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 上部四头像加地图与年表，中部骑马人物居中，底部四栏图文方框
cards.why: 把人物、地图、战役和结论分区排布，信息虽多但层级清晰，方便读者扫读和截图保存。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 深棕黑打底，橙色旗帜与金色文字提亮，整体古画色调
cards.why: 低明度暖色模拟旧卷轴与油画质感，让历史题材显得厚重可信，同时高对比金字保证可读性。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 一位骑马者居左中，身后旗帜、军队、城堡与地图
cards.why: 骑马者作为视觉锚点，配合旗帜和军队，把抽象的“强权”变成一个可感知的领袖形象。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 史诗、荣耀、战争与治理并存的庄严感
cards.why: 整体氛围让读者感到这是一段值得认真阅读的宏大叙事，而不是零散的历史碎片。

cards.label: Subject

cards.label: Mood

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: The Neocloud Boom
cards.why: The oversized bold slogan points directly at the industry's hottest opportunity, creating a sense of scarcity and opportunity that makes people want to know where the value comes from.

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: A single horizontal banner, with a text area on the left and the building as the main subject on the right; a light gray ground line compresses the image into two layers, creating a diagonal sightline from upper left to lower right.
cards.why: The horizontal split of text on the left and image on the right makes the title instantly readable, and the architectural perspective draws the eye toward the signage, with a clean, uncrowded information hierarchy.
alts: Rule of thirds with text left and image right

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: A large light gray-white background, deep blue-black building blocks and deep blue title, with cool white light strips and blue polyline accents, overall cool-toned and minimal industrial.
cards.why: Cool gray-blue carries inherent credibility in tech and capital, and the deep blue contrasts strongly against the light background, making both text and graphics stand out clearly.
alts: Add a touch of neon warm color
Switch to a slate-gray dominant tone

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: On the right is a dark elongated building with a full row of light strips on its facade and a glowing letter sign hanging on one corner; in the lower left of the image, a blue arrow polyline rises upward.
cards.why: The building represents capital-intensive computing infrastructure, while the rising polyline turns the narrative from "facility" into "value growth," making the theme immediately clear.
alts: Switch to a chip hero image

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Calm, rational, restrained, like an investment bank research cover; unified cool lighting and negative space bring a sense of professionalism and futuristic feel.
cards.why: The restrained visuals do not compete with the title, yet convey "this is a serious judgment," making it more suitable to be saved and shared with peers.

Why trillions of enterprise value are about to be created.
Main headline is about three times the subtitle
Main headline deep blue-black, subtitle gray
About 60% width on the left, vertically centered slightly above

Glowing letter mark on one corner of the building

Clear light and dark blocks, crisp edges
Restrained, rational, corporate research cover feel
Large empty area in the upper half, strong sense of breathing room

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: The Neocloud Boom
cards.why: 超大加粗标语直指行业风口，制造稀缺与机会感，让人想知道价值从何而来。

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 单幅横幅，左侧文字区右侧建筑主体，浅灰地面线把画面压成上下两层，左上到右下形成斜向视线。
cards.why: 左文右图的横向对分让标题一眼可读，建筑透视把视线引向招牌，信息层级干净不挤。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 大面积浅灰白背景，深蓝黑建筑块与深蓝标题，冷白灯带与蓝色折线做点缀，整体冷色调、极简工业感。
cards.why: 冷灰蓝自带科技与资本可信度，深蓝在浅底上对比强烈，文字和图形都被衬得清晰。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 右侧一栋深色长条建筑，立面上有整排灯带，一角挂有发光字母招牌，画面左下一道蓝色箭头折线向上升。
cards.why: 建筑代表重资产算力设施，上升折线把叙事从“设施”翻成“价值增长”，一看就懂主题。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 冷静、理性、克制，像投行研究封面，统一冷光与留白带来专业与未来感。
cards.why: 克制的视觉不会抢标题，却让人感到“这是严肃的判断”，更适合被收藏和转发给同行。

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: 春滿金山来事
cards.why: The old-style couplets written vertically on red paper on the wall are a strong era symbol, immediately pulling people back to the main room of their own old home.
alts: Keep only the image without text

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Single full composition, 1 scene: people and table at the bottom, background is a wall full of paintings and couplets.
cards.why: A full frame without grids lets the full table of people and the wall of old objects be seen at once, with lots of information but not hard on the eyes, suitable for stopping the scroll.
alts: Split into two sections top and bottom
Collage into a nine-grid of old photos

cards.label: Color Palette
cards.value: Warm beige-yellow walls, dark brown wood furniture, gray-green floor, overall warm tone of old photos.
cards.why: Warm yellow plus dark wood color is like the faded base of old photos, with red paper popping out in the middle, exactly the colors of home in memory.
alts: Fade overall to black and white
Emphasize red as the main tone
Change to cold gray-blue overcast sky

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: Several people sitting around a wooden table, table covered with a floral tablecloth, bowls and dishes placed, long wooden benches beside the table.
cards.why: Eating around a table is the most relatable life scene, everyone can identify and think of their own home.
alts: Only photograph a table of food
Move to a dining table in the yard

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Old-style family dinner painted with watercolor brushstrokes, warm lighting and old furniture bring a quiet nostalgic feel.
cards.why: Soft nostalgia is not heavy, it warms the heart after viewing, so people are more willing to like and save.

xray.short: Vertical red paper characters on wall
spec: Right side of the image, arranged vertically
Single character height about one-tenth of the frame

xray.short: Warm yellow wall with dark wood
spec: Large area of warm beige-yellow wall
Dark brown wood furniture and benches
Soft warm light indoors, bright spots on the floor

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: 春滿金山来事
cards.why: 墙上红纸竖写的旧式对联是强烈的年代符号，一眼就把人拉回自家老屋的堂屋。

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 单幅满构图，1 个画面：人物和桌子在下方，背景是整面挂画与对联的墙。
cards.why: 不分格的一整幅让满桌人和满墙旧物同时入眼，信息多却不费眼，适合停下滑动。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 墙面暖米黄、家具深褐木色、地面灰绿，整体是旧照片的暖调。
cards.why: 暖黄加暗木色像褪色的老照片底色，红纸在中间跳出来，正是记忆里老家的颜色。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 几个人围坐在木桌旁，桌面铺花桌布，摆着碗和菜，桌边是长条木凳。
cards.why: 围桌吃饭是最容易被代入的生活场景，人人都能对号入座想起自己家。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 水彩笔触画的旧式家庭晚饭，暖调光线与老家具带来安静的怀旧感。
cards.why: 柔和的怀旧不沉重，看完心里发暖，所以更愿意点赞和收藏。

spec: 单字高度约占画幅一成
屋内柔暖的光，地面有亮斑

sourcePrompt.en: Referencing the old photo restoration method, vintage texture, visual storytelling, and publishing tone of the case study "When the school bell rings, which home would you most want to go back to for dinner~", generate a new set of vintage old photo image-text posts. New theme: {fill in the photo theme you want to restore, rebuild, or replicate} Reference platform: Xiaohongshu Content direction: vintage old photo image-text Creation method: retain the nostalgic emotion, film/photo paper texture, character relationships, scene era feel, and restoration constraints of the original case; if it is photo restoration, it must be faithful to the original image's identity, facial features, composition, and historical context, avoiding excessive beautification, redrawing, false historical information, and modern digital plastic feel. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. 6-9 pages of image-text script, each page including scene description, main copy, era/texture keywords, and save guide; 3. Visual prompts that can be directly used for image generation or photo restoration, explaining character, scene, lighting, film grain, damage repair, and color restoration requirements; 4. Publishing suggestions: title length, tags, image ratio, and platform tone. Constraints: do not replicate the original author, original characters, or brand logos; do not fabricate historical facts; when involving real people's photos, prioritize identity consistency, and do not do rejuvenation, beautification, face slimming, or facial feature rewriting.

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: I'VE FINALLY FOUND IT... AFTER 15 YEARS
cards.why: A speech bubble claiming a long, arduous search sets up the comic's quest premise and pulls readers into the reveal.

cards.label: Layout

cards.label: Palette

cards.why: The earthy, slightly drab palette keeps focus on the bright yellow scroll and its blank reveal.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A green humanoid character in a wide-brimmed brown hat, holding a blank yellow scroll.
cards.why: The simple, expressive character plus the conspicuously blank scroll makes the meme template instantly reusable.

cards.label: Mood

Top-left panel, in white speech bubble
Blank yellow scroll in final panels

cards.why: 从喜悦到“NYEHHH”愤怒的突然情绪反转，正是这个模板有趣且易于分享的原因。

sourcePrompt.en: Please generate a new horizontal WeChat public-account cover based on the reference cover's composition, visual metaphors, and readability as a WeChat thumbnail. Output size: 1456x582, ratio about 2.5:1; keep the core subject and essential title information within the safe square crop for WeChat. Article title: {fill in the WeChat article title} Summary: {fill in summary} Original cover method: The Shared Traits of "Full-Time Housewives": The Women Husbands Want to Cherish dual-skill style Create a horizontal WeChat public-account article cover, 2.35:1 aspect ratio, for an article titled "The Shared Traits of \"Full-Time Housewives\": The Women Husbands Want to Cherish". Central concept: visualize abstract tool capabilities as interface windows, code snippets, node networks, control panels, AI workflows, or glowing system cores. Style: preserve the reference cover's visual direction: light-background minimalist infographic/product slide. Use a palette inspired by #faf1ed (white), #f3e6e2 (cream), #fcf7f4 (white), #fdfcf9 (white). Keep the image editorial, conceptual, and readable as a small WeChat thumbnail. Composition: lots of whitespace, suitable for a large title, a few icons, and a clear left-text/right-image or center-title layout. Keep the main subject and any essential title text inside the safe square crop, while using the full wide frame for atmosphere, secondary symbols, or directional motion. Text strategy: use either no text or a very short headline fragment from the title. If text is used, make it large, clean, and integrated into the layout rather than pasted on top. Mood: match the article skill "the shared traits of full-time housewives, the women husbands want to cherish, dual-skill style" -- useful, sharp, high-signal, and slightly more memorable than a normal tutorial thumbnail. Avoid: photorealistic clutter unless the source cover is photo-led, fake logos, unreadable tiny text, generic gradient blobs, stock-office imagery, watermark-like marks, and literal screenshots unless the article is explicitly about software interfaces.

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: Claude can do more than you think
cards.why: Use a single assertive claim to create a cognitive gap, making people wonder if they've missed out on features, so they click.
alts: Stop using only the chat box

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Hand-drawn central radial structure diagram, with 12 feature cards distributed across four rows
cards.why: A central radial layout makes it instantly clear that 'a bunch of features all belong to one tool' — high information density without looking messy.
alts: Feature list laid out one by one

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Off-white background + black hand-drawn lines + orange key highlights
cards.why: A low-saturation paper-like background reduces pressure, while orange appears only at key points to guide the eye's sequence.
alts: Pure black and white with no accent color

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A rounded rectangle in the center reading Claude, surrounded by 12 feature cards with icons
cards.why: Draw abstract product capabilities as countable physical cards, making people feel 'this content is worth saving.'
alts: Screenshot of a person using the interface

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Hand-drawn notes style: rational, clean, tool-like
cards.why: The hand-drawn feel closes the distance, like useful notes compiled by a friend — easier to share than official graphics.

spec: Claude can do more than you think
Top center, about 56% of the width
An orange underline beneath both do more and you think
A rounded rectangle in the middle, reading Claude
5 in the top row, 1 on each side in the middle, 5 in the bottom row, distributed around the center
Thin arrows point from the cards toward the center
Cards evenly spaced, with even white space around the edges
Orange appears only on the title keywords and the central icon
Rounded rectangle box, with an orange radiating star on the left and the word Claude on the right
Each card contains a line-drawn icon and one line of English label
Uniform thin black outlines, no fill
Rational, fresh, a sense of organized knowledge
One line of handwritten explanatory text, with an orange underline below

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: Claude can do more than you think
cards.why: 用一句断言制造认知落差，让人怀疑自己是不是用漏了功能，从而点开。

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 手绘风格的中心辐射结构图，12 个功能卡片分布在四行
cards.why: 中心辐射让“一堆功能都属于同一个工具”一眼成立，信息密度高却不乱。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 米白底 + 黑色手写线条 + 橙色重点标记
cards.why: 低饱和纸感底色降低压迫感，橙色只在关键处出现，引导视线顺序。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 中央写有 Claude 的圆角矩形框，周围环绕 12 个带图标的功能卡片
cards.why: 把抽象的产品能力画成可数的实物卡片，让人觉得“内容值得收藏”。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 手绘笔记式的理性、干净、工具感
cards.why: 手绘感拉近距离，像朋友整理的干货笔记，比官方图更容易被转发。

spec: Claude can do more than you think
do more 与 you think 下方各有一条橙色下划线
中部一个圆角矩形，内写 Claude
上排 5、中左右各 1、下排 5，围绕中心分布
细箭头由卡片指向中心
卡片等距，四周留白均匀
#E8722C 橙色下划线与星形图标
橙色仅出现在标题关键词与中心图标
圆角矩形框，左侧橙色放射星形，右侧 Claude 字样
每个卡片含一个线描图标与一行英文标签
理性、清爽、被整理过的知识感
一行手写说明句，下方有橙色下划线

cards.label: Hook
cards.why: There is no text on the image; the close-up of two glossy dishes and the full table setting put appetite front and center at first glance.
alts: Add large text: Anyone can make it
Overlay a price corner tag: less than 20 per meal
Two-line vertical list of dish names

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Single overhead shot of the tabletop, no panels; two white plates staggered vertically, a white bowl of rice at the lower left, chopsticks placed diagonally on the right
cards.why: The overhead shot puts all dishes in frame at the same time, with plates and bowls staggered so the whole content can be seen at a glance, giving enough information in the cover image all at once.
alts: Top-and-bottom split of raw and cooked comparison
Large finished-dish image with small step photos in the corner

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: White porcelain and the off-white tabletop as the base, caramel brown of the sauce as the heaviest color, tomato red as an accent, gray-beige placemat to anchor the image
cards.why: The off-white background makes the dark brown sauce and red look more appetizing, and the colors stay clean without competing with the food.
alts: Dark background with high contrast to set off the dishes

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: Three white porcelain pieces: a plate of sauce-coated meat chunks sprinkled with sesame and scallions, a plate of tomato shrimp scrambled eggs, and a bowl of white rice
cards.why: Two home-style rice dishes in the same frame let viewers directly imagine what they will make tonight.
alts: A hand bringing a plate into frame
Add a bowl of soup to make three dishes

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: A home-style dining table under natural window light, soft reflections on the porcelain, glossy hot dishes, as if just out of the pan and ready to eat
cards.why: The relaxed feel of an everyday dining table lowers the barrier to imitation and makes people feel they can succeed by following along.

spec: Natural light on the tabletop, highlights on the porcelain
Everyday home-style, just out of the pan

cards.label: 钩子
cards.why: 画面上没有任何文字，靠两盘油亮菜品的特写和满桌摆盘直接把食欲摆在第一眼。

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 单幅俯拍桌面，无分格；两只白盘上下错落，左下白碗盛米饭，右侧斜放筷子
cards.why: 俯拍让所有菜同时入镜，盘碗错落排布一眼看完全部内容，信息在首图里一次给足。
alts: 成品大图加角落小步骤图

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 白瓷与桌面的米白打底，酱汁的焦糖棕最重，番茄红作点睛，餐垫灰米色压住画面
cards.why: 米白底让深棕酱汁和红色显得更馋人，色彩干净不抢菜。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 三只白瓷餐具：一盘裹酱汁的肉块撒芝麻与葱花，一盘番茄虾仁炒蛋，一碗白米饭
cards.why: 两道家常下饭菜同框，观众能直接对号入座自己今晚要做什么。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 靠窗自然光下的家常餐桌，瓷面反光柔和，热菜油亮，像刚出锅就开饭
cards.why: 日常餐桌的松弛感降低模仿门槛，让人觉得照着做也能成功。

spec: 桌面自然光，瓷面有高光

sourcePrompt.en: Refer to the case study "These two dishes are insanely good with rice! So easy anyone can make them!" for its content structure, cover hook, visual pacing, and publishing tone, and generate a new set of viral image-text posts. New topic: {fill in the topic you want to generate} Reference platform: Xiaohongshu Content direction: e-commerce product promotion image-text Creation method: Keep the original case's product scenes, selling point order, trust reasons, and conversion actions, and highlight why it's worth buying or saving. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. 6-8 page image-text script, each page including visual description, main copy, information points, and interaction/save action; 3. Visual prompts that can be used directly for image generation, specifying subject, scene, lighting, composition, fonts or layout; 4. Publishing suggestions: title length, tags, image ratio, and platform tone. Constraints: Do not replicate the original author, original characters, or brand identity; do not fabricate data; when it involves health, metaphysics, investment, or educational outcomes, avoid promising results.
sourcePrompt.zh-CN: 参考案例《这两道无敌下饭！简单到有手就能做！》的内容结构、首图钩子、画面节奏和发布语气，生成一组新的爆款图文。 新主题：{填写你要生成的主题} 参考平台：小红书 内容方向：电商带货图文 创作方法：保留原案例的商品场景、卖点顺序、信任理由和转化动作，突出为什么值得买或收藏。 请输出： 1. 封面标题与副标题； 2. 6-8 页图文脚本，每页包含画面描述、主文案、信息点和互动/收藏动作； 3. 可直接用于图像生成的视觉提示词，说明主体、场景、光线、构图、字体或版式； 4. 发布建议：标题长度、标签、图片比例和平台语气。 约束：不要复刻原作者、原人物或品牌标识；不要编造数据；涉及健康、玄学、投资、教育结果时避免承诺效果。

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: 你要记住，除了生病
cards.why: Use an unfinished sentence as a reminder to create suspense, making people unable to resist reading the second half.

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Two equal-height frames stacked vertically, each with white-background black-text subtitles at the bottom
cards.why: The top-and-bottom layout is like a comic strip, with a natural reading order; one image per screen while swiping feels very smooth.
alts: Single image with whitespace around it

cards.label: Color Palette
cards.value: Deep blue night and warm yellow light create a warm-cool contrast
cards.why: Cool colors calm people, warm colors comfort them; the tones themselves speak for the text.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A round-headed stick figure, orange monk robe, sitting cross-legged with palms together or hand on chest
cards.why: The minimalist figure has no identity, so anyone can project themselves onto it, making emotional projection stronger.
alts: Replace with a person seen from behind
Replace with a hand-drawn line art

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: A sense of calm from sitting quietly at night and self-healing in the morning light
cards.why: Healing imagery lowers defensiveness, making people willing to stop, read to the end, and save it.
alts: By the window in the rain

Bottom of the first frame, about 80% of the width
Bold sans-serif, white background black text

Each about half, divided equally top and bottom
Independent subtitle bar at the bottom of each frame

By the window at night and by the bed in the daytime
Left image dark night side light, right image morning slanted light

cards.value: 你要记住，除了生病
cards.why: 用一句断句未完的叮嘱制造悬念，让人忍不住看完下半句。

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 上下两个等高画幅，每幅底部白底黑字字幕
cards.why: 上下对照的排版像连环画，阅读顺序自然，滑动时一屏一图很顺。

cards.label: 配色

cards.why: 冷色让人安静、暖色给人安慰，色调本身就在替文字说话。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 一个圆头火柴人，橙色僧袍，盘坐合掌或抚胸

cards.why: 疗愈画面降低防御心，让人愿意停下来读完并收藏。

sourcePrompt.en: Create a new [Meme Template] concept Title Turn They Are The Same Picture into a fresh social meme Subtitle Keep the classic visual rhythm, swap in a new punchline and audience insight. Creative direction: meme template Method: preserve the original template structure, conflict, eye-line, and reversal timing while replacing the situation with an English-language social insight. Please output: 1. A concise English title and subtitle for social posting; 2. 2-4 short English caption lines that can be placed directly on the meme; 3. A visual prompt for image generation or image editing, covering subject, composition, typography, stickers, and whitespace; 4. Posting advice: use case, hashtags, and engagement hook. Constraints: do not recreate a real person's identity, trademark, or watermark; do not claim source authorization; when keeping the source image, use it only as a composition reference.
sourcePrompt.zh-CN: 创建一个新的[表情包模板]概念标题：将“它们是一样的图片”转化为新鲜的社交表情包副标题：保留经典视觉节奏，替换成新的笑点和受众洞察。创作方向：表情包模板方法：保留原始模板结构、冲突、视线和反转时机，同时将情境替换为英语社交洞察。请输出：1. 用于社交发布的简洁英文标题和副标题；2. 2-4条可直接放在表情包上的简短英文说明文字；3. 用于图像生成或图像编辑的视觉提示，涵盖主体、构图、排版、贴纸和留白；4. 发布建议：使用场景、话题标签和互动钩子。限制：不要重现真实人物的身份、商标或水印；不要声称获得来源授权；保留源图像时，仅将其用作构图参考。

cards.label: Hook
cards.why: A lone blank-faced figure in a party hat immediately signals social exclusion and invites the viewer to project their own caption.
alts: Zoom in on the party hat

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: One single white panel with three loose figure clusters: one vertical pair, one pair at left, one pair at right.
cards.why: The sparse all-white field with no borders keeps the focus on the emotional distance between the three groups.

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Pure black line art on pure white with no fill colours or shading.
cards.why: The uncoloured, sketchy look reads as an unfinished template, so anyone can drop their own story into it.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: Party hat figure standing alone while three pairs of figures pair off around them.
cards.why: The visual of being left out while others couple up is instantly readable and painfully relatable.
alts: Zoom in on the lone face
Add a phone in their hand

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Quietly melancholic, awkward third-wheel feeling of a party you were not invited to.
cards.why: The flat expressions and physical distance make the loneliness feel real and shareable without saying a word.
alts: Turn it into a rave scene

spec: loner upright and still, others leaning together

cards.label: 钩子
cards.why: 一个戴着派对帽、面无表情的孤独身影会立刻传达出社交排斥感，并邀请观众代入自己的配文。
alts: 用箭头指向那个落单的人

cards.label: 布局
cards.value: 一个单独的白色面板，包含三组松散的人物：一组竖向两人，一组在左侧的两人，一组在右侧的两人。
cards.why: 没有边框的全白稀疏画面让焦点保持在三个群体之间的情感距离上。
alts: 裁切到只剩那个落单的人

cards.label: 调色板
cards.value: 纯白底上的纯黑线稿，没有填充色或阴影。
cards.why: 无上色的草图感看起来像未完成的模板，因此任何人都能把自己的故事放进去。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 戴派对帽的人物独自站着，周围有三对人物两两配对。
cards.why: 别人成双成对而自己被排除在外的画面一眼就能看懂，而且令人痛苦地有共鸣。

cards.label: 情绪
cards.value: 安静忧郁、尴尬的第三人感，像一场你并未被邀请的派对。
cards.why: 平淡的表情和身体距离让孤独感显得真实且易于分享，甚至不用说一句话。

spec: 3（左侧一对、右侧一对、站立的落单者）
各组之间的大块白色空隙
站立，拿着杯子，戴派对帽
落单者站得笔直而静止，其他人相互倚靠
