sourcePrompt.zh-CN: 创建一个新的[表情包模板]概念 标题 把“他们不知道”变成新鲜的社交梗 副标题 保留经典的视觉节奏，换入新的包袱和受众洞察。创意方向：表情包模板 方法：保留原始模板结构、冲突、视线和反转时机，同时将情境替换为英语社交洞察。请输出：1. 用于社交发布的简洁英文标题和副标题；2. 2-4行可直接放在表情包上的简短英文配文；3. 用于图像生成或图像编辑的视觉提示，涵盖主体、构图、排版、贴纸和留白；4. 发布建议：使用场景、话题标签和互动钩子。限制：不要重现真实人物的身份、商标或水印；不要声称拥有来源授权；保留源图像时，仅将其用作构图参考。

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: 现在叫提供情绪价值
cards.why: Redefine brown-nosing with corporate jargon, creating a cognitive clash that makes people chuckle.

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Two equally divided comic panels, top and bottom, with the title centered and enlarged on the first image.
cards.why: The top-bottom comparison structure is clear, letting you grasp the before-and-after contrast at a glance.
alts: Single image with big text at the bottom

cards.label: Color Palette
cards.value: Cool blue on top and warm yellow below, black cat with red tie for high contrast.
cards.why: Cool and warm zones reinforce the emotional shift, and high contrast makes the character stand out more.
alts: Black and white plus a touch of red

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A black cartoon cat wearing round glasses and a red tie, with different expressions in the top and bottom panels.
cards.why: Anthropomorphic animals have built-in cuteness, and exaggerated expressions amplify the emotional contrast.

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Funny and playful, with a relaxed workplace self-mockery vibe.
cards.why: Self-deprecating humor lowers the preachy feel and makes people willing to share and complain.

spec: Used to be called brown-nosing / Now called providing emotional value
Centered at the top of the upper and lower panels respectively
2 equally divided panels, top and bottom
Even outer white space, narrow gap between panels
A black cat with round glasses and a red tie, with a white muzzle and paws
Frowning with pursed lips, with star-shaped symbols beside it
Mouth open in a smile, left paw holding up a light bulb
Light and funny, with workplace complaints
Flat coloring with no strong shadows, soft
A reversal from helplessness to smugness

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: 现在叫提供情绪价值
cards.why: 用职场黑话重新定义拍马屁，制造认知冲突让人会心一笑。

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 上下两格等分漫画，首图标题居中放大。
cards.why: 上下对比结构清晰，一眼看懂前后反差。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 上冷蓝下暖黄，黑猫配红领带高对比。
cards.why: 冷暖分区强化情绪转折，高对比让角色更醒目。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 戴圆眼镜、系红领带的黑色卡通猫，上下两格表情不同。
cards.why: 拟人化动物自带萌感，夸张表情放大情绪反差。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 搞笑调侃，职场自嘲式的轻松感。
cards.why: 自嘲式幽默降低说教感，让人愿意转发吐槽。

spec: 以前叫拍马屁 / 现在叫提供情绪价值
分别位于上下两格顶部居中
外留白均匀，格间有窄缝
圆眼镜、红领带的黑猫，有白色口鼻与爪
皱眉抿嘴，旁边有星形符号

sourcePrompt.en: Referencing the rhythm, contrast gags, panel density, and title tone of the image post "They say only people with high EQ get this in their feed😎", generate a new set of funny comic themes for Xiaohongshu: title "8 Absurd Moments Contemporary People Are Experiencing", subtitle "Turn life's tiny breakdowns into light, funny comic strips, great for comment-section interaction". Please output a 6-9 page image-text script, with each page containing the visual description, main copy, character emotion, and an interactive question on the last page.
sourcePrompt.zh-CN: 参考图文《据说只有高情商的人能刷到😎》的节奏、反差包袱、分镜密度和标题语气，生成一组新的小红书搞笑漫画主题：标题《当代人正在经历的8个离谱瞬间》，副标题“把生活小崩溃画成轻松好笑的连环图文，适合评论区互动”。请输出 6-9 页图文脚本，每页包含画面描述、主文案、角色情绪和最后一页互动提问。

cards.label: 钩子
cards.why: The blank group stare invites the viewer to write the caption, which is what makes a template spread.
alts: Three faces waiting for a line

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: Single uncropped photo panel; three subjects in a row along the upper two-thirds, round table across the bottom third
cards.why: One full-bleed frame leaves clear blank areas for text overlays top and bottom.
alts: Split into three equal vertical panels
Two stacked panels, top text bottom image

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: Warm reddish-brown subjects against a saturated red seat and light grey-white table
cards.why: The red seat band makes the brown figures pop instantly in a small feed thumbnail.

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: Three seated great apes with long reddish-brown hair, front row on a curved red bench
cards.why: Three identical animals in a serious pose read as a mock panel or jury, which is instantly funny.

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: Deadpan broadcast-studio seriousness played straight by animals
cards.why: The mismatch of solemn setting and animal faces is the comic tension people screenshot and reuse.

spec: space left for a viewer-written caption
three apes in a horizontal row
three great apes, long reddish-brown hair
curved red bench behind a round table
papers, pen, cup on the table
window with sky and a distant skyline

cards.label: 钩子
cards.why: 空白的群体凝视邀请观众来写说明文字，这正是模板得以传播的原因。
alts: 头顶上方留出空白对话空间
没有文字，纯粹的反应组合

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 单个未裁切照片面板；三个主体沿上方三分之二排成一行，圆桌横跨下方三分之一
cards.why: 一个全出血画框为顶部和底部的文字叠加留出清晰空白区域。
alts: 分成三个等宽的垂直面板
两个堆叠面板，上文字下图像
方形裁切并带有说明栏

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 暖红棕色主体，配以饱和红色座椅和浅灰白色桌子
cards.why: 红色座椅带让棕色人物在小尺寸信息流缩略图中立刻突出。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 三只坐着的大型猿类，长着红棕色长毛，前排坐在弧形红色长椅上
cards.why: 三只一模一样的动物摆出严肃姿势，看起来像模拟小组或陪审团，这立刻就很搞笑。
alts: 五只坐着的猿组成的群体

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 动物一本正经地演绎冷面播音室式严肃
cards.why: 庄重场景与动物面孔的不匹配，是人们截图并重新使用的喜剧张力。

底部三分之一，椭圆边缘

sourcePrompt.zh-CN: 创建一个新的[模因模板]概念 标题 把“思考吧马克思考”变成新鲜的社交模因 副标题 保留经典的视觉节奏，换入新的笑点和受众洞察。创意方向：模因模板 方法：保留原模板的结构、冲突、视线和反转时机，同时把情境替换为英语社交洞察。请输出：1. 用于社交发布的简洁英文标题和副标题；2. 2-4条可直接放在模因上的简短英文说明行；3. 用于图像生成或图像编辑的视觉提示，涵盖主体、构图、排版、贴纸和留白；4. 发布建议：使用场景、话题标签和互动钩子。限制：不要重现真实人物的身份、商标或水印；不要声称来源授权；保留原图时，仅将其用作构图参考。

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: クソほど地頭がいい人の『思考の圧縮術』
cards.why: Uses an extremely colloquial exaggerated word plus a quoted term to create a strong curiosity gap around a "smart person's secret method," making people want to read on.
alts: Change to a question: What do smart people have in common?
Number first: The thinking compression technique you can grasp in 1 image
Contrast style: People whose brains overload vs. naturally smart people

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Large title and subtitle at the top, below it a three-column comparison plus a four-step bar at the bottom
cards.why: The title occupies the visual center, and below it columns and numbered bars cut the abstract concept into scannable small chunks, suitable for saving and sharing.
alts: Change to a vertical long image with two left-right columns
Put four-step cards directly below the top title
Remove the columns and change to a single-column timeline

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Mainly white background with black lines, using blue and yellow as accent colors to distinguish the two sides' viewpoints
cards.why: The black-and-white hand-drawn base ensures readability under high information density, while the blue-yellow contrast makes "cluttered person / naturally smart person" immediately split to each side.
alts: Change to a cream background with red and blue dual colors
Dark background with fluorescent yellow emphasis

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: Hand-drawn board-style drawing-board person, a diagram of information compressed into a box, and two contrasting person avatars on the left and right
cards.why: Uses stick figures plus physical-object metaphors to turn an abstract ability like "thinking compression" into an understandable action, lowering the barrier to comprehension.
alts: Change to real photos with arrow annotations
Keep only one person with a knotted head
Use gears and a funnel to represent information flow

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: A light hand-drawn note feel, rational with a bit of humor
cards.why: Not serious and not chicken-soup-ish, like a top student's class notes, making the method feel credible and making people willing to follow along.
alts: Change to a calm minimalist tech feel
Use a dark chalkboard chalk style

spec: The "Thinking Compression Technique" of Insanely Smart People
Centered at the top of the image, occupying about 80% of the width
Bold black handwritten style, black, with a blue underline
Main title and subtitle, about 20% of the height
Three major columns: left, center, right, widths close to 1:1.2:1
Four-step horizontal bar, arranged at equal widths

xray.short: White background with blue and yellow accents

spec: One person points at a board covered in sticky notes, with two small figures beside them having question marks above their heads
Scattered icons are turned into a cube box by a compressor
Two avatars contrasted left and right, one side with tangled lines and the other with a lightbulb above the head
Black-and-white hand drawing with a small amount of colored-pencil fill
Even with no shadows, flat coloring

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: クソほど地頭がいい人の『思考の圧縮術』
cards.why: 用极端口语化的夸张词加引号术语，制造“聪明人秘密方法”的强好奇心缺口，让人想往下看。
alts: 改成疑问句：地頭がいい人の共通点は？
数字前置：1枚でわかる思考の圧縮術
对比式：頭がパンクする人 vs 地頭がいい人

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 上部大标题加副标题，下方三大分栏对比加底部四步骤条
cards.why: 标题占据视觉中心，下面用分栏和编号条把抽象概念切成可扫读的小块，适合收藏和转发。
alts: 改成左右两栏纵向长图
顶部标题下直接放四步骤卡片
去掉分栏改成单列时间线

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 白底黑线为主，蓝黄作强调色区分两侧观点
cards.why: 黑白手绘底保证信息密度下的可读性，蓝黄对比让“散らかる人/地頭がいい人”一眼分边。
alts: 改成米黄底加红蓝双色

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 手绘板书画板人物、信息压缩成箱子的示意图、左右两个对照人物头像
cards.why: 用火柴人加实物隐喻把“思维压缩”这种抽象能力画成可看懂的动作，降低理解门槛。
alts: 换成真实照片加箭头标注
只保留一个打结脑袋的人物
用齿轮和漏斗表示信息流

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 轻快的手绘笔记感，理性又带点幽默
cards.why: 不严肃不鸡汤，像学霸同学的课堂笔记，让人觉得方法可信也愿意照着做。
alts: 增加暖色手账胶带元素

spec: クソほど地頭がいい人の『思考の圧縮術』
粗黑手写体，黑色，加蓝色下划线
主标题与副标题，约占高度20%
三大分栏：左中右，宽度接近1:1.2:1
一人指着写满便签的板，旁边两个小人头顶问号
散乱图标经压机变成立方体箱子
左右两个头像对比，一侧线条打结一侧头顶灯泡
黑白手绘加少量彩笔填色

sourcePrompt.en: Based on the reference cover's composition, visual metaphor, and WeChat public-account thumbnail readability, generate a new horizontal WeChat public-account cover. Output size: 1456x582, ratio about 2.5:1; the core subject and essential title information should also work with WeChat's safe square crop. WeChat article title: {fill in the WeChat article title} Summary: {fill in the summary} Original cover method: "Thinking Compression": The Secret of Extremely Smart People Style dual-skill Create a horizontal WeChat public-account article cover, 2.35:1 aspect ratio, for an article titled ""Thinking Compression": The Secret of Extremely Smart People". Central concept: distill a single visual metaphor around "the secret of thinking compression for extremely smart people," avoiding cramming all the article's information into the image. Style: preserve the reference cover's visual direction: black-and-white or low-saturation editorial illustration/photo. Use a palette inspired by #fefefe (white), #dbdedd (cream), #7b7c7c (gray), #fcfcfb (white). Keep the image editorial, conceptual, and readable as a small WeChat thumbnail. Composition: the image is information-dense, suitable for a central subject plus supporting information on the left and right, keeping the thumbnail readable. Keep the main subject and any essential title text inside the safe square crop, while using the full wide frame for atmosphere, secondary symbols, or directional motion. Text strategy: use either no text or a very short headline fragment from the title. If text is used, make it large, clean, and integrated into the layout rather than pasted on top. Mood: match the article skill "the secret of thinking compression for extremely smart people style dual-skill" -- useful, sharp, high-signal, and slightly more memorable than a normal tutorial thumbnail. Avoid: photorealistic clutter unless the source cover is photo-led, fake logos, unreadable tiny text, generic gradient blobs, stock-office imagery, watermark-like marks, and literal screenshots unless the article is explicitly about software interfaces.

cards.label: Hook
cards.why: The wordless image first makes people curious about "why the water drop is being fished," creating click and share motivation.
alts: Enlarge the water drop and center it
Add a number to the hook

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Single-panel panoramic banner, with the central hook as the visual center, industry on the left, city in the middle right, and pipes in the middle

cards.label: Palette

cards.label: Subject

cards.label: Mood

cards.label: Palette

cards.label: Mood

cards.why: 同一个熟悉的角色被画得更精致，带来清晰而满足的地位反转。

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: 大蒜的一生
cards.why: Using an anthropomorphic timeline adds a “stage” concept to an ordinary ingredient, making people want to see which stage the garlic in their own home is at.
alts: Which Stage Is Your Garlic At

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: A cross-sectioned garlic body in the center, with two rows of four columns above and below, four equal-width columns separated by three vertical lines, overall symmetrical and centered.
cards.why: The symmetrical four-column comparison structure lowers reading effort, letting you horizontally compare four states at a glance.
alts: Large central image with labels on both sides

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Beige-apricot background with dark brown text; the garlic itself has purple-red, milky white, tender green, and withered brown—color as classification.
cards.why: The low-saturation beige background keeps the text from being harsh, while the purple, white, green, and brown of the garlic cloves naturally become a four-part color code.
alts: Pure white background with natural produce colors

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A horizontally cut garlic, showing four states from left to right: fresh, dried, sprouted, and shriveled.
cards.why: Making “time” concrete as four cross-sections of one garlic from left to right gives a stronger sense of wholeness than four separate photos.
alts: Four separate garlic bulbs laid flat
Real shots of garlic growth stages
Macro close-up of a garlic cross-section

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: A clean ingredient-science feel, like comparison specimens in a food lab—rational yet a little cute.
cards.why: A restrained, credible visual makes the content feel “evidence-based,” suitable for saving as a tool image.

spec: Top center, about one-eighth of the image height
Sans-serif bold black, dark brown, tight letter spacing
Sets the tone: telling an ingredient as life stages
One row above and one below the subject, each row with four equal-width columns
Three thin vertical lines running through the upper and lower label areas
Generous top and bottom margins, subject centered and about half the height

xray.short: Beige background with four color segments

spec: Wet cut surface with purple-red skin
Green sprout emerging from the top
Dried skin, hollow spaces in the cut surface
Even flat light, no strong shadows
Clear ingredient cross-sections, close to macro
Suitable as a save-worthy tool image

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: 大蒜的一生
cards.why: 用拟人化的时间叙事给普通食材加了一个“阶段”概念，让人想看看自己家那瓣蒜处在哪一步。

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 正中一个横切大蒜主体，上下两条四列表格，四列等宽由三条竖线分隔，整体对称居中。
cards.why: 对称的四栏对照结构降低阅读成本，一眼就能横向比较四种状态。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 米杏色底配深棕文字，蒜体自带紫红、乳白、嫩绿与枯褐，颜色即分类。
cards.why: 低饱和米色底让文字不刺眼，蒜瓣本身的紫、白、绿、褐天然成了四段色彩编码。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 一颗横向剖开的大蒜，从左到右依次呈现新鲜、干燥、发芽、干瘪四种状态的切面。
cards.why: 把“时间”具象成一颗蒜从左到右的四段剖面，比放四张照片更有整体感。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 干净的食材科普感，像食品实验室的对照标本，理性又有点可爱。
cards.why: 克制、可信的视觉让内容显得“有依据”，适合被收藏当工具图。

spec: 顶部居中，约占画面上八分之一高
无衬线粗黑体，深棕色，字距紧凑
定调：把食材讲成生命阶段

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: 看懂板块，你就比90%的散户多一个视角
cards.why: Using the specific number "90%" creates a cognitive gap, making retail investors wonder, "Am I among that 10%?" and identify with it.
alts: 3 signals to spot sector rotation early
Most people are reading this indicator wrong
Understand this chart and save 3 years of detours

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Left text, right image; the left headline occupies two and a half lines, and the right side is a matrix of sector heatmap cards inside a circular background
cards.why: Dividing left and right lets readers first be hooked by the large text, then get instantly credible visual evidence from the right image, lowering comprehension cost.

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Off-white background, black main headline, orange accent numbers, and right-side color blocks in brown-red, green, and yellow to indicate gains/losses and defense
cards.why: Warm off-white reduces the cold, hard feel of financial content, while orange-black contrast keeps key numbers readable on both large and small screens at a glance.
alts: Deep blue background with gold numbers
Pure white background with red/green up-down colors
Black background with fluorescent orange headline

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A matrix of 11 sector color blocks inside a circle on the right, each labeled with sector name, code, and change percentage
cards.why: Turning abstract industry sectors into a scannable matrix of color blocks makes color itself the conclusion, satisfying the need to "understand at a glance" for saves.

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Rational, professional, with a slight sense of urgency, like an industry scan briefing for retail investors
cards.why: Restrained typography with a hint of "one more perspective" feels both credible and fear-of-missing-out, driving saves and shares.

spec: Understand sectors and you'll have one more perspective than 90% of retail investors
Left side of the image, top-aligned
Black Song-style main text, orange numbers and "perspective" emphasized
Arranged in three lines, largest font size
Left text takes about 45%, right chart takes about 40%
11 cards placed inside a circular backing
Even whitespace between cards, overall centered
11 sector color blocks, labeled with Chinese name, code, and change percentage

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: 看懂板块，你就比90%的散户多一个视角
cards.why: 用“90%”这个具体数字制造认知落差，让散户产生“我是否属于那10%”的自我代入。
alts: 大多数人都看错了这个指标
看懂这张图，少走3年弯路

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 左文右图，左侧标题占两行半，右侧是圆形背景里的板块热力图卡片矩阵
cards.why: 左右分工让读者先被大字钩住，再用右图给出即时可信的视觉证据，降低理解成本。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 米白底、黑色主标题、橙色强调数字、右侧色块用棕红绿黄表示涨跌与防御
cards.why: 暖米白降低财经内容的冷硬感，橙黑对比让关键数字在大屏小屏都一眼可读。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 右侧圆形内的11个板块色块矩阵，每块标注板块名、代码和涨跌幅
cards.why: 把抽象行业板块变成可扫读的色块矩阵，颜色即结论，满足“一眼看懂”的收藏需求。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 理性、专业、带轻微紧迫感，像一份给散户的行业扫描简报
cards.why: 克制的排版配上“多一个视角”的暗示，既可信又让人怕错过，促发收藏和转发。

spec: 看懂板块，你就比90%的散户多一个视角
黑色宋体主字，橙色数字与“视角”强调
左侧文字占约45%，右侧图表占约40%
圆形底衬内放置11个卡片
卡片间有均匀留白，整体居中

底部三色说明：上涨/下跌/防御

Creative direction: meme template Method: preserve the original template structure, conflict, eye-line, and reversal timing while replacing the situation with an English-language social insight. Please output: 1. A concise English title and subtitle for social posting; 2. 2-4 short English caption lines that can be placed directly on the meme; 3. A visual prompt for image generation or image editing, covering subject, composition, typography, stickers, and whitespace; 4. Posting advice: use case, hashtags, and engagement hook. Constraints: do not recreate a real person's identity, trademark, or watermark; do not claim source authorization; when keeping the source image, use it only as a composition reference.

cards.label: Mood

sourcePrompt.en: Referencing the case study "Recreating the life of young people in 2008 with AI" — its old-photo restoration approach, period texture, visual storytelling, and publishing tone — generate a new set of retro old-photo image-and-text posts. New theme: {fill in the photo theme you want to restore, rebuild, or replicate} Reference platform: Xiaohongshu Content direction: retro old-photo image-and-text Creation method: keep the original case's nostalgic mood, film/photo-paper texture, relationships between people, period feel of the scene, and restoration constraints; if it is photo restoration, you must stay faithful to the original image's identity, facial features, composition, and historical context, avoiding excessive beauty filters, redrawing, false historical information, and a modern digital plastic look. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. A 6-9 page image-and-text script, each page including a visual description, main copy, period/texture keywords, and a save prompt; 3. Visual prompts that can be used directly for image generation or photo restoration, specifying requirements for people, scene, lighting, film grain, damage repair, and color restoration; 4. Publishing suggestions: title length, tags, image aspect ratio, and platform tone. Constraints: do not replicate the original author, original people, or brand logos; do not fabricate historical facts; when real people's photos are involved, prioritize identity consistency, and do not make them younger, beautify, slim the face, or alter facial features.

sourcePrompt.en: Referencing the old photo restoration approach, era texture, visual storytelling, and posting tone of the case study "Vintage Old Photo Case 0003", generate a new set of vintage old photo image-and-text content. New theme: {fill in the photo theme you want to restore, rebuild, or recreate} Reference platform: Xiaohongshu Content direction: vintage old photo image-and-text Creation method: keep the original case's nostalgic emotion, film/photo paper texture, character relationships, scene era feel, and restoration constraints; if it's photo restoration, it must be faithful to the original identity, facial features, composition, and historical context, avoiding excessive beautification, redrawing, false historical information, and a modern digital plastic feel. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. A 6-9 page image-and-text script, each page containing a visual description, main copy, era/texture keywords, and a save prompt; 3. Visual prompts that can be used directly for image generation or photo restoration, explaining requirements for characters, scene, lighting, film grain, damage repair, and color restoration; 4. Posting suggestions: title length, tags, image ratio, and platform tone. Constraints: do not replicate the original author, original people, or brand logos; do not fabricate historical facts; when real people's photos are involved, prioritize preserving identity consistency, and do not make them younger, beautify, slim the face, or rewrite facial features.
sourcePrompt.zh-CN: 参考案例《复古老照片案例 0003》的老照片修复方式、年代质感、画面叙事和发布语气，生成一组新的复古老照片图文。 新主题：{填写你要修复、重建或复刻的照片主题} 参考平台：小红书 内容方向：复古老照片图文 创作方法：保留原案例的怀旧情绪、胶片/相纸质感、人物关系、场景年代感和修复约束；如果是照片修复，必须忠于原图身份、五官、构图和历史语境，避免过度美颜、重绘、虚假历史信息和现代数码塑料感。 请输出： 1. 封面标题与副标题； 2. 6-9 页图文脚本，每页包含画面描述、主文案、年代/质感关键词和收藏引导； 3. 可直接用于图像生成或照片修复的视觉提示词，说明人物、场景、光线、胶片颗粒、破损修复和色彩还原要求； 4. 发布建议：标题长度、标签、图片比例和平台语气。 约束：不要复刻原作者、原人物或品牌标识；不要编造历史事实；涉及真实人物照片时优先保留身份一致性，不做年轻化、美颜、瘦脸或五官改写。

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: 老照片别扔！修完像新的一样
cards.why: First persuade people not to throw away old photos, then promise they can be restored like new, giving a full reason in one sentence to make people stop and finish the comparison image.
alts: Don't throw away old photos! One click to make them clear
Old family photos can still be saved

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Three vertical sections: title + two side-by-side equal-sized photos, black checklist area, bottom caption bar; checklist area split into two columns
cards.why: The image shows while the text tells, the two-photo comparison and checklist lay out the selling points at once, information-dense but scannable at a glance.
alts: Half left-right: image left, text right
Image top, text bottom, single-column list
Four sections split evenly top to bottom

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Cream yellow background + full pure black bar, right photo on dark red background
cards.why: The strong contrast of cream yellow and pure black is like an old photo album cover, and the dark red background makes the restored photo stand out especially bright.
alts: Dark brown background + cream white text
Gray white background + ink green accents

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: Two three-person group photos side by side: left is a yellowed old photo, right is a color new photo
cards.why: The before-and-after comparison of the same group photo is natural evidence, and viewers immediately understand how good the effect can be.
alts: A single old photo enlarged close-up
Restoration before and after stacked top and bottom
Multiple old photos in a nine-grid

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Warm and nostalgic, mottled old photo juxtaposed with bright new photo
cards.why: Nostalgic emotion paired with the brightness after restoration reminds people of their own photo albums and makes them save it for later.

spec: 老照片别扔！修完像新的一样
Top center of the image, in two lines
Largest in the whole image, two lines take up about one fifth of the top
Dim old photo juxtaposed with bright new photo
Even and soft, no obvious shadows

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: 老照片别扔！修完像新的一样
cards.why: 先劝人别扔旧照片，再承诺修好如新，一句话给足理由让人停下来看完对比图。

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 三段纵向：标题＋两张并排等大照片、黑色清单区、底部说明条，清单区分两列
cards.why: 图在看、字在说，双图对比与勾选清单把卖点一次排清，信息密但一眼扫得完。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 米黄底＋整条纯黑，右侧照片深红背景
cards.why: 米黄与纯黑的强反差像老相册封面，深红背景把修复后的照片衬得格外鲜亮。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 左右并排的两张三人合影：左侧泛黄旧照，右侧彩色新照
cards.why: 同一张合影的前后对照是天生证据，看图的人立刻明白效果能到什么程度。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 温情怀旧，旧照斑驳与新照鲜亮并置
cards.why: 怀旧情绪配上翻新后的明快，让人想起自家相册，忍不住收藏备用。

spec: 老照片别扔！修完像新的一样
全图最大，两行占上部约五分之一
旧照黯淡与新照鲜亮并置

Creative direction: meme template Method: preserve the original template structure, conflict, eye-line, and reversal timing while replacing the situation with an English-language social insight. Please output: 1. A concise English title and subtitle for social posting; 2. 2-4 short English caption lines that can be placed directly on the meme; 3. A visual prompt for image generation or image editing, covering subject, composition, typography, stickers, and whitespace; 4. Posting advice: use case, hashtags, and engagement hook. Constraints: do not recreate a real person's identity, trademark, or watermark; do not claim source authorization; when keeping the source image, use it only as a composition reference.

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: 喂，妈？
cards.why: The most everyday line when answering a call instantly puts readers into the tense feeling of "a call from Mom and Dad."
alts: The caller avatar on the phone screen
A relaxed posture lying on the sofa

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Three-panel comic: a full-width horizontal panel on top, a small panel at bottom left, and a large panel at bottom right
cards.why: A wide-top, narrow-bottom panel rhythm pulls the eye from the full scene to the phone close-up and then to the character's reaction.
alts: Four equal panels in a vertical row
Two stacked panels with a central close-up

cards.label: Color Palette
cards.value: Pure black-and-white line art, no fill colors, with hierarchy shown only through line density
cards.why: Minimal black and white feels like a sketchbook doodle, easy to read and lowering the barrier to copying.
alts: A monochrome cream paper texture background
Black and white with a touch of red

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A long-haired character lying back on the sofa watching a tablet, then picking up the phone
cards.why: The contrast between a relaxed at-home posture and being interrupted by a phone call is the moment readers relate to most.
alts: Draw only the character's face answering the call
Draw the character springing up from the sofa

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: A lazy everyday at-home feel, with slight tension from the call breaking it
cards.why: The emotional drop from calm to being interrupted by "a call from Mom" creates a knowing smile of recognition.
alts: A low-pressure vibe of tired slacking

spec: Right side of the bottom-right panel, slightly above the character's mouth
Handwritten-style black text, sans-serif, medium size
Use the first line of answering the phone to pull readers into the scene
Spans the full width, about 44% of the height
Thin black divider lines between panels
Indicated only by line density, no grayscale
A long-haired character lying back on the sofa, with a tablet standing on the table to the right
A tilted phone, with a smiling face avatar on the screen labeled "Mom"
The same character holding the phone to their ear and talking
Line art only, no facial coloring
The phone vibration and answering break the calm
No light-and-shadow treatment, all white space
Light gray small text "Xiami Daily" in the bottom right corner

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: 喂，妈？
cards.why: 一句最日常的接电话台词，让人立刻代入“爸妈来电”的紧张感。
alts: 手机屏幕上的来电头像

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 三格漫画：上方整幅横格，左下小格，右下大格
cards.why: 上宽下窄的分镜节奏，把视线从全景推到手机特写再落到人物反应。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 纯黑白线稿，无填充色，仅靠线条疏密区分层次
cards.why: 极简黑白像手账速写，读起来轻松不费力，也降低复制门槛。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 一个长发人物躺靠在沙发上看平板，随后接起手机
cards.why: 居家的松弛姿态与被电话打断的反差，是读者最有共鸣的瞬间。
alts: 只画人物接电话的脸部

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 宅家慵懒的日常感，被来电打破的轻微紧张
cards.why: 平静被“妈来电”打断的情绪落差，制造出会心一笑的共鸣。

spec: 右下格右侧，人物嘴边偏上
手写体式黑字，无衬线，字号中等
用接电话的第一句话把读者拉进情节
格与格之间为细黑分隔线
仅用线条密度示意，无灰阶
一个长发人物躺靠在沙发上，右侧桌上立着平板
一部倾斜的手机，屏幕内是笑脸头像，标注“妈”
同一人物把手机贴在耳边说话
仅线稿勾勒，无面部上色
手机震动与接听打破平静
右下角淡灰小字“虾米日常”

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: THE END of our world
cards.why: All-caps bold paired with handwriting is naturally an end-of-days declaration that makes people want to read on immediately.

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Single horizontal banner composition, text pressed center-left, mountains spread horizontally below
cards.why: A single illustration with centered text conveys conflict at first glance, fitting for a horizontal WeChat public account cover.

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Teal sky with orange-red flames, cream bold type contrasting with vermilion handwriting
cards.why: Strong warm-cool contrast stands out in the feed, and apocalyptic red-orange tones evoke tension.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: Erupting volcano with black smoke, foreground of rolling gray mountains
cards.why: The disaster scene has built-in story feel, hinting at destruction and mystery in the novel.

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Apocalyptic thriller, tense and oppressive
cards.why: Dark background interwoven with firelight creates panic and unknown suspense.

spec: Upper half and lower right of the image
Single full-bleed panel with no inner margins

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: THE END of our world
cards.why: 全大写粗体加手写体对照，天然就是末日宣言，令人立刻想读完。

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 单幅横幅构图，文字压在中央偏左，山脉在下方横向铺开
cards.why: 独幅插图配中心文字，适合公众号横版封面在第一眼就传达冲突。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 青绿天空配橙红火焰，米白粗体与朱红手写体形成对比
cards.why: 冷暖强撞色在信息流里跳脱，末日红橙色调激发紧张情绪。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 喷发的火山与黑烟，前景为起伏的灰色山脉
cards.why: 灾难场景自带故事感，暗示小说中的毁灭与谜团。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 末日惊悚、紧张压抑
cards.why: 暗沉背景与火焰明暗交错，营造恐慌与未知的悬疑感。

spec: 全大写粗体衬线 + 手写体

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A boy with his hand pressed against the wall and a short-haired student wearing an armband
cards.why: Physical contact creates direct conflict, and readers instinctively want to see who gives in first.

cards.label: Mood

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: AI老照片修复
cards.why: Directly points out the action of "restoration", the old-photo comparison is right in front of the eyes, letting people understand at a glance what they can get back.

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Two equal-width cells side by side, occupying about the upper two-thirds; below, a white horizontal bar with a centered enlarged title
cards.why: Two images side by side left and right, the eyes automatically compare before and after, and they are convinced in one sentence.
alts: Single large image with corner text

cards.label: Color palette
cards.value: Large areas of white background below and around, the left photo yellowed and aged, the right photo with bright green trees and red tabletop
cards.why: The white background lifts up the two photos, and the extreme contrast between yellow and bright makes "restoration" visible to the naked eye.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: In each of the two cells, there are two children, one older and one younger; the younger one sits in a metal basin, on a low red table
cards.why: The combination of children and old objects most easily triggers the sense of identification of "whose family photo is this".
alts: An old photo of a pet

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: The left side is mottled and creased, the right side is clean and bright, nostalgia and renewal presented side by side
cards.why: A sense of age and a sense of freshness in the same frame; the emotional gap makes people willing to save it and forward it to family.

xray.short: Large title pressed to the bottom
spec: In the white area at the bottom of the image, centered and starting slightly left
Largest font size, occupying about 80% of the image width

xray.short: White background sets off yellow photos
spec: Large white background below and around
The yellowed, aged base color of the left photo
The green of the trees in the image

xray.short: Old and new gazing at each other
spec: Nostalgic texture juxtaposed with clear brightness
The right side is overall brighter, the left side is darker and grayer

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: AI老照片修复
cards.why: 直接点明“修复”这一动作，旧照对比就在眼前，让人一眼看懂能拿回什么。

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 左右两格等宽并列，占上方约三分之二；下方白底横条居中放大字标题
cards.why: 左右同图并列，眼睛自动做前后对照，一句话就被说服。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 下方与四周大面积白底，左侧照片泛黄做旧，右侧照片绿树与红色桌面偏鲜亮
cards.why: 白底把两块照片托起来，黄与亮的两极对比让“修复”变得肉眼可见。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 左右两格各有一大一小两个孩子，小的坐在金属盆里，坐在红色矮桌上
cards.why: 孩童与旧物的组合最容易触发“这是谁家的照片”的代入感。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 左侧斑驳折痕、右侧干净明亮，怀旧与焕新并排呈现
cards.why: 岁月感和清新感同框，情绪落差让人愿意收藏并转发给家人。

字号最大，约占画面宽度八成

sourcePrompt.en: Referring to the old photo restoration method, vintage texture, visual storytelling and posting tone of the case study "Whose memory has been awakened❓AI Old Photo Restoration📷", generate a new set of vintage old photo image-text posts. New topic: {fill in the photo topic you want to restore, rebuild or recreate} Reference platform: Xiaohongshu Content direction: vintage old photo image-text Creation method: keep the nostalgic emotion, film/photo paper texture, character relationships, era sense of the scene and restoration constraints of the original case; if it is photo restoration, it must be faithful to the original image's identity, facial features, composition and historical context, avoiding excessive beautification, redrawing, false historical information and modern digital plastic feel. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. 6-9 page image-text script, each page including visual description, main copy, era/texture keywords and save guide; 3. Visual prompts that can be directly used for image generation or photo restoration, explaining requirements for characters, scene, lighting, film grain, damage repair and color restoration; 4. Posting suggestions: title length, tags, image ratio and platform tone. Constraints: do not replicate the original author, original characters or brand logos; do not fabricate historical facts; when involving photos of real people, prioritize preserving identity consistency, and do not do rejuvenation, beautification, face slimming or facial feature rewriting.

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: The Reason 90% of AI Workflows Die in 30 Days
cards.why: Use large bold "90%" and "30 Days" to create a concrete numerical contrast that makes people want to know why at a glance.
alts: Use a specific percentage + time to create contrast
Put the failure number at the largest font size
Use a subtitle to add the solution

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: A left-right split comparing the failure and success paths, with the right column extending into three rule cards
cards.why: A left-right comparison lets readers quickly see the difference, and the neatly arranged rule cards make it easy to save.
alts: Two-column layout with title on the left and comparison on the right
Timeline layout aligned top to bottom

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Off-white background paired with coral red and gray-green, purple for the failure side and green for the success side
cards.why: Warm and cool colors clearly distinguish failure from success, and the off-white background keeps a long image from tiring the eyes.
alts: Warm gray background with red-green contrast
Low-saturation Morandi colors to distinguish states
Dark background with bright highlight colors

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: A comparison diagram of the failure timeline on the left and the success timeline on the right, plus three rule cards
cards.why: A visualized timeline is more convincing than plain text, and a flowchart makes abstract concepts intuitive.
alts: Use a flowchart instead of plain text explanation
Use emoji icons to enhance emotional communication
Add grave and plant icons to symbolize outcomes

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Rational, clear, with a slight warning feel, overall professional and trustworthy
cards.why: Warning tones combined with solutions make people feel both pressure and a way out, so they are willing to save it.
alts: Serious warning style with clear answers
Light professional feel with a positive ending

spec: The Reason 90% of AI Workflows Die in 30 Days
Sans-serif bold, 90% extra large with red doodle highlight
Black main text, 90% in black with coral red background
Title on the left, comparison chart in the middle, rule cards on the right
The middle splits into left and right halves, gray-purple failure line on the left, green success line on the right
Three cards arranged vertically on the right, with a summary line at the bottom
Day 1 sad robot face, Day 7 confused, Day 30 grave and dead tree
Day 1 smiling face, Day 7 momentum, Day 30+ results and plants
Three rounded white cards containing icons, numbered titles, and explanatory text
Light green banner with a heart and a summary sentence
Low saturation, high brightness, calm and restrained
Flat design with no shadows, even and bright
Warn first, then offer hope, rational and actionable
Clear information hierarchy, reads like a professional guide

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: The Reason 90% of AI Workflows Die in 30 Days
cards.why: 用大号加粗的“90%”和“30 Days”制造具体数字反差，让人一眼想知道为什么。
alts: 用具体百分比+时间制造反差
把失败数字放在最大字号位置
用副标题补充解决方案

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 左右分栏对比失败与成功路径，右侧分栏延伸出三条规则卡片
cards.why: 左右对照让读者快速看到差异，规则卡片整齐排列便于保存。
alts: 左标题右对比双栏布局

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 米白底搭配珊瑚红与灰绿色，紫色用于失败侧，绿色用于成功侧
cards.why: 冷暖色明确区分失败与成功，米白底让长图阅读不疲劳。
alts: 低饱和莫兰迪色系区分状态
深色背景加高亮高光色

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 左侧失败时间线与右侧成功时间线的对比图示，以及三张规则卡片
cards.why: 具象化时间线比纯文字更有说服力，流程图让抽象概念变直观。
alts: 用流程图代替纯文字说明
用表情图标增强情绪传达
加入坟墓和植物图标象征结果

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 理性、清晰、带轻微警示感，整体显得专业且可信赖
cards.why: 警示色调配合解决方案，让人感到既有压力又有出路，愿意收藏。
alts: 严肃警示风搭配清晰解答
高效工整的信息图氛围
轻量专业感与积极收尾

spec: The Reason 90% of AI Workflows Die in 30 Days

黑色主字，90% 为黑字配珊瑚红底

三张圆角白卡，内含图标与编号标题和说明文字

cards.value: 孕6月，她发现了丈夫的背叛。及时止损，离婚，引产。

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Single image, no panels; a rectangular text box in the upper left, the rest is a complete scene
cards.why: The text box states the conclusion first, while the image below fills in details, leading the eye from top to bottom through the whole story.
alts: Two stacked panels, text on top, image below
Two columns with image on the left and text on the right
Full image with no text, pure visual storytelling

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Large areas of whitespace, with light blue clothing and light pink clothing as two faint color accents
cards.why: Whitespace keeps the image clean and readable, and the two light-colored outfits immediately distinguish the two characters.

cards.label: Subject

Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. A 6-9 page image-text script, each page containing a visual description, main copy, era/texture keywords and a save prompt; 3. alts: Add labels on each side: "no investment / investment"
Place the title across the center seam

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Two equal-size diagonal halves left and right, with the diagonal running from top center to bottom center, each taking about half
cards.why: The diagonal split layout naturally creates tension, letting viewers judge "win or lose" at a glance, perfect for a list-style viral opener.

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Left in cool deep blue dark tones, right in warm golden tones, with a clear boundary at the diagonal
cards.why: Cold colors = scarcity, warm colors = abundance is a common consensus; the colors alone tell the conclusion, no text needed.
alts: Black and white with a touch of gold

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: On the left, a person crawling on the ground; on the right, a person sitting on a pile of gold coins with arms raised and head tilted up
cards.why: The same character in two postures lets readers relate to "the same person, different choices," making the contrast easiest to remember and share.
alts: Change to a comparison of two pairs of hands

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Left side depressed and defeated, right side excited and smug, overall a flat-illustration-style dramatic contrast
cards.why: Juxtaposing emotional extremes makes readers feel anxiety first, then hope; the emotional swing directly drives clicks and saves.
alts: Add a sense of laughter and sighing sound effects

Diagonal from top center to bottom center

Piles of yellow gold coins and a treasure chest in the distance
Cool blue and dark, emotionally suppressed

cards.label: 钩子
cards.why: 强烈的贫富视觉反差让人瞬间代入，产生“我属于哪一边”的自检冲动。

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 左右两块等大斜切对比，斜线从顶部中央斜向底部中央，各占约一半
cards.why: 斜切对比版式天然制造张力，两眼一扫就完成“输赢”判断，适合清单型爆款开篇。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 左冷深蓝暗调，右金黄暖调，斜线处形成明确分界
cards.why: 冷色=匮乏、暖色=富足是大众共识，颜色本身就把结论讲完了，无需文字。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 左侧一人伏地爬行，右侧一人坐于金币堆上举手仰头
cards.why: 同一角色两种姿态让读者代入“同一个人不同选择”，对比信息最易被记住和转发。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 左边压抑失落，右边兴奋得意，整体为扁平插画式的戏剧化对比
cards.why: 情绪两极并置让读者先感到焦虑再感到希望，情绪起伏直接推动点击与收藏。

Public-account article title: {填写公众号文章标题} Intro: {填写简介} Original cover method: Why TAO is the Bitcoin of AI style dual-skill Create a horizontal WeChat public-account article cover, 2.35:1 aspect ratio, for an article titled "Why TAO Is the Bitcoin of AI". Central concept: visualize abstract tool capabilities as interface windows, code snippets, node networks, control consoles, AI workflows, or a glowing system core. Style: preserve the reference cover's visual direction: black-and-white or low-saturation editorial illustration/photo. Use a palette inspired by #ffffff (white), #868686 (gray), #bbbbbb (cream), #9f9f9f (gray). Keep the image editorial, conceptual, and readable as a small WeChat thumbnail. Composition: high information density, best suited to a central subject with supporting information on the left and right, keeping the thumbnail readable. Keep the main subject and any essential title text inside the safe square crop, while using the full wide frame for atmosphere, secondary symbols, or directional motion. Text strategy: use either no text or a very short headline fragment from the title. If text is used, make it large, clean, and integrated into the layout rather than pasted on top. Mood: match the article skill "Why TAO is the Bitcoin of AI style dual-skill" -- useful, sharp, high-signal, and slightly more memorable than a normal tutorial thumbnail. Avoid: photorealistic clutter unless the source cover is photo-led, fake logos, unreadable tiny text, generic gradient blobs, stock-office imagery, watermark-like marks, and literal screenshots unless the article is explicitly about software interfaces.

cards.label: Hook
cards.why: Not a single word, yet it makes people stop and compare the two shapes left and right, creating the suspense of "what does this mean?"
alts: Use arrows to mark the difference
Add a number label on each side

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Two equal-sized rounded capsules side by side on a pure white background, centered and symmetric, with spacing of about half a capsule width
cards.why: A minimal symmetric two-element comparison saves the most cognitive effort; it's instantly clear that "these are two states."
alts: Switch to a top-bottom stacked comparison
Add a third variant on the right

cards.label: Palette
cards.value: Pure white background paired with pure black and light gray, only three colors, no gradients or shadows
cards.why: Black, white, and gray make the image look like a diagram rather than an ad, so readers are more willing to save it as knowledge content.
alts: Switch to an off-white background to lower contrast

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: Two vertical rounded capsule shapes: a light gray circle at the top of the left one, a light gray horizontal bar across the middle of the right one
cards.why: Drawing the abstract concept as two almost identical shapes, differing in just one spot, implies "the difference is exactly this one point."
alts: Change the gray block into a notch
Use a dashed box to mark the difference area

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: A calm, restrained analytical feel, like a diagram from a white paper or product spec page
cards.why: A non-sensational visual tone sets readers' expectation for rational breakdown next, suitable for opinion-style long-form articles.
alts: Add a faint grid to the background
Lower contrast for a softer feel

spec: No readable text in the image
Side by side, horizontally centered and aligned
Both have roughly equal height and width
Background, taking up most of the image
Fill of the two capsule subjects
The left circle and the right horizontal bar
Vertical rounded capsule with a light gray circle overlaid on top
Same-size vertical rounded capsule with a light gray horizontal rectangle covering its middle
Even flat light, no shadows or highlights

cards.label: 钩子
cards.why: 没有一个字，却让人停下来对比左右两个形状，形成“这是什么意思”的悬念。
alts: 左右各加一个数字编号

cards.label: 版式
cards.value: 纯白底上两个等大圆角胶囊左右并排，居中对称，间距约半个胶囊宽
cards.why: 极简对称的双元素对比最省认知成本，一眼就懂“这是两种状态”。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 纯白背景配纯黑与浅灰，仅三色，无渐变无阴影
cards.why: 黑白灰让画面像示意图而非广告，读者更愿意当作知识内容保存。

cards.label: 主体
cards.value: 两个竖直圆角胶囊图形：左侧顶部一个浅灰圆，右侧中部一条横贯的浅灰矩形
cards.why: 把抽象概念画成两个几乎相同的形状，只差一处，暗示“区别就在这一点”。

cards.label: 氛围
cards.value: 冷静克制的分析感，像白皮书或产品说明页的图解
cards.why: 不煽情的视觉语气让读者预期接下来是理性拆解，适合观点型长文。

spec: 左右并排，水平居中对齐
两者高度和宽度基本相等
竖直圆角胶囊，顶部叠加一个浅灰圆形
同尺寸竖直圆角胶囊，中部覆盖一条横向浅灰矩形
均匀平光，无阴影无高光

cards.label: Hook
cards.value: 为啥会性冷淡
cards.why: Use a blunt question to hit a hard-to-talk-about topic, making people click in and see themselves in it.
alts: Why do people lose interest in sex

cards.label: Layout
cards.value: Two-part vertical layout: the top dark blue-gray text banner takes about one quarter, and the bottom light blue scene illustration takes about three quarters, with no panel divisions.
cards.why: A big title takes up a full banner, so you read the text first and then the image; the information hierarchy is clear at a glance.
alts: Big title on top + full illustration
Left-right split: text left, image right

cards.label: Color Palette
cards.value: A dark blue-gray top bar paired with a light blue background, the overall image in cool tones, clean and uncluttered.
cards.why: The cool blue background makes the colorful large text pop, making it easier for the eye to catch while scrolling.

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: Two cartoon characters: one lying in bed wrapped in a blanket raising a hand, the other jumping up, with pillows and bedsheets.
cards.why: Exaggerated actions turn an awkward-to-mention scene into a joke, lowering shame and making people more willing to share.
alts: A finger pointing at the text banner
Close-up still life of bed and pillow

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: A lighthearted, witty comic rant feel, using humor to defuse an awkward topic.
cards.why: A humorous tone makes a heavy topic discussable, and the comments section naturally gets lively.

xray.short: Two lines of large title text
spec: Inside the dark top banner, centered
Cool blue base feels calm, character actions create contrast

cards.label: 钩子
cards.value: 为啥会性冷淡
cards.why: 用一句直白提问戳中难开口的话题，让人忍不住点进来对号入座。

cards.value: 上下两段式：顶部深蓝灰文字横幅约占四分之一，下方浅蓝场景插画约占四分之三，无分格。
cards.why: 大标题独占一整条横幅，先读字再看图，信息层级一眼分明。

cards.label: 配色
cards.value: 深蓝灰顶栏配浅蓝背景，画面整体冷调，干净不杂乱。
cards.why: 冷蓝底色把彩色大字衬得跳出来，滑动时更容易被眼睛抓住。

cards.label: 主体

sourcePrompt.en: Refer to the case study 'Why Do People Lose Interest in Sex? Say No to a Sexless Marriage' for its content structure, cover hook, visual pacing, and publishing tone, and generate a new set of viral image posts. New topic: {填写你要生成的主题} Reference platform: Xiaohongshu Content direction: emotional story image posts Creation method: Keep the original case's audience insights, narrative twists, and resonant phrasing, and use real-life snippets to drive the emotion rather than empty platitudes. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. A 6-8 page image script, each page including visual description, main copy, key info, and interaction/save action; 3. Visual prompts ready for image generation, specifying subject, scene, lighting, composition, font, or layout; 4. Publishing tips: title length, tags, image ratio, and platform tone. Constraints: Do not replicate the original author, original characters, or brand identifiers; do not fabricate data; when involving health, metaphysics, investment, or educational outcomes, avoid promising results.

Please output: 1. A concise English title and subtitle for social posting; 2. 2-4 short English caption lines that can be placed directly on the meme; 3. A visual prompt for image generation or image editing, covering subject, composition, typography, stickers, and whitespace; 4. Posting advice: use case, hashtags, and engagement hook. alts: Keep only the sharp version full-frame

Lower saturation for an aged film look

alts: Keep only a half-body frontal view
Scale down the figure to leave room for the background

Use a central circular crop to highlight the light point
Use a nine-grid collage with four water-light images

cards.label: Color palette

cards.label: Subject
cards.value: Close-up of water ripples and splashing droplets, with light points densely distributed along the ridges of the ripples
cards.why: Flowing liquid plus sparkle makes a static image seem to move, making it easier to stop when scrolling past.

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Bright and translucent, wealthy and sparkling, like good luck is flowing
cards.why: Bright, glowing things are easily seen as good omens, prompting people to repost for luck.

sourcePrompt.en: Please generate a new horizontal WeChat public-account cover based on the reference cover's composition, visual metaphor, and thumbnail readability for WeChat public accounts. Output size: 1456x582, ratio about 2.5:1; the core subject and essential title information must also work within the safe square crop for WeChat public accounts. WeChat article title: {fill in WeChat article title} Summary: {fill in summary} Original cover method: Yasuda Kinen Answer Sheet: Full-Field Horse Diagnosis, Track Aptitude, Jockey Ratings & Best Betting Tips dual-skill style Create a horizontal WeChat public-account article cover, 2.35:1 aspect ratio, for an article titled "Yasuda Kinen Answer Sheet: Full-Field Horse Diagnosis, Track Aptitude, Jockey Ratings & Best Betting Tips". Central concept: distill a single visual metaphor around "Yasuda Kinen answer sheet full-field horse diagnosis..." and avoid cramming the entire article into the image. Style: preserve the reference cover's visual direction: high-saturation poster/tech-ad aesthetic. Use a palette inspired by #020307 (black), #5b9bcd (blue), #fffffe (white), #263b59 (charcoal). Keep the image editorial, conceptual, and readable as a small WeChat thumbnail. Composition: the image has a fairly high information density, suitable for a central subject plus supporting information on the left and right, keeping the thumbnail readable. Keep the main subject and any essential title text inside the safe square crop, while using the full wide frame for atmosphere, secondary symbols, or directional motion. Text strategy: use either no text or a very short headline fragment from the title. If text is used, make it large, clean, and integrated into the layout rather than pasted on top. sourcePrompt.en: Refer to the content structure, first-image hook, visual rhythm and publishing tone of the case study "You Only Live in This World Once, Go See the Scenery You Love🍀" to generate a new set of viral image-text posts. New topic: {填写你要生成的主题} Reference platform: Douyin Content direction: AI image-text creation case Creative method: Break down the original case's tool entry point, visual style, step density and replicable parameters, and write the abstract method into an image-text tutorial that can be followed step by step. Please output: 1. Cover title and subtitle; 2. A 6-8 page image-text script, each page including visual description, main copy, information points and interaction/save action; 3. Visual prompts that can be used directly for image generation, explaining subject, scene, light, composition, font or layout; 4. Publishing suggestions: title length, tags, image ratio and platform tone. Constraints: Do not replicate the original author, original characters or brand logos; do not fabricate data; when it involves health, mysticism, investment or educational outcomes, avoid promising results.

Add a frame around the central figure

Focus on the hand removing the mask

cards.label: Mood
cards.value: Classical oil-painting texture, dark lighting, dramatic expressions with a voyeuristic feel

cards.label: 配色
